rows.name: Fire
rows.promise: A thread of orange light blooms into flame that scorches the ground, ignites grass and wood, spreads heat about ten paces, singes and frightens creatures, and burns for about a minute.
rows.does: Draws an orange beam to the target, scorches the centre to ash, heats and ignites the area, rolls heat out to 10 cells, burns, frightens and hurts creatures within 10 cells, then rekindles the blaze three times over nine seconds while the world's fire spreads on.

rows.name: Water
rows.promise: A rushing cascade of water sweeps out in an arc, soaks a village-square-sized patch, douses fire into steam and makes plants grow.
rows.does: Sweeps 36 lines of water and falling water orbs in an arc from the target, puts out burning cells with steam, floods a small pool, grows plants and calms nearby creatures over about 10 seconds.

rows.name: Life
rows.promise: A green ring spreads from the caster, sprouting grass and flowers and closing the wounds of injured creatures nearby.
rows.does: Draws a green circle and light, then expands rings that turn about half the dry cells to grass with a few flowers, calls w.grow, and heals 2 hp four times, but only on creatures under 10 hp.
rows.missing: Wounded creatures at 10 hp or more are never healed, so healing, half of the promise, skips the injured with larger health pools; the creature list is also read only once.
rows.fix: Heal every creature in w.here(w.x, w.y, R).wounded with c.heal(n) on each pulse, whatever its hp, re-reading the list each pulse, and keep the grass and flower ring as it is.

rows.name: Light
rows.promise: A warm gold glow that lights a clearing for about an hour, makes creatures of darkness flinch back and gently warms travelers and crops.
rows.does: Gold motes gather to the spot, then it raises an hour-long ward dome against fire, lava, floods, blasts, lightning, cold and all beasts and spirits, re-lit with w.light every 5 seconds and warmed by 6 degrees.
rows.missing: The light is there, but the item is mostly a full protective dome that blocks lava, fire and blasts, far beyond a cantrip light. It also pushes out every beast and spirit, deer and rabbits included, rather than only creatures of darkness.
rows.fix: Drop lib.lastingWard/w.ward and keep the gathering plus a lasting body that calls w.light every few seconds for the hour. Each tick, give only undead, hostile and night hunters near the glow's edge status('fear', 3, w.x, w.y), and keep the small w.temperature warmth.

rows.name: Meteor Strike
rows.promise: A blazing star-metal meteor falls on the spot, blasts a ~30-pace scorched crater, burns nearby trees to ash, hurls and dazes everything around, and leaves a long-lasting scar.
rows.does: A glowing meteor body streaks down from the sky. On impact it explodes and terraforms a crater about 16 to 36 cells wide. Creatures within twice the crater radius are hurt, pushed outward and stunned for 150 s. The ground is painted with a dark scar that decays to dirt after 900 s, with a star-metal

rows.name: Phoenix
rows.promise: A flame bird that circles low over ash, warms the air, then bursts into fire that scatters seeds so green shoots rise through the cinders.
rows.does: Spawns one glowing, fireproof flying bird that wanders anywhere, leaves flowers, casts grow every 15 s, heals every 25 s, breathes fire when hurt, and respawns as a phoenix when it dies.
rows.missing: It never seeks out ash and never bursts into fire and seeds over it. It gives off no warmth, and the healing is an extra the entry never promises.
rows.fix: Add a custom goal that seeks 'ash' with an act that bursts fire particles, w.paint grass and w.grow on the ash. Give it a mild heat aura or w.temperature warmth, and drop the heal ability.

rows.name: Arcane
rows.promise: A humming silver lattice spirals out from the caster and lights stone, water, plants and beasts from within for about a minute, then they fade back, leaving a faint glow and a tingle in nearby creatures.
rows.does: Draws a circle, drones and flashes, then sends two slow spiral arms of glowing shards that travel only a few cells. It paints faint concentric rings and a soft light for 60 s, tints creatures pale silver for good, calms them for 4 s, and ends with a burst of sparks.
rows.missing: Stone, water and plants are never lit, only a general area light. Creature tints never fade back. The 'lattice' is plain rings, and the shards barely leave the centre. The hum is a drone, not struck glass.
rows.fix: Use w.sound('crystal') and faster shards (speed about w.r per second) whose tick lays short-lived glowing particles or w.light on the cells they pass. Draw crossing spiral lines in w.draw instead of rings. After about 60 s, reset creature tints with c.tint back to normal or a fading tint, and add a

rows.name: Arcane Shield
rows.promise: A faint blue dome around the caster and those beside them that turns aside arrows, stones and blows for up to ten minutes.
rows.does: Raises a blue ward over a house-sized area for 600 seconds, with a blue magic circle, a soft light and a ring of glowing voxels; the test shows it stopped 91% of the harm.

rows.name: Divine Shield
rows.promise: A pale gold dome over everyone nearby that turns aside fire, floods, blasts and attackers for a long time, with a calming warmth inside.
rows.does: Draws a gold circle and light, then raises a pale gold ward of 0.9 w.r for 600 seconds against every harm, pushing beasts and spirits out; the test run shows it stopped fire, lava, blasts and most raiders.

rows.name: Extinction Event
rows.promise: A burning sky-stone falls trailing cinders and turns the land to glass and ash; the living are driven far off or put into a season-long sleep, and the scar stays barren for a generation.
rows.does: A large meteor with a cinder trail crashes at the target. It blasts a power-5 crater, paints glass ringed by ash, and sets fires over 1.1 r. Survivors in 0.6 r are put to sleep for 300 s and those beyond are feared and pushed away. The glass and ash then decay back to dirt over about an hour. The te
rows.missing: The entry promises the living are driven off or put to sleep, not killed. The explosion runs before the statuses, and the wide fires then burn the sleepers, so a player sees mass death instead of an exodus and a long sleep.
rows.fix: Apply sleep and fear/push before the impact. Cut w.explode to about power 2 inside the glass radius. Confine w.ignite and w.temperature(+300) to the glass core, or drop them, so sleepers in 0.6 r are not burned. Keep the glass and ash.

rows.name: Great Flood
rows.promise: A sea-green ripple, then a roaring wall of water surges across a wide area, sweeps creatures into a heap at its edge, soaks the land, drains after about 12 seconds and leaves mud.
rows.does: Flash, shockwave and circle, then an expanding ring of water (6 deep, thinning to 2) fills a disc of 1.3 w.r over 3 seconds. Creatures at the front are pushed outward and stunned, with foam spray. After 4 seconds of churning foam it drains the area and paints silt that turns back to grass, plus some

rows.name: Meteor
rows.promise: A blazing comet streaks down and bursts in a twenty-pace ring of fire and gale that knocks people flat, singes them, and leaves fading flames.
rows.does: A glowing meteor body falls from high across the sky. On landing it booms, shakes the ground and sends out a shockwave. It sets a ring of fire with ignites within about 10 cells and lays ash. Every creature in range is pushed outward and up, hurt, burned and frightened (test: 434 cells, 17 creatures

rows.name: Protection Spell
rows.promise: A faint silver ring sinks over a small target and shields those inside from blows, debris and sharp edges for an hour.
rows.does: Draws a silver circle and a glowing ring that sinks to the ground, then raises a ward of radius w.r that it renews for an hour; the test run shows it stopping fire, lava, blasts and most raider harm.

rows.name: Rebirth
rows.promise: An island-wide spiral of phoenix warmth that revives the recently dead and mends what was broken: blooms, branches, creatures.
rows.does: A glowing flame body spirals outward from the island's center for 16s. Within 9 to 10 cells of its path it revives and heals corpses, puts out fire, turns ash to grass, stumps to trees and rubble to houses, and grows plants.
rows.missing: On a large island the 4-turn spiral spaces its passes about R/4 apart (about 46 cells on 384), but each pass only reaches 9 to 10 cells, so much of a cosmic island's dead are never revived.
rows.fix: Scale the disc and corpse radius with R (e.g. R/8), or add turns so passes overlap. Finish with a sweep of w.corpses(cx, cy, R) that revives any the phoenix missed.

rows.name: Resurrection
rows.promise: Warm gold light sinks into the fallen, who rise alive with wounds closed and then sleep, unless dead over a week.
rows.does: Draws a gold circle and light, then for each corpse in reach (skipping those dead over a week) casts a gold beam from the sky, revives it, heals it and puts it to sleep for 60 s; a faint drone if none are found.

rows.name: Serpent
rows.promise: An olive, pale-bellied snake that slides through grass and reeds, strikes rabbits and small prey, and coils to rest at dusk.
rows.does: Spawns one olive serpent with a pale belly that hunts rabbits and birds by day. It digs every 30 s, freezes whoever hurts it, and sleeps on a heated cell at night. When it dies it spawns a new serpent.
rows.missing: Freezing its attackers is ice magic no grass snake has. Respawning itself on death makes it effectively unkillable. Neither fits a plain hunting snake.
rows.fix: Remove the 'freeze' ability (strike back with a plain bite, or use a custom act that hurts the attacker). Change onDeath from 'spawn:serpent' to nothing or a material. Optionally change the 'dig' ability to a custom act that moves it onto rock or grass to coil at dusk.

rows.name: Shadow
rows.promise: A small circle of pooled dusk that cools the grass, hushes birds and hides whoever stands in it for a minute, with drifting lengthened shadows.
rows.does: Hisses, dims the screen for 4 s, paints a dark ground disc that turns to bare dirt after 60 s, chills the spot by -20/-10, calms creatures inside for 60 s, sleeps only kind 'beast' nearby, and draws a dark disc with swaying spokes for 60 s.
rows.missing: Nothing is hidden: calm is not concealment, so hunters still see their prey. Birds are not hushed, because the 'beast' kind check misses deer and birds. The circle replaces the grass and leaves dirt instead of cooling it.
rows.fix: Drop the ground paint and draw the dusk with w.draw only. Hide those inside, for example with w.ward(w.x, w.y, w.r, {against: ['creatures'], seconds: 60, color: '#1a1426'}) or by calming every hunter in reach. Give status 'sleep' or 'calm' to every animal by w.nature(c) === 'animal' (birds especiall

rows.name: Sky Mage
rows.promise: A glowing, floating being of green and violet northern light in a frost hood that walks the air, reads the winds and guides travelers by night.
rows.does: Makes an ordinary villager with the mage calling (a pointed-hat wizard who walks, freezes foes and blinks away) and flares three green and violet beams, a burst and a light around it.
rows.missing: It is a plain walking human villager, not a flying, glowing creature of aurora light, and it never reads the weather, guides anyone or carries messages; the arrival is a flash and a chime.
rows.fix: Declare a spell.creatures 'sky mage' (base spirit, flying, glow, color #7dffb0, color2 #b28dff, features hood, glowing eyes, staff), give it a goal such as explore or a custom guide goal that leads villagers, and add an ability like cast:Rain or a weather-reading act; spawn it with w.spawn instead o

rows.name: Underworld
rows.promise: A mossy hollow under a crooked oak whose ground opens at dusk into a winding earth stair down into shadow, lit by pale fungus lanterns, where mages gather rare stones and roots.
rows.does: Sinks a 5-cell crater, paints spreading glowing shadow moss and grows a straight oak. It draws a dark pit with a spiral of descending posts and four glowing fungus lanterns, then scatters deepstone and silent roots. It hires two delvers who carry them home as gold and adds more at dusk.
rows.missing: Nobody ever descends and the ground never parts at dusk, so the promised move is absent. The oak is a plain straight oak, not crooked. The worship/prayer grant and night light are unpromised extras. It is tiny for a cosmic tier.
rows.fix: Add a dusk act that opens the pit and moves the delvers down and back: c.teleport into the hollow, hide them for a while, then return them carrying stones. Lean or twist the oak with a model trunk. Drop the worship use, the prayer grant and the night light effect. Widen the hollow and the spreading

rows.name: World Seed
rows.promise: A glowing green-gold seed wrapped in silver Yggdrasil roots that makes barren land bloom and, cracked open, grows one sheltering great tree; cosmic in scale.
rows.does: Places a small glowing orb on a stone pedestal, paints a 4-cell patch of spreading green ground, waters fields at dawn and grows plants every 45 s within about 14 cells; an oak appears only on full-moon nights.
rows.missing: The sapling-into-sheltering-tree, its central promise, waits for a full moon and never came in the test; the reach is a few cells for a cosmic item; the silver root parts (0.04 wide) are below 0.05 and are not drawn.
rows.fix: On placing, plant the sapling with w.tree(style "giant", height 30-40, grow 20) beside the seed, or let the tree effect fire at night every few minutes; widen the greening and grow radius well past 14 and let seedbloom spread faster over dirt, ash and rock; make the root and silver parts at least 0.

rows.name: Wormhole
rows.promise: A folded pit of starry dark under a slowly turning violet ring that tugs passers-by in and carries them a short way across the countryside in one step, humming like a bell.
rows.does: Sinks a basalt crater ringed with crystal and draws a starry pit under a glowing violet ring, with a smaller twin mouth about 30 cells away. Ring bodies hover over both mouths. Every 1.5 s it pulls creatures within 6 cells inward and teleports those within 2 to the far mouth with bursts and a zap, d

rows.name: Wormhole Network
rows.promise: Two moss-ringed earthen tunnel mouths in a meadow; whoever steps into one ring comes out of the other at once.
rows.does: Draws two identical tunnel-mouth models 20 cells apart with silver moss rings, then every second teleports any creature within 1.6 cells of a mouth to just past the other mouth, with a purple burst and a whoosh. It also lures villagers and beasts to the empty midpoint, grants prayer, and lights up a
rows.missing: The lure points at the midpoint, so creatures rarely walk into the rings. Prayer and night light are not promised. Both models face the same way. A single 20-cell pair with no camera is far too small for a cosmic place.
rows.fix: Lure creatures to the mouths by placing a small lure landmark at each ring instead of the midpoint. Drop the prayer grant and the light effect, or replace prayer with a 'tend' grant that recharges the link. Turn the second model with turn: Math.PI. Scale up to cosmic with several linked mouth pairs

rows.name: Adamantine Wall
rows.promise: A grey-silver stone slab veined with glowing star metal that keeps raiders and wild beasts from crossing into the village.
rows.does: Raises an 8-cell stone wall with a glowing star-metal line and cap, and plants a lasting artifact with a permanent ward over the village. The ward keeps out beasts, fire, lava, blasts and cold and lets villagers through; the test run prevented 94 to 98% of harm.

rows.name: Apocalypse
rows.promise: A ring of burning stars over the land rains molten glass for a long while; people and beasts flee, crops burn, streams boil, and the glassed soil afterward stays warm and fertile.
rows.does: Two embers spiral up and burst into a ring of 12 orbiting stars. For about 11 seconds they rain roughly 1000 glowing shards across the island, each leaving molten glass that hurts, heats, ignites and steams water. Creatures get fear, random patches heat by 150, and the glass cools into glowing warm

rows.name: Arcane Cataclysm
rows.promise: A violet spiralling sky-storm rakes a wide ring of land with arcane strikes that scatter foes and leave the ground glowing.
rows.does: Opens a violet vortex in the sky and spirals about 60 violet lightning strikes outward across the ring, scattering and frightening creatures. A final shockwave throws everyone back and stuns them, and the land is left patched with glowing mana scar that fades to grass after 15 minutes.

rows.name: Archangel
rows.promise: A towering, radiant six-winged golden warrior descends to guard a village and its fields, shielding people and crops from storm, blight and raiders while the sky is bright.
rows.does: A beam of light falls and a glowing, flying, crowned and armored golden angel with a sword appears. It guards by day, scares and attacks wolves, heals with an aura, shields and calls lightning when enemies come near, and holds a 15-minute ward over the village. In the test run it stopped all harm fr

rows.name: Astrologer
rows.promise: A tall silver-robed star-faced creature that hums, traces constellations, makes nearby lanterns flicker, and reads the weather and the best hours for planting.
rows.does: Flashes, chimes and sparkles, then makes one ordinary elder villager with the priest job titled Astrologer, with a soft light on it for 6 seconds.
rows.missing: It is a plain priest villager with no silver robe, no star-chart face and no constellation-tracing. Nothing reads weather or seasons or helps planting, and no lanterns flicker.
rows.fix: Declare a spell.creatures 'astrologer' (base spirit or two legs, tall, silver color, glowing star-chart features) with a custom goal that walks to fields at dusk and boosts them via w.grow or forecasts with a cast:Rain ability in drought. Give it a faint glow, use a hum or drone sound instead of chi

rows.name: Astronomer
rows.promise: A man-sized being of flesh and starfall, shedding silver light, that keeps a mage company, reads the sky, traces comets and warns of coming storms.
rows.does: Makes one ordinary villager of the nearest village, a mage titled Astronomer, with a puff of silver sparks and a glowing dust body that follows it and sheds silver motes for ten minutes.
rows.missing: It never reads the sky, traces a comet or warns of anything. It does not keep to a mage's side, and its starfall dust fades after ten minutes, leaving a plain villager.
rows.fix: Keep the dust for its life. Give the Astronomer a night job via spell.goals or its own ability that stops to gaze up, draws a faint w.beam or w.draw star-path overhead, and warns its village, for example by sending villagers indoors or toward a w.ward-free shelter before rain or fire, or by marking

rows.name: Aurora
rows.promise: Shimmering ribbons of color drawn down from the sky; people beneath wrapped in light and uplifted; the meadow glows in shifting hues for a long while.
rows.does: For 9 seconds it draws a line of rainbow beams rising from near the ground to about 60 voxels, waving across the valley. It then grows plants, bursts colored sparks and leaves an invisible healing-aura landmark.
rows.missing: The curtain stands on the ground rather than hanging in the sky, nobody is wrapped in a veil of light or steadied, and the meadow's lasting glow of shifting hues is absent: after the beams end, nothing visible remains.
rows.fix: Draw the ribbons high in the sky (z 40 to 70) with a light w.darken so they show. Give the creatures in reach a tint and the calm status. Leave a lasting glow on the meadow, such as a decaying glowing ground material painted over the grass, or repeated w.light pulses in shifting colors.

rows.name: Black Hole
rows.promise: A violet ring collapses into a hanging sphere of black that spirals debris and drags creatures toward it, then pops and leaves scorched ground smelling of rain.
rows.does: A shrinking violet ring collapses into a growing black orb over the target. For about 18 seconds, spiralling particles circle it, creatures within 1.5 w.r are pushed in a spiral toward it and swallowed near the centre (golems are pulled weakly), and trees and cover are torn up into shards that spira

rows.name: Bog Monster
rows.promise: A bear-sized sludge creature with glowing green eyes that slogs about, guards marshy ground and drags intruders into the mire.
rows.does: Places a static wooden sphere and an artifact that periodically turns ground to mud, spreads a moss, puffs steam and waters fields; no creature is ever spawned.
rows.missing: The monster never exists as a creature: it does not walk, has no glowing eyes, does not guard, and does not lure frogs or moths. Its 'do: "act"' is not a valid effect name, and a villager guard use is backwards.
rows.fix: Declare spell.creatures Bog Monster (base golem, body slime, color #1e1a12, color2 green glowing eyes, features glowing eyes, slow speed, behavior guard, prey hostile, leaves mud, goal guard, ability {do: "flood"}, scares or lures beast) and w.spawn it. Drop the wooden sphere and the artifact, or ke

rows.name: Book of the Dead
rows.promise: A cold black book whose silver script reveals the last words of the dead, briefly calling a departed memory back into a voice.
rows.does: Draws an open book on a lectern and spawns pale hooded spirit echoes that follow villagers with a calm aura. It fully revives one nearby corpse and lets villagers pray and worship at it.
rows.missing: Nothing reveals or voices the dead's last words. The revive pair raises a corpse to full life, more than a moment's memory. Prayer and worship are unasked-for extras. The 'calm' effect is not a valid do, so it is dropped. The echo spawned on placement is a night creature weak to light, so by day it
rows.fix: Replace the revive pair with a corpse pair whose act spawns a short-lived echo at the corpse, with a whisper sound and a light, and leaves the corpse dead. Drop the prayer grant, the worship use and the 'calm' effect. Spawn the echo only at dusk/night, or remove its light weakness.

rows.name: Cosmic Tempest
rows.promise: A silver column of starlight wind wanders the land for a minute, harmlessly flinging stones, dust and small creatures into glittering arcs, and leaves a faint silver glow beneath it.
rows.does: It draws a silver spiral that rises into a glowing vortex body. The vortex wanders within about 1.2 w.r for 60 seconds and swirls starlight particles. It kicks up dust or spray, pushes and levitates nearby creatures without hurting them, and hurls boulders and rubble as glittering shards that land a

rows.name: Crystal Golem
rows.promise: A walking violet-and-amber crystal golem that stands watch and shields nearby people and plants.
rows.does: Raises a lasting ward dome with periodic heal and night light from a static artifact, drawn as a few stacked stone boxes with glowing eyes; no creature is spawned.
rows.missing: The golem is never a creature: it is an immobile block statue that never moves, walks or guards. Its look is crude whole-cell boxes, with no geode shards and no humming joints.
rows.fix: Declare spell.creatures with a 'crystal golem' (base golem, body golem, color '#8a6cc8', color2 '#ffb347', behavior guard, goal guard, abilities [{do:'shield', when:'enemy near', every:20}]) and w.spawn it; keep the ward as its shield. Drop the w.box statue, or redraw any look with w.model shard par

rows.name: Divine Intervention
rows.promise: A gold spiral column lifts one person, creature or stone out of danger, sets it down somewhere safe, and keeps it unharmed and hidden for a day, leaving a scorched ring.
rows.does: Draws a spiralling gold beam column and a small ash ring. It lifts the nearest creature plus up to seven others standing in fire, water, heat or gas, flies each as a gold star to a safe cell 0.6 to 1.5 w.r away, and heals it there for two minutes. A healing landmark stays at each spot; with no creat
rows.missing: Nothing guards the rescued after landing. There is no ward, so blasts, lava and hunters still reach them, and only a two-minute heal follows them. Nothing hides them, so 'unharmed and unseen' is barely kept, and the test found almost no protection.
rows.fix: At each landing spot raise w.ward(d.x, d.y, 3, {seconds: 600, color: gold, keepOut: ['hostile','beast']}) within the first seconds. Make the Hidden Sanctuary landmark scare hunters (wolf, bear, hostile kinds) rather than villagers or beasts. Keep the lift to the one chosen target plus the few truly

rows.name: Doombringer
rows.promise: A cursed hourglass of smouldering red ash that brings doom: scorching heat and harm spreading from it, at legendary scale.
rows.does: It places a small hourglass on a plinth that burns enemies near the village, lights up at dusk, hands villagers arms and is worshipped. Every 90 s it paints a 2-cell patch of warm ash, and only on full moons does it call three red lightning strikes.
rows.missing: The doom mostly works as the village's guardian (burns enemies, light, arms, worship), which the name never promises. Its harm is tiny for legendary: 10 cells in five minutes. The sand stream, cap rims and pillars are thinner than 0.05 and are never drawn.
rows.fix: Drop the dusk light, the arms grant and the villager worship. Make the ash spread (spreads into grass/field, hurts, flammable) and turn its periodic act into a growing ring of w.ignite/w.temperature plus 300 that harms whatever is near, not only enemies. Let the doom-fire lightning fall more often a

rows.name: Earth
rows.promise: Rough stone pillars rise from the ground with a low hum, lift whoever stands there, and crumble back to dust after about a minute.
rows.does: With a drone and tremors, it raises 7 columns of 'earthen stone' (6 to 10 voxels tall) around the target and nudges nearby creatures upward. The stone material turns to dirt after 60 seconds.
rows.missing: The decay only changes the ground material. The raised land never sinks, so the pillars stay forever as dirt columns instead of crumbling away.
rows.fix: Record each pillar's cell and original height. Spawn a w.body with life 60 whose end lowers those cells back with w.raise (or w.terraform) and throws a dirt-colored w.burst and a 'grind' sound.

rows.name: Familiar
rows.promise: A small sleek silver creature with amber eyes that stays bound to a keeper, scouting ahead and keeping them company.
rows.does: Spawns a small glowing silver four-legged beast that follows villagers. It leaves flowers, heals every 25 s, blinks away when hurt and scares wolves, with an amber star floating above its head.
rows.missing: Its glowing eyes are pale silver (color2 #e8f0f8), not amber. It has unpromised healing, a flower trail and a hovering star in place of the scouting and companion role the entry describes.
rows.fix: Set color2 to amber (#ffbf40) for the eyes and drop the star body, the heal ability and leaves:'flowers'. Give it a custom goal that scouts ahead of its leader villager (seek anywhere near the village, then return), keeping behavior follow and teleport when hurt.

rows.name: Firestorm
rows.promise: A roaring fire vortex that tears across a valley-wide area for about ten seconds, burning grass to ash, lighting wood and driving creatures away, while sparing stone and water.
rows.does: After a spark circle, one vortex body (r 4) sweeps east from 1.4 w.r west of the target for 10 s. It ignites, ashes grass and burns voxels in a 2.5 to 3 cell swath and frightens creatures within 6 cells, under a light east wind.
rows.missing: The scorched track is only about 6 cells wide (4.7% of the area), thin for a grand spell. The +120 degree w.temperature each frame boils any water it crosses, though the entry says water is untouched.
rows.fix: Scale the swath with the tier: ignite, ash and burnVoxels over about w.r*0.3 and fear over w.r*0.5, and start the path nearer the target. Skip w.temperature on cells where w.cell(x,y).fluid is water, or heat only ground cells.

rows.name: Flight
rows.promise: A faint silver wind lifts the people it touches, who fly and move about freely for a while before drifting gently back down.
rows.does: It pushes up the creatures within a few cells and gives them 6s of levitate, with 12 silver swarm wisps spiralling up for 9s. An invisible body then re-levitates anyone standing near the cast spot every 2s for 600s.
rows.missing: The flight is pinned to a fixed patch of ground, not to the people the wind touched. Anyone who moves away drops within 4s, and strangers who wander in later are lifted. The 600s field is also likely why the test run never finished.
rows.fix: Save the creatures lifted at cast time in the body's data and re-apply status('levitate') to those same creatures wherever they are, not to w.creatures around the spot. Have the silver wisps seek and follow them, and cut the duration to well under 600s so the run can end.

rows.name: Frozen Tomb
rows.promise: A small glass cube that seals one creature or object inside, held unchanged in frost until released.
rows.does: Raises a chapel with a tiny glowing cube beside it, domes the whole village in an hour-long ward, chills its own cells now and then and freezes corpses that come within 2 cells.
rows.missing: Nothing is ever sealed: no single creature is caught and held in stasis. A village-wide dome is a different protection from the one the entry describes, and do: "act" is not a valid do name, so the chill effects may be dropped.
rows.fix: Remove the chapel and the lastingWard. Place the cube on a plinth as a small artifact whose act picks one nearby creature (the nearest wounded or endangered), stops it with status freeze for a long time, holds it in a small w.ward(x, y, 1.5) and tints it ice-blue, then releases it later (dawn or on

rows.name: Grand Finale
rows.promise: A thunderous firework bloom of gold and crimson that knocks people down, dusts them with glitter that fades, scorches nothing and drifts down as ash.
rows.does: Draws a gold and crimson spiral of sparks, then booms, shakes and sends a shockwave with rings of gold and crimson bursts and light smoke. Creatures within 6 cells are pushed up and stunned and tinted gold, nearby animals flee, and grey ash particles drift down. Nothing burns.

rows.name: Healing Rain
rows.promise: A soft blue cloud rains warm glimmering drops for about a minute, healing every creature beneath it, reviving wilting plants, and leaving the grass greener afterwards.
rows.does: Raises a drifting glowing blue cloud over the target that rains particles for 60 seconds. Every second it heals each living creature within reach by 8 and douses any burning cells. Every 5 seconds it grows plants. When it ends it greens the grass in a disc, and that grass fades back to normal after

rows.name: Hellfire
rows.promise: A dark crimson wave of shadow flame rolls outward, burns everything it touches, chills and frightens creatures, and leaves blackened earth for a day.
rows.does: After a crimson flash and a dimming of the light, it expands rings of fire outward to about 1.1 w.r. The rings lay a near-black soot ground that decays after a day, with crimson shockwaves and dark and red rising sparks. Creatures in reach get burn, freeze and fear, then fires are ignited across the

rows.name: Hot Spring
rows.promise: A steaming turquoise pool ringed by pale stones that heals those who bathe in it and spreads moss and flowers around it.
rows.does: Raises the engine's hot spring wonder with a small model of a glowing pool and pale stones, scatters grass and flowers once, then calls w.artifact for a 'Hot Spring' that is never declared, so nothing heals or spreads afterwards (the test run shows it idle).
rows.missing: No healing ever happens, and no moss keeps spreading: spell.artifacts is missing, so the artifact is empty and the place only stands there.
rows.fix: Declare spell.artifacts [{name: 'Hot Spring', radius: 4, effects: [{when: 'every', every: 20, do: 'heal', radius: 4}], grants: [{what: 'heal'}]}] and add a 'spring moss' ground material with spreads {into: ['grass','dirt'], rate: 0.03} painted around the rim instead of the one-off grass and flowers.

rows.name: Human
rows.promise: One human appears: an upright villager who joins a village, works, builds and lives among its kind.
rows.does: After a small flash and circle it makes one of the island's own villagers (a builder) with w.person, who walks to a village, keeps a household and works; in the test run it lived and acted.

rows.name: Levitate
rows.promise: Whatever is at the spot (creatures, stones, crates) drifts up about a man's height and floats for minutes, with dust swirling in a ring around it.
rows.does: Pushes creatures within about 4 cells up and keeps refreshing levitate on anyone in that spot for 4 minutes, while pale glowing dust spirals upward in a ring there.
rows.missing: Only creatures float, so a cast on an empty spot or on a boulder lifts nothing and shows only the dust ring; the field also lifts whoever wanders in rather than holding one target.
rows.fix: When w.creatures finds no one, read w.cell for a boulder or other cover, w.clear it and redraw it as a few 'float' voxels about 2 up that bob for the body's life, then set them back down in end; otherwise lift the nearest creature and keep refreshing levitate on it only.

rows.name: Ley Line
rows.promise: A long glowing seam of green-veined stone that hums with mana, draws mages to attune along its ridge and makes the grass beside it grow thick and bright, then fades to soil after a day.
rows.does: Lays a 16-cell seam: a raised ridge of glowing ley stone flanked by bright ley grass, drawn with glowing veins and end pillars. A drone sounds and a green mana orb runs along the ridge every 18 s, greening grass where it ends. It grows the land every 45 s and hires two attuners who walk to the stone

rows.name: Meteor Swarm
rows.promise: A rush of blazing cart-sized stones crashes down across a valley, each striking in fire and dust, knocking people down within ten paces, with fires burning about a minute and lasting craters.
rows.does: After a golden circle and shockwave, 28 spark-trailing meteors fall in a spiral over about 0.6 w.r. Each impact explodes, ignites, digs a small crater, paints glowing cinder that turns to ash after 60s, hurts creatures within 3 cells and pushes and frightens everyone within 10.

rows.name: Meteorite
rows.promise: A warm, half-buried black-iron star in a scorched crater that now and then rains starfire on a nearby field, downing flying things and glazing the ground for a day.
rows.does: It digs a crater and lays basalt around a tiny 7-box rock with a glowing tip. Every 40 s it sets the land within 7 cells alight at 0.5 chance, bursts sparks, deals 5 damage to spirits and birds, and paints permanent basalt. The test run saw it act only once in five minutes.
rows.missing: The 'glassy for a day' ground is permanent basalt, not glass that fades. The starfire is a plain wildfire that spreads into fields and houses rather than sparks over a field. Flyers take 5 damage and are not brought down. Nothing keeps the stone warm, and it rarely fires.
rows.fix: Declare a glowing 'star glass' ground material with decays ~600 and becomes 'dirt'. Paint it on the nearest field (w.nearest('field')) instead of basalt. Swap w.ignite for a few w.fire sparks of low intensity. Kill or heavily hurt birds and spirits with z>1 and push them down. Add a small w.heat at

rows.name: Miracle
rows.promise: A column of gold light falls on a chosen spot, heals the wounded fully and greens the damaged land, which stays fertile for a season.
rows.does: A widening gold beam pours down. Corpses near the center are revived, and a ripple out to 1.4 r heals and calms every creature. It puts out fire, clears poison, acid, rubble and stumps, and turns ash, dirt and grass into glowing blessed soil that spreads, sprouts flowers and decays back to grass aft

rows.name: Philosopher's Stone
rows.promise: A slowly turning violet crystal sphere with a black singularity inside that draws raw magic from the air and steadies spells cast through it so they last far longer.
rows.does: Draws a stone plinth under a violet voxel sphere with a black center and a spiral vortex of particles, rings it with glowing gold, turns nearby rock and rubble to gold every 20 s, sends gold to the village at dawn, heals the hurt, and revives corpses.
rows.missing: The entry's purpose, gathering magic from the air and making spells cast through it last longer, never happens. It is replaced by generic alchemy, healing, resurrection and worship that the entry never mentions.
rows.fix: Add an act effect that pulls glowing particles inward from all sides to the stone. On a timer, it should re-cast a library spell or renew nearby artifacts' and wards' durations within its radius, so magic visibly holds longer. Drop the heal, revive and prayer extras, or keep only the gold as the nam

rows.name: Sandstorm
rows.promise: A whirling column of grit and gusts churns over a village-sized field for a minute, pelting, blinding and knocking down creatures and stripping crops and thatch bare.
rows.does: After a sand tint and circle, one 4-cell vortex body wanders within about R for 60 s. Every half second it clears crops, flowers and bushes in a 3-cell disc, turns fields to sand and paints sand. It swirls, stuns and frightens creatures within 6 cells, then leaves a low dune at the center.
rows.missing: Thatch is never touched (houses are not harmed). There is no wind and no airborne sand over the field, only a 3-cell bite, which is small for grand. The cast's yield 60 is far over the 12 s limit, and the test run never finished.
rows.fix: Add w.wind in the storm's heading plus a stream of sand w.particle or w.burst around the vortex, widen the stripping disc to about w.r*0.3, and turn houses under the core to rubble with w.set(x,y,'rubble') at low chance. Replace the final yield 60 with about 11 and let the 60 s body carry on by itse

rows.name: Shadow Step
rows.promise: The caster melts into shadow and reappears up to thirty paces away in another shadow, with a gust of cold wind.
rows.does: Leaves a dark cloud body that streaks about 0.6 s to the nearest tree, house, bush or boulder. It also chills the start spot, paints it permanently with rock, puffs smoke and scares nearby creatures at both ends, with a hiss, whoosh and chime.
rows.missing: Nobody moves: no villager or creature is teleported, so the step is only a passing shadow effect. The permanent rock patch at the start spot is an unwanted scar.
rows.fix: Take the creature or villager nearest (w.x, w.y) with w.creatures and c.teleport() it into the cell beside the shadowing cover just after the streak lands, with a w.wind gust there. Drop w.paint 'rock' and the chime; keep the chill and the dark streak.

rows.name: Supermassive Black Hole
rows.promise: A huge dark silver-rimmed hollow, about a hundred paces across, that slowly draws loose stones, leaves and winds to its still center and pulls buried metal up.
rows.does: Digs a crater 24 cells across of dark ground with a silver rim and a black-orb model. Every 3 s it nudges creatures inward and moves loose cover one cell toward the center, and it clears gas inside. Every 25 s it raises a patch of glowing star iron that villagers haul home.
rows.missing: It is far too small for a cosmic tier and for the hundred-pace hollow in the entry, and wild winds are never trapped: gas is only deleted and the wind is never bent toward it. Its placement also wipes out nearby houses.
rows.fix: Raise R to about 35 to 40 and widen the pull loops to match. Add a periodic w.wind toward the center with swirling dust bodies spiralling in instead of only clearing gas. Spare houses outside the inner crater instead of clearing all cover in the disc.

rows.name: Supernova
rows.promise: A small white star blooms overhead and bursts in a blinding island-wide ring that scorches grass to ash, breaks fragile things, and knocks everyone back amid golden sparks that last about half a minute.
rows.does: A star body grows for 3s, collapses, then a flash, boom and shake. A shockwave ring sweeps the whole island, turning grass to ash, some houses to rubble and clearing bushes and crops. Every creature is pushed outward, stunned, frightened and hurt, while glowing gold particles linger 20 to 30s and th

rows.name: Tree of Life
rows.promise: A small glade of green turf around a cottage-sized silver tree with glowing gold leaves, where the wounded are mended, withered fields restored and seeds gathered.
rows.does: It lays a disc of spreading soft turf with flowers and a 6-voxel silver-trunked oak with glowing gold leaves, ringed by stones, and heals creatures on arrival. It keeps a healing aura and grants healing and food, waters fields at dawn and grows plants every 40 s. It regrows ash, dirt, stumps and rub

rows.name: Village
rows.promise: A village of timber houses round a well and a green, with a bell hung from a crooked oak, whose many people go about their daily work.
rows.does: Lays out a real seven-house village with its own plaza, well, fields and villagers, adds an oak with a bell model in its branches and a stone well beside it, and leaves an artifact that feeds the village, waters it in drought or fire and lights it at dusk.

rows.name: Villager
rows.promise: A slow crowd of villagers moving as one being that tends fields, mends lanes and keeps watch near its homes, murmuring in many voices.
rows.does: With a chime and small sparks, makes three ordinary adult farmers of the nearest village who go about farming on their own.
rows.missing: Nothing makes the three move or act as one crowd, none keeps watch or mends roads, and the chime is not a murmur of voices.
rows.fix: Open with w.sound('whisper') instead of chime, give the three farmer, guard and builder jobs, and add a custom goal or w.hire job that keeps them walking the lanes together near their homes.

rows.name: Volcano
rows.promise: A black cone with a glowing crater that puffs smoke, spits glowing rocks and sends slow lava rivers over nearby ground for a day, then cools to a warm mound.
rows.does: Rumbles and jolts, then raises an engine volcano with a lava vent and one puff of smoke. Its lava burns nearby houses. The repeating smoke-and-rocks effect is written as a function in `do`, so the engine drops it.
rows.missing: The ongoing smoke puffs and glowing rock bombs never happen (the test run shows 0 bodies), and nothing ever settles it into a quiet warm mound.
rows.fix: Rename the effect's `do(self, w)` to `act(self, w, target)` so the smoke and meteor bombs repeat every few seconds, and add a fuel/decay limit or a later step that stops the vent and leaves warm basalt.

rows.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
rows.promise: A small drifting blue-white flame spirit that hovers over marsh at dusk and lights and leads travelers like a wandering lamp.
rows.does: Spawns two glowing, flying blue-white spirits with a lantern that wander and explore by night, lure villagers after them, scare wolves, shed light every 15 seconds at night and blink away when hurt.

rows.name: Wizard
rows.promise: A robed mage with silver-lit hands who walks among towns, mends broken things with a word and conjures small blue flames to guide travelers at night.
rows.does: Makes one villager titled Wizard with a blue flash, chime and burst, then places a fixed Wizard artifact on that spot whose two effects are written as do: function(...) instead of act.
rows.missing: The engine drops effects whose do is not a known name, so the blue night flames and the rubble mending never run; even if they did, they stay at the drop spot while the wizard walks away, and his promised heal does nothing.
rows.fix: Rename both effects' do: function to act(self, w) (e.g. {when:'night', every:25, act(self,w){...}}), make mending rebuild a house where rubble lay (w.building) instead of just clearing it, and add {when:'every', every:30, do:'heal'} for the heal promise.

rows.name: Yggdrasil
rows.promise: A cosmic world tree whose serpent-like ash-gray roots pump sap into barren soil, draw water from the sky and raise whole forests by dawn.
rows.does: Raises the engine's world tree wonder with a ring of gray root models and glowing sap. Every 45 s it greens up to 3 cells and grows a tree on about half of them. It also grows at dawn within 14 cells, waters fields in drought and summons root sprites on full moons. The test run changed only 83 cells
rows.missing: Far too small for cosmic: a handful of trees every 45 s within 16 cells is not new forests across the land. The sap only spreads into rare dirt, ash, sand and basalt, so it barely moves. Nothing draws from the sky: there is no rain or weather, only drought watering.
rows.fix: Spread it to legendary or cosmic reach. Make the dawn effect grow at radius 40 or more and plant w.tree clusters far out each dawn. Let living sap spread into grass and dirt at a higher rate. Add a drought effect of cast:Rain so the roots visibly drink from the sky. Put a w.camera on the arrival.

rows.name: Abyss
rows.promise: A still, black pool in a hollow that swallows light, with cool, heavy shadows along its banks.
rows.does: Digs a spring-fed pond, fills it with black, non-flowing abyss water and rings it with rock, ash, a dark stone rim and dead trees. The artifact keeps chilling the banks and putting out fires. It lures beasts, frightens villagers and raises shade eels on full moons.

rows.name: Acid Breath
rows.promise: A green corrosive mist exhaled in a short cone that burns creatures, eats armor and cover, and lingers on stone and grass for about a minute before fading.
rows.does: Sends puffs of poison gas and green sparks along a cone west of the target, paints a glowing 'acid sheen', deletes some trees, houses and crops outright, and hurts creatures in the cone by 3 with the burn status and fear.
rows.missing: The burn status sets victims alight, which is fire rather than acid. The lingering sheen hurts nothing. It also turns grass and stone into dirt for good instead of fading, and houses simply vanish rather than corrode.
rows.fix: Lay real acid along the cone with w.flood(px, py, small r, 'acid', shallow) or give 'acid sheen' hurts: true, plus decays back to its original ground. Replace status('burn') with repeated c.hurt over a few seconds and a green tint, and let the acid eat the cover instead of using w.clear.

rows.name: Aegis
rows.promise: A rune-worked silver shield disc that wards those near it from falling stones, blades and stray spells, its glow fading as the protection is spent.
rows.does: Raises a stone plinth with a glowing silver-and-gold rune disc and places the Aegis artifact. It keeps a ward over the area for an hour that stops fire, lava, blasts and raiders, and adds shield, heal and night-light effects; the test run blocked 85 to 97% of the harm.

rows.name: Air
rows.promise: A breath of wind that gusts around the spot, lifts leaves and dust, pushes small creatures, briefly carries a person aloft, then fades to calm after about thirty seconds.
rows.does: Pale particles spiral around the caster, then a whoosh and a shockwave. A burst of leaf and dust bits flies out and the wind is set. A nearby villager levitates for 4 seconds, and for 30 seconds a hidden body shifts the wind, pushes creatures outward (birds upward) and drifts leaf particles before r

rows.name: Akashic Records
rows.promise: A midnight-blue book whose pages breathe drifting silver script that reveals the history of things and glimpses other realities.
rows.does: Places a lectern with a blue book and a chime. It has prayer, heal and worship grants, daytime grow, revival of the dead, a full-moon spirit, and a dusk sprinkle of particles that restores some rubble, stumps and ash. In the test run only grow fired.
rows.missing: Nothing is ever revealed. The hanging silver script lines (0.02 thick), the page tops and the ribbon are under 0.05 and are not drawn. Heal, prayer and grow are generic extras the name does not promise.
rows.fix: Make the script and page parts at least 0.05 thick and keep them hanging and glowing. Add an act effect that reveals the past: at dusk draw ghostly outlines (w.draw or faint glow particles) of lost houses and trees over the rubble and stumps it then restores, and mark the dead it revives. Drop grow,

rows.name: Ambrosia
rows.promise: A swirling honey-gold vial whose drops rest and heal the weary and bring wilting plants back to green life.
rows.does: Places a vial of glowing gold on a stone plinth that heals creatures nearby every 25 seconds and when hurt, lets villagers come for healing, regrows the land at dawn, waters it in drought and regrows stumps nearby.

rows.name: Apotheosis
rows.promise: A gold ring blooms; everyone inside is healed, empowered and given a winged shadow for a day, while the ring's grass greens and then withers at dusk.
rows.does: Draws a 6 s spiral of gold beams over a gold circle, then paints glowing grass. Creatures inside are healed by 5, enlarged 1.2x and tinted gold. A long-lived body heals blessed ones by 1 a second while they stay in the ring, draws plain dark ellipses under them, and paints the ring to dirt on a time
rows.missing: The shadow is a blob, not a winged figure. There is no real strength gain (no hp or power boost), and the heal is small and only works inside the ring. 'Withers at dusk' turns the ground to permanent dirt on an arbitrary timer instead of letting the grass fade back, and the 16-minute body kept the t
rows.fix: Heal the blessed fully with c.heal(c.hp*2 or so) and raise their strength, e.g. transform or a lasting heal/regen tied to c.data rather than the ring. Draw the shadow with w.draw as a wing-spread silhouette (two swept triangles plus a body). On w.darken/dusk let the radiant grass decay back to grass

rows.name: Ark
rows.promise: A hand-sized silver starship whose shimmering shell shields a single bearer from blows and storms, thinning in long fights.
rows.does: Sets a silver ship on a stone pedestal, raises a 90-second ward of full legendary reach over the area, then shields on enemy or fire from 5 recharging charges, heals the hurt, lights at dawn and is prayed to and worshipped.
rows.missing: It domes a whole village area instead of shielding one bearer. It adds healing, dawn light, prayer and worship the entry never promises. Many hull and rim parts are thinner than 0.05 and fall off the eighth grid, so the ship shape and its blue rim are partly lost.
rows.fix: Shrink the ward and artifact radius to a few cells around the Ark, so it shelters one traveler or the nearest villager. Remove the heal effect, the dawn light, the heal and prayer grants and the worship use, keeping the shield effects with charges. Resize the model's parts to at least 0.125 on eight

rows.name: Armageddon
rows.promise: A crimson rift tears open the sky and a long rain of burning meteors scorches the whole island to glass and fire, shattering towers and driving every creature to flight, under a red sky with smoking scars left behind.
rows.does: Shows a red circle and drone at the caster, a beam up to a glowing vortex rift over the island's center, and a red tint. For about 18 seconds, roughly a hundred meteors pour from the rift across the whole island: they explode, burn voxels, ignite fires, fuse sand and fields into glass, leave glowing

rows.name: Ash Cloud
rows.promise: A rolling bank of grey grit about thirty paces wide that blinds and chokes those inside for a minute, dusts crops pale, lingers three minutes and leaves the ground powdered.
rows.does: Three grey cloud bodies roll across the area, laying ash and smoke and stunning and greying every creature they pass for 60 s, then a three-minute haze keeps puffing smoke and the centre is powdered with ash.

rows.name: Assassin
rows.promise: A shadowy cloaked figure that steps out of the dark to guard a place or follow a traveler, then fades away when done.
rows.does: Adds an ordinary villager with the guard job titled 'Assassin', plants a small dagger model beside it, and raises an almost invisible ward dome that lasts an hour.
rows.missing: Nothing looks like living shadow: it is a normal villager in village dress. It never shadows a traveler, never moves unseen, never fades back into the dark, and an hour-long dome does the guarding in its place.
rows.fix: Declare a spell.creatures 'assassin' (base spirit or two legs, near-black color, hood, glowing eyes, dagger or sword) with goal guard or behavior follow (leader villager) and prey hostile, plus a lifespan so it fades when done. Spawn it from a shadowy burst, and drop or greatly shorten the lastingWa

rows.name: Astronaut
rows.promise: A silver-suited spacefarer who drifts slowly on a tether of light and surveys distant lands, bringing word back.
rows.does: Flashes, chimes, makes an ordinary villager titled Astronaut with the guard job, and shows a vertical light beam for 4 seconds and a short light; the villager then patrols like any guard.
rows.missing: It looks like any villager (no silver-white suit or visor). It never drifts or floats, and the tether vanishes after 4 seconds. Nothing is surveyed or revealed; it only does a guard's rounds.
rows.fix: Keep w.person, but give the arrival a slow descent: a body (look orb, silver) falling from z 40 to its spot with a lasting thin w.beam tether. Add a short survey on arrival: a few w.beam sweeps or w.light marks over nearby villages, water and hostile creatures found with w.nearest, so it reveals the

rows.name: Aurora Borealis
rows.promise: Rippling green and violet ribbons of light across the night sky over a region, calming everyone beneath and quickening crops and grasses until dawn.
rows.does: Dims the sky for 8 s and sends ten glowing green and violet orbs with trails drifting outward at height 70. They bob for a minute while an invisible body calms every creature in reach, calls w.grow at 0.02 density and casts shifting colored ground lights for 2 minutes.
rows.missing: The aurora reads as ten floating orbs, not curtains or ribbons. The night lasts only 8 s and the calm and growth only 2 minutes, not a night. w.grow adds sparse vegetation but does not brighten or speed up crops.
rows.fix: Draw the curtains as wavy vertical sheets of glow particles or w.beam rays along several lines at z 60–80, rippling over time. Hold w.darken over the whole cast and keep the calm and lights going through the night, or use a lasting landmark with aura calm. Brighten the fields with a short-lived glow

rows.name: Balrog
rows.promise: A tall horned demon of flame and smoke, summoned from deep stone, that guards its place and drives off intruders, its heat wilting plants around it.
rows.does: Opens a smoking crack of cinder stone and spawns one glowing, horned, winged, fireproof balrog. It roams up to 40 cells to rock, turning cells to smouldering cinder, hunts wolves, deer, boar and bears, and fire-whips anything near, setting a line alight. It scares villagers and beasts.
rows.missing: It never guards anything: it is a roaming hunter of wildlife, not a warden that holds its ground against intruders. It has no heat aura, so plants near it never wilt; only the cells it steps on change.
rows.fix: Set behavior "guard" and goal "guard" (or keep delve but with a small near) so it holds the spot where it was summoned and whips only what comes close. Add aura "burn" with auraRadius 2 to 3 and a low auraPower so nearby grass, bushes and trees wilt and catch.

rows.name: Big Bang
rows.promise: A blinding white flash, then a rolling shockwave of light and heat that flings and stuns creatures and leaves ground glowing cherry-red that cools to scorched black, with a ringing after.
rows.does: Gathers converging starlight into a shrinking star, then flashes white with a boom and shake. A ring sweeps the whole island, pushing every creature outward and stunning it for 10s, and hurts those near the heart. It paints the core cherry-red glowing ground that turns into black scorch after 5s, he

rows.name: Bird
rows.promise: A slender winged human-faced messenger of air that flies swiftly across the valley carrying letters and tokens between people.
rows.does: Spawns one pale flying bird-bodied creature that wanders and explores, leaves flowers where it walks, casts grow, teleports when hurt and scares wolves and bears.
rows.missing: It looks like an ordinary bird, not a human figure with wing-arms; it never carries anything between villages. The flowers, grow and the scaring of wolves and bears have nothing to do with a messenger, and its name 'bird' collides with the island's wild bird.
rows.fix: Rename the kind (e.g. 'birdfolk'). Use body 'two legs' with features ['wings','hood'], flying: true. Add a spell.goals entry that seeks village, carries gold or loot from one village to the next (like 'gather'), and give it that goal. Drop leaves: 'flowers', the grow ability and scares: ['wolf','bea

rows.name: Black Dragon
rows.promise: A great black dragon that guards a stronghold for whoever bonds it, breathes cold smoke that dims light, and leaves clinging shadows where it lands.
rows.does: Spawns one flying, fireproof black dragon that guards and hunts deer, boar and wolves, freezes enemies, puffs smoke and cold around itself every 25 s and leaves fading shadow ground. Cast also raises a 15-minute clear ward dome over the whole legendary reach.
rows.missing: The village is kept safe by a dome the summoning raises, not by the dragon. The guide says a creature that domes the village stops being itself. Its breath is a plain freeze, not cold smoke aimed at foes that dims lights.
rows.fix: Drop lib.lastingWard and let the dragon's guard goal and behavior do the protecting, perhaps with prey including hostile raiders. Turn the 'enemy near' ability into a cold-smoke breath of your own: w.gas smoke and w.temperature -30 in a cone toward the target, plus a freeze status.

rows.name: Black Flame
rows.promise: A hovering banner of smoke-colored fire, a cart wide, burning for a minute and staining the ground and creatures it touches grey and quiet, without harming them.
rows.does: A dark swaying flame body hangs about 2.5 voxels up for 60 seconds. Every second it paints a small disc of grey 'ashen stain' ground that returns to grass after 10 minutes. Creatures it touches are tinted grey and kept calm for 10 minutes, and none are hurt.

rows.name: Black Ice
rows.promise: A patch of dark, glassy ice-ground that never melts and chills nearby fields and water into frozen stillness.
rows.does: Raises a low glacier and paints it with a custom dark 'black ice' ground that holds its cells near -40 degrees. It drops the temperature over the area, so nearby water freezes and the cold lasts.

rows.name: Blast Wave
rows.promise: A pale orange ring of force rolls out about twenty paces, shoving everyone away from the caster unhurt, knocking them down and scattering dust and leaves.
rows.does: Expands a pale orange shockwave ring to about 20 cells over 0.8 s with dust, leaf and pebble bursts along its front, and pushes each creature it reaches outward and up, stunning it for 1.5 s without damage; it ends in about 4 s.

rows.name: Blizzard
rows.promise: A minute-long storm of stinging white flakes over a wide circle that chills and slows creatures and plants and freezes streams to ice.
rows.does: Sets a wind, drops the temperature by 60 over 1.4 w.r so water freezes, then for 60 seconds drifts snowflake particles on the wind, freezes every creature in reach each second, and every 3 seconds chills the area again and lays snow.

rows.name: Bog Spirit
rows.promise: A slow, dripping, seal-grey marsh spirit that guides travelers through fens, soaks up standing floodwater and releases it slowly where dry land needs it.
rows.does: Spawns a glowing grey-green slime spirit that wanders and tends, heals nearby creatures every 20 s, lures villagers, scares wolves, and every 25 s clears all water within 3 cells.
rows.missing: It never releases the water it drinks onto dry fields. It drains any water, lakes and river included, rather than standing floodwater only. The healing aura is not in the entry.
rows.fix: Keep a count of the water it drinks in self.data. Add an ability that, when it is near dry field or crop cells, sets shallow water there with w.set(x, y, 'water', small), or use an artifact-style 'water' act. Limit drinking to shallow water (depth < 1) away from rivers and lakes. Replace heal with t

rows.name: Brick
rows.promise: A sturdy rust-red block of fired clay that villagers build with, holding heat and resisting weather.
rows.does: Paints a small patch of fired-brick ground and stacks 18 rust-red stone voxels at the spot; over time it bakes nearby mud into fireproof, waterproof, acid-proof brick ground, lays more brick around itself, lures villagers and grants gold.

rows.name: Camelot
rows.promise: A white stone fortress-hall with silver towers, Excalibur hung above it and a healing Grail, protecting and healing the realm around it.
rows.does: Raises white walls, a gate arch, four towers and a tall central keep with silver roofs, hangs a sword of magic voxels over the keep and sets a glowing golden cup in the court. It also places a 600-second ward and an artifact that heals the hurt, re-shields against enemies, revives the dead, summons

rows.name: Cataclysm
rows.promise: The ground splits in a ragged ring of fissures around the caster, throwing every building, tree and creature within about a hundred paces off its footing; the fissures last a day and a second cast in the same spot is twice as strong.
rows.does: Cuts a noisy ring of sunken 'fissure' ground with radial cracks, which reverts to dirt after 900 s. It turns about half the houses to rubble and many trees to stumps or boulders, then quakes eight times, throwing, stunning, scaring and hurting every creature in 1.3 r. On fissures that are still open

rows.name: Celestial Bastion
rows.promise: A squat pale-stone fortress with a lasting golden halo that shields a settlement from blade, flame and storm, drives off night creatures and heals those inside.
rows.does: Raises a village-style watchtower with a tiny 1.4-cell pale keep model beside it, crowned by a ring of glowing gold. It casts an hour-long ward, heals around it every 8 s, gives light at night and grants heal, arms and prayer.
rows.missing: The legendary fortress is a house-sized toy beside an ordinary watchtower, not a bastion among the houses. The protection ends after an hour, though the entry promises walls and a halo that never fade. Prayer and arms grants are extras the entry never mentions.
rows.fix: Draw the bastion as the main structure: a wide squat pale-stone keep, several cells across, with walls, corner towers, a gate and the halo over its battlements (w.model plus w.wall/w.tower in pale stone), instead of a small model beside a watchtower. Keep the ward renewing indefinitely, e.g. an arti

rows.name: Celestial Choir
rows.promise: A hovering aurora of green and violet light with winged beings inside it who sing, steadying wards, calming storms, quieting spirits and guiding travelers.
rows.does: Raises a permanent ward, static rings of green and violet magic voxels with a white core high above the spot, pulsing lights and particles, and four calm-aura seraphs that follow villagers; an artifact lights the night, heals, shields and rains on fire.
rows.missing: The choir never sings: one chime and one drone, no choir sound. The seraphs leave the light to trail villagers instead of moving through it, the ribbons never coil, and nothing calms a storm.
rows.fix: Play w.sound("choir") at arrival and repeat it from the body's tick with each pulse. Give the seraphs behavior guard or wander, or make them bodies circling inside the rings at z 22 to 30. Slowly re-voxel or rotate the ribbons. Add a weather act that calms storms, for example clearing wind with w.wi

rows.name: Clay
rows.promise: A small shallow pale bowl of clay ground that settlers dig for pots and bricks, where a wheel turns by itself and pressed stones come out fired.
rows.does: Sinks a radius-4 bowl and paints it with pale clay that hardens to rock in fire, turns to mud in water and creeps into nearby dirt, then sets a static three-box wheel model in it. Its recurring repaint effect is written as do(...) instead of act and is dropped.
rows.missing: Settlers never dig or take the clay, so it has no tie to the villages; the wheel never turns; the only ongoing effect is malformed and does nothing.
rows.fix: Give the clay material lures: ['villager'] and taken: true (or add an artifact grant) so settlers carry it home. Move the repaint into act(self, w, target) with a valid when. Optionally add a slow every-few-seconds turn or a particle on the wheel.

rows.name: Clay Golem
rows.promise: A man-high, orange fired-clay golem with glowing runes that hauls building material, shores up broken walls and digs foundations for builders.
rows.does: Spawns one clay-orange golem with glowing eyes and a hammer. It seeks rubble, clears it, firms the ground to rock and carries stone to the village stores. It also digs now and then; the test run logged 13 deeds in two minutes.

rows.name: Cloud
rows.promise: A small white vapor cloud hanging at chest height that gives off mist to dampen parched fields.
rows.does: Draws a floating white cloud (float voxel spheres plus a chest-height model), waters fields within 4 cells every 40 s and in droughts, puffs steam every 15 s, and lets villagers fetch water from it.

rows.name: Cloud Fountain
rows.promise: A raised, misty spot with a warm geyser whose spray falls as slow rain over nearby hills, keeping grass green and offering water.
rows.does: Raises a geysers wonder on a lifted hill, releases steam, greens the grass and places an artifact that rains every 15 s, grows plants every 40 s and grants water; it also floats a small island with a box and a willow overhead.

rows.name: Cloud Giant
rows.promise: A towering, slow giant of pale vapor and sparking steam that guards pastures, leaves mist where it walks, cools the air and drives off storms.
rows.does: Raises an hour-long ward dome, then spawns one pale golem-bodied spirit that guards its spot, scares and attacks wolves, bears and boars, heals those nearby, and freezes enemies.
rows.missing: Nothing shows vapor or steam: no mist trail, no steam or sparks, no cooling of the air, nothing against storms, and a radius-1.3 golem is hardly towering. The heal aura and grow ability are not promised.
rows.fix: Give it leaves: a short-lived pale mist material (decays to grass), and an ability act that calls w.temperature(self.x, self.y, 4, -10) and w.gas(self.x, self.y, 2, 'steam', 0.3) every few seconds. Use resize(2.5) on spawn and a sparking glow color2. Replace aura heal with calm and drop grow.

rows.name: Crater
rows.promise: A scorched ash-gray basin sunk into the land, with meteor-glass shards on its rim, a faintly smoldering glowing heart, and rain pooling inside.
rows.does: Sinks a crater (r up to 12, depth 6) with a boom and shake, paints ash inside, scatters glowing meteor glass in a ring near the rim, and heats the center. It places a small glowing orange heart model and an artifact that brings rain every 40s (pooling in the basin) and light at night.

rows.name: Cryostasis
rows.promise: A silver haze puts one living target into an hour-long, unharmed sleep, leaving only frost-rimmed grass where the caster stands.
rows.does: Puts every creature within 1.5 cells to sleep for an hour and tints it silver, raises an hour-long ward over the spot, and plants a permanent ring of eight 3-voxel glowing crystal spikes with a burst and a shockwave.
rows.missing: The entry says the land is untouched except for frost on the grass, yet the program adds permanent magic crystal spikes and no frost. The silver tint is never removed when the target wakes.
rows.fix: Drop the magic-voxel spike ring and paint a light frost (snow, low density, about 1 cell) at the caster's spot instead. Clear the tint when the sleep ends, for example with a body that calls c.tint back after 3600 seconds, or skip the tint and rely on a brief w.light.

rows.name: Curse
rows.promise: A violet smoke line stabs one target, souring its luck with slips and mishaps for a long while, and the land a few paces around wilts into grey dust.
rows.does: A violet shard and a trail of particles streak to the spot. Plants within 3 cells are cleared and grass, fields and dirt turn to ash. The nearest creature within 1.5 cells is tinted, marked and, for 10 minutes, stunned and shoved every 4 to 8 seconds.

rows.name: Dark Meteor
rows.promise: An ink-black meteor crashes down and leaves a dim, cold ring for a day that drains whoever is in it and puts small creatures to sleep.
rows.does: A dark meteor body falls, explodes, digs a crater, paints cold umbral ash that turns to grass after 300 s, and darkens the whole sky for 10 s. Creatures there at impact get a 6 s stun, or a 40 s sleep for rabbits and birds.
rows.missing: The lasting shadowed ring does nothing to creatures: the drain and the sleep hit only who stands there at the instant of impact, and the dimness is a 10 s global darken, not a lasting local gloom.
rows.fix: Leave a lasting presence on the crater, a w.landmark with aura sleep (or a w.artifact whose every-few-seconds act stuns creatures in R*0.6 and puts rabbits and birds to sleep) that lasts as long as the ash. Give the umbral ash a dark glow or use a lasting w.draw gloom in place of the short global da

rows.name: Dark Phoenix
rows.promise: A living black phoenix wreathed in violet fire that sweeps a field with cold shadow and slow dim flame, darkening the land beneath it.
rows.does: Flashes and spawns one fireproof flying bird that leaves a slowly spreading gloom ground, scares villagers and beasts, breathes fire at enemies, and darkens the sky for 25 seconds every 25 seconds.
rows.missing: It is weak to light, so placed by day it likely dies within seconds (only 3 cells of gloom spread in five minutes). It has no slow violet flame in the air, only ordinary fire breath at enemies, and nothing phoenix-like such as a rebirth.
rows.fix: Remove 'light' from weak, or give it active 'night' with a shaded roost by day. Add a violet smoldering material that it leaves or ignites slowly under its path (or a dim-flame gas). Give it onDeath 'spawn:dark phoenix' or fire so it reborns from ash.

rows.name: Demiurge
rows.promise: A glowing woman holding the first light wanders the island and remakes its raw matter into new forms, at cosmic scale.
rows.does: Spawns one glowing hooded figure that wanders. Every so often it raises a small hill, digs a small pond, builds a stone or crystal pillar, or greens a patch with flowers. It also shifts the wind and calms villagers. The test changed only 15 cells over five minutes.
rows.missing: Far too small for a cosmic creature: each act reshapes only a 3 to 7 cell spot and rarely fires. The world is not visibly remade, and the 'living shard of the first light' in her chest is never shown.
rows.fix: Make her works world-scale and frequent: shorten work and the ability cooldowns, and use w.land (mountain, lake, valley, floating island) and w.wonder at r 10 to 25 instead of small terraforms. Add a glowing chest accent to the creature (color2 glow, or a few-box model with a glow part) so the inner

rows.name: Divine Light
rows.promise: A minute-long golden pillar of light that heals everyone nearby, lifts weariness and reveals and drives off the monsters hidden in the dark.
rows.does: Golden gathering, then a 60 s beam, light and ward. For a minute it heals villagers, golems and peaceful animals by 25 each second and calms them. Every other creature is hurt, frightened away and tinted gold, and smoke and poison are cleared; grass grows at the end.

rows.name: Divine Radiance
rows.promise: A pillar of white-gold holy flame that heals and cleanses everyone near it, hurts dark things, and leaves the land glowing, greening and blooming with pale wildflowers.
rows.does: Raises a twin white-gold beam with a choir, light and shockwave. It heals every living creature in reach and revives corpses, burns and frightens undead, and calms and wounds hostiles. It puts out fire, melts snow and thin ice, turns ash and dirt to grass and flowers, paints glowing hallowed ground

rows.name: Djinn
rows.promise: A smoke-blue spirit of wind in a robed shape that guards caravans, carries messages and fans parched fields into rain-bearing gusts.
rows.does: A spiral of particles and a whoosh, then one hooded, glowing spirit that follows villagers, scares wolves and bears, grows plants every 20 s, casts Rain every 60 s whatever the weather, and teleports when hurt, for 10 minutes.
rows.missing: No wind anywhere: no gusts, no swirling column, nothing blown. Its rain falls on a timer, not on dry fields, and its body is a generic hooded spirit rather than a twisting column of cloud.
rows.fix: Give the Rain ability when: 'drought' (or a custom act that looks for dry fields). Add a custom ability that calls w.wind toward the parched field and drifts w.gas('steam') clouds over it. Make the arrival a rising vortex body with the wind sound, and give the djinn a swirling cloud trail.

rows.name: Dodo Flock
rows.promise: A plump grey dodo familiar that waddles, clucking, toward any stranger as a living alarm and molts feathers that ward off sudden storms.
rows.does: Spawns 3 grey flightless bird 'dodos' that guard their spawn spot with a calm aura and scare beasts. It also raises a generic 20-second ward dome and places stone and leaf blobs with a chime. An artifact waters cells near fire and lights the night.
rows.missing: The dodos never go toward strangers or raise an alarm, and nothing clucks. The storm ward is a brief all-purpose dome, not molted feathers against storms. Night light and fire-watering have nothing to do with the name.
rows.fix: Give the dodo behavior wander with a custom goal that seeks hostile or strange creatures, sounds 'chirp' and draws villagers to them (lures villager, not scares beast). Replace the 20-second w.ward and the light and water effects with a molt that leaves a feather material or artifact granting shield

rows.name: Dragon Breath
rows.promise: A roaring twelve-pace cone of fire from the caster's palms that scorches grass, melts frost, scares off small creatures and singes larger ones.
rows.does: Over about 2 seconds it heats a narrow 12-cell wedge eastward, turns half its grass and fields to ash, clears ice and lights scattered small fires. It also throws repeated all-direction spark bursts at the origin, makes creatures in the wedge afraid and tints them orange.
rows.missing: No visible column of flame rolls down the cone: the only moving effect is a round spark burst at one point, the sound is rise and boom rather than a roar, and singed creatures take no damage.
rows.fix: Each step, emit flame w.particle or small flame w.body in a fan along the cone direction (vx toward the target, spread within the cone, reaching the current front), use w.sound('roar'), and give creatures in the cone a light c.hurt (for example 1 to 2) besides the tint.

rows.name: Dragon Egg
rows.promise: A warm, glowing, speckled dragon egg whose heat and pulse steady magic and keep things vigorous: a healing relic with a hint of the dragon inside (summon).
rows.does: Draws a small stack of glowing gold boxes on a stone pedestal, then places an artifact that heals within 8 cells every 20 seconds, grants healing to visiting villagers and gives off light at night.
rows.missing: Its defining warmth never happens: no heat on the land, even though the summary claims it. Nothing is ever summoned or hatched despite the summon promise. The night light is a stock extra the entry never mentions.
rows.fix: Add an act effect that calls w.heat or w.temperature on nearby cells (a few degrees) with a slow pulsing w.light. Add a rare effect that hatches a dragonling creature through summon:<kind>, or drop the summon intent. Remove the night light effect, and put the speckle parts on eighths so they are dra

rows.name: Dragon Rider
rows.promise: A silver-and-leather saddle that binds to a creature so a rider can soar the sky and dive on the largest, most dangerous beasts.
rows.does: Puts a 2x1 wooden box and one silver voxel on the ground as a 'Dragon Rider' artifact. The artifact later summons a saddled wyvern (first one after up to 60 s, 3 charges) that hunts bear, boar and deer. Every 20 s a white beam hurts one beast near the wyvern, and the artifact hands villagers arms.
rows.missing: No rider ever mounts anything. The saddle is a plain box and voxel, not a saddle. The mount does not arrive when the item is placed, only on the first timed summon. Scaring beasts away fights the promised hunt. For a creature item, the player sees almost nothing at first.
rows.fix: Spawn the saddled wyvern at once in cast with w.spawn('saddled wyvern', w.x, w.y), and draw a ridden look: a creature model or features with an armored rider over the dragon body, or pair it with w.person(x, y, {job: 'hunter', title: 'Dragon Rider'}). Draw the saddle with w.model (silver fittings, l

rows.name: Dungeon
rows.promise: A crystal cavern with humming shards that guide travelers through chambers to a hidden treasure, then fades to bare stone once it is found.
rows.does: Raises a crystal-flecked mound with an open winding trench, small glowing shard posts along it, a stone gate, a tiny chest and one cell of villager-luring gold; the artifact only lights the area at night.
rows.missing: No cavern or chambers (just an open trench), shards never hum or react to travelers, and nothing makes it fade back to stone after the treasure is taken; the night light is an unrelated extra.
rows.fix: Use w.wonder(x,y,'cave mouth') or w.land canyon for the cavern; replace the night-light effect with an act effect that plays w.sound('crystal') and w.light on the shards when villagers come near; put several gold cells at the heart and add an act effect that, once w.cell shows the gold gone, paints

rows.name: Dwarf
rows.promise: A knee-high earthen dwarf that digs tunnels, shores up mine shafts and keeps watch over stone walls, humming as it works.
rows.does: Spawns a hooded, axe-carrying golem-bodied dwarf from a small dirt mound; it wanders to rock, raises the cell, clears its cover and paints dirt there, carrying stone home.
rows.missing: It never digs: it heaps dirt onto rock instead of cutting into it, and it never keeps watch over walls or shores up anything.
rows.fix: Make the delve act lower the rock (w.terraform with a small negative height, or w.raise downward) and leave rubble beside the cut; add a guard behaviour or goal near stone walls or rock; give it a pick or hammer instead of an axe.

rows.name: Eclipse
rows.promise: A dark fire-ringed disk dims a twenty-pace sphere to dusk for a minute; creatures inside stumble and lose their way while shadows crawl, then fade.
rows.does: Hangs a dark orb overhead for 60 s, darkens the whole island for 60 s, stuns every creature within R each frame, and paints a spreading shadow ground that decays to grass. It also sets real fires on a ring of ground cells.
