rows.missing: The ring of real w.fire on the ground can spread fire into forests, fields and houses, which an eclipse never does. The darkening covers the whole island instead of the twenty-pace sphere. Spreading shadow can creep beyond the area and turns dirt into grass when it decays.
rows.fix: Remove the w.fire ring and keep the fire band visual only (the orb's color2, a w.circle, or flame particles around the body). Limit the dusk to the area, for example with a dark w.light or tint centered on w.x, w.y instead of a full w.darken. Drop the shadow's spreads, or cap it inside R, so it fade

rows.name: Ember Swarm
rows.promise: A slow snowfall of glowing sparks that turns flowers and dry grass into softly glowing amber blossoms for an hour; creatures caught in it sneeze and shimmer but take no harm.
rows.does: Whispers, puffs sparks, then 12 glowing star motes drift down over about five seconds; where each lands, flowers and bare grass in a small disc become glowing amber blossoms that fade back to flowers after an hour. Creatures in reach get a little hop, a spark burst, a click sound and a short calm, w

rows.name: Exodus
rows.promise: Water splits into two standing green walls around a dry sand channel that people cross safely while fish are lifted aside, then the sea folds closed.
rows.does: Wards the area, then clears water along a randomly angled line, lays sand, teleports nearby fish 8 cells sideways, raises two 12-voxel green magic walls for about 8 seconds, then removes them and restores the water.
rows.missing: The path ignores where the water is: a random angle that need not cross from shore to shore, walls even on dry land. Nothing holds back the water beside the channel, which can flow straight back in. The 5-cell unvoxel when it closes also strips nearby trees and voxels. No one is led across.
rows.fix: Use w.nearest('water') and w.here to aim the line across the water toward the far shore. Re-clear the channel's fluid each second so it stays dry, and shape the walls from the water's own depth. Close by restoring only the cells in wet, not with a wide w.unvoxel. Have calmed villagers walk the path,

rows.name: Exorcism
rows.promise: A pale gold ring of light spreads over the ground, dissolving spirits and undead into motes, leaving the living unharmed, and keeping them away from the place for an hour.
rows.does: A whisper and a gold circle, then a ring of gold motes and a shockwave expand to about 1.2 w.r; every undead or spirit the ring reaches bursts into rising gold motes and dies, and a faint rune circle plus a ward that pushes those kinds out stays for an hour.

rows.name: Extinct Spirit
rows.promise: A pale grey ghost dodo, a glowing wisp-bird that drifts, answers softly and points the way along hidden paths and lost trails.
rows.does: Flashes, chimes, floats a grey cloud body for 6 seconds, then places an invisible artifact that lights at night, scares beasts and is prayed at by villagers. No dodo is ever spawned or drawn.
rows.missing: No ghost dodo appears: no creature kind, spawn or model. Its path-pointing beam is written as a function in do instead of act, so the engine drops it. The prayer and worship are defaults the name never asks for.
rows.fix: Declare spell.creatures with a dodo spirit (base spirit, body bird, color #c9ced6, glow, flying, behavior follow, leader villager) and a custom explore goal whose act draws a w.beam toward w.nearest('tree') or a trail; w.spawn it in cast. Move the beam code into act, and drop the grants prayer and u

rows.name: Extinction
rows.promise: A grey mist rolls over the land and one chosen creature kind vanishes from sight for a day, leaving only faint footprints, then returns unharmed.
rows.does: Grey cloud bodies sweep the whole island and turn every creature of the kind nearest the touch into a pale, glowing-eyed 'echo' spirit that wanders and leaves grey tracks; after 240 s they turn back, stunned for a moment. The test run timed out.
rows.missing: The creatures never fade from sight. They stay as visible, glowing-eyed spirits with a calm aura, so the 'gone, only footprints remain' promise is not kept, and the test run never finished.
rows.fix: Make the echo nearly invisible: drop the glowing eyes and the calm aura, give it a ground-matching translucent color, and set resize(0.3) or a similar factor on transform. Keep 'faint tracks' as the only clear sign, and check that the 240 s body really ends and transforms the creatures back so the r

rows.name: Fallen Angel
rows.promise: A tall ash-winged sentinel that watches over a sleeping house or grove and lights the paths it guards with its faintly glowing wings.
rows.does: Raises a 120-second ward, then spawns a glowing, flying, crowned spirit that guards its spot, attacks and scares wolves and bears, heals every 20 s and shields when enemies near; it is active by day only.
rows.missing: It sleeps at night (active: 'day'), so it is not on watch while the house sleeps and does not light the paths after dark. The healing ability is an extra the entry never promises.
rows.fix: Make it keep watch at night (active: 'night' or no active), and add a light effect or an act that lights the cells around it after dusk; drop the heal ability and let guard plus the shield carry the protection.

rows.name: Fallen Castle
rows.promise: A charred, ember-glowing castle hanging in the sky over a town, watching and guarding it from the air.
rows.does: Raises an hour-long ward over the village and an ordinary watchtower on the ground that strikes enemies with lightning and arms villagers, with a tiny model of about 20 parts floating 12 voxels up beside it.
rows.missing: The castle is only about 2 cells across, the size of a house and far from a major fortress. Its glowing windows are 0.06-thick slits off the eighth grid and will likely be lost. The working building is a plain village watchtower, and the guarding is lightning rather than Black Flame.
rows.fix: Draw the floating castle as one larger w.model of 60 to 140 parts (about 5 to 7 cells across) with a broken rock underside, crenellated ember-capped towers, and glowing windows and gate on eighths at least 0.125 thick. Put the artifact under it and have its enemy effect act with a dark-red fire bolt

rows.name: Fenghuang
rows.promise: A heron-sized bird of living flame, gold to ember red with a sparking tail, that guards hearths, calms frightened animals with its song and rises from its ash.
rows.does: Spawns a glowing gold and red flying spirit bird after a flash and a burst of sparks; it guards where it lands, calms animals within 6 cells, scares wolves, breathes fire at enemies, heals now and then, and respawns when it dies.
rows.missing: Its guard prey is 'rat', a kind that does not exist, so it attacks nothing; its guarding rests only on scaring wolves and breathing fire. No spark trail follows it.
rows.fix: Set prey to real threats (wolf, hostile, undead) so it attacks what nears the village, and spawn it beside the nearest village (w.nearest('village')) so it guards hearths; a fire-colored trail or periodic w.particle sparks behind it would show the comet tail.

rows.name: Final Incantation
rows.promise: A bell-like word heals everyone within ten paces and keeps them strong for a minute, roots them in place, and raises a low stone rampart ring that crumbles to dust after that minute.
rows.does: Gives everyone within 10 cells a single heal of 100 and 60 s of calm, raises a 3-voxel stone ring of radius 7 that vanishes after 60 s with a dust burst at the center, and adds a 20 s ward, with a chime and a flash.
rows.missing: The healing is one burst, not a minute of restored strength. Calm does not stop anyone fleeing or hold them to their ground, the ward ends at 20 s instead of a minute, and a chime is not a struck bell.
rows.fix: Re-heal the creatures within 10 cells every few seconds in the 60 s body's tick, and hold them with status('stun', 60) or by pushing them back inside the ring. Set the ward's seconds to 60, play gong instead of chime, and burst the dust along the ring's points.

rows.name: Fireflies
rows.promise: Pulsing clouds of tiny gold-glowing fireflies at meadow and stream edges that act as living lanterns, watch over sleepers at night and fade into the grass by dawn.
rows.does: Spawns 3 glowing flying insects, active at night, that wander, tend, leave flowers, use a grow ability, lure villagers and scare birds, with a brief sparkle burst on arrival.
rows.missing: Three insects are not a pulsing cloud. Nothing makes them lanterns or keepers of watch over sleeping villagers. The flower-planting and bird-scaring come from nowhere in the entry.
rows.fix: Spawn 10 to 15 fireflies near grass or water. Give them behavior follow with leader villager and a light aura or ability at night that drives night hunters off sleepers. Drop leaves flowers, the grow ability and scares bird.

rows.name: Flame Dash
rows.promise: Someone vanishes in black smoke and reappears up to thirty paces away in a burst of fire that singes, shoves and blackens the grass.
rows.does: Puffs smoke at a spot 30 cells west of the target and draws a line of ember particles to the target. There it sets a small fire, paints ash and pushes, hurts and burns any creature within 2.5 cells, then warms the air for a moment.
rows.missing: Nobody is ever moved: there is no caster or creature that blurs away and reappears, so the dash is only a streak of particles between two puffs (the test run moved 0 creatures).
rows.fix: Find someone at the start (w.nearest('villager', sx, sy, 6) or a creature from w.creatures) and c.teleport(lx, ly) them after the smoke puff, or send a w.body look 'flame' with a smoke trail from start to landing so a visible figure makes the dash; keep the landing burst, push and ash.

rows.name: Flying Dutchman
rows.promise: A ghostly galleon with starlit sails that drifts through the night air along dark coasts, ferrying messages and never stopping for those who ask.
rows.does: Spawns one glowing night spirit (spirit body with a tail and glowing eyes) that wanders and explores, scares villagers and beasts, leaves ice where it passes, and casts lightning and freeze.
rows.missing: It looks like a wisp, not a ship: no hull, mast or sails. It ferries nothing between coasts. The ice trail and lightning strikes are not in the entry, and a light-weak night spirit placed by day has no way to wait for dusk.
rows.fix: Give the creature a model of a galleon (hull boxes, mast, tattered sail boxes with part 'wing' that glow); replace explore with a custom goal that flies between villages or the coast and carries a message; drop leaves 'ice' and the freeze ability; remove weak 'light' or have it hide as mist until du

rows.name: Four Horsemen
rows.promise: A storm-coated warhorse with four riders that rolls a wave of hunger, drought or ruin across a whole valley in one night, then fades, and grows gentler with those who tend it.
rows.does: Spawns one grey armored four-legged beast that hunts deer and boar, withers crops in 3-cell patches, leaves creeping parched earth where it walks, and once a night parches a 6-12 cell ring with a small quake. Its 'gentleness' grows from villagers merely standing near it. The test run changed 64 cell
rows.missing: The cosmic, valley-wide sweep in a single night never happens, only small local patches. No storm or drought weather is shown. The riders are just a hood and sword on a horse. Tending is never asked of anyone, since nearness alone counts as faith.
rows.fix: Make the night ability a real sweep: a w.body or a moving w.line front crossing the valley at dusk that paints parched earth and withered crop, drains water with w.temperature heat, and brings dust w.wind and darkened skies. Draw the riders with a w.model or a custom creature model. Gain bond only f

rows.name: Frost Giant
rows.promise: A towering giant of living ice that guards frozen ground, freezes what comes near and leaves frost where it walks.
rows.does: Chills the spot, then spawns a glowing ice-blue golem-bodied giant (hp 400) that guards its place, attacks wolves, bears and boars, scares wolves and bears, freezes enemies, leaves ice where it walks and becomes ice when it dies.

rows.name: Frost Nova
rows.promise: A spiralling burst of frost that locks the ground, puddles and creatures in rime for about ten seconds, numbs warm-blooded foes and leaves the grass silver.
rows.does: Pale sparks spiral out and a frost shockwave expands. Grass turns to silver rime that fades back after 45 s, and shallow water freezes, then thaws after about 10 s. Villagers and animals are frozen for 3 s; other creatures are frozen for 10 s, hurt and encased in ice that shatters afterwards.

rows.name: Frost Rune
rows.promise: A blue sigil in the air strikes the ground; a spreading rime slows everyone on it for about a minute, then fades to a faint sheen.
rows.does: Draws a hexagram of beams over a magic circle, paints a growing disc of rime, and freezes every creature nearby for 60s, re-freezing those on rime with breath puffs. The rime then creeps into grass, dirt and sand and decays into bare rock after 60s.
rows.missing: The frost never fades: it keeps creeping and turns the grass, fields and dirt it covers into permanent bare rock, not a faint sheen. Victims are frozen solid rather than slowed to a crawl.
rows.fix: Drop spreads (or keep it to a slow rate with a hard edge), set becomes to grass or dirt instead of rock, and give the creature freeze a few seconds at a time from the body tick rather than 60s up front, so it reads as numbed feet instead of statues.

rows.name: Frozen Crypt
rows.promise: A squat frost-rimed stone crypt with a sleeping-face frost door that keeps the dead and restless spirits quiet at night and the living calm.
rows.does: Raises an ordinary village chapel with a small pale box model with icicles beside it, paints snow, adds an artifact that freezes around it at night and on fire and heals every minute, and domes the village for an hour against fire, floods, lightning, harm and beasts.
rows.missing: Nothing quiets the dead or spirits or calms the living, and the hour-long dome against fire, lava and raiders is not what a crypt promises. The building is a chapel with a tiny crypt prop beside it, and the sleeping frost face is not drawn.
rows.fix: Drop the chapel and lastingWard. Draw the crypt itself as the w.model with rime courses, a squat roof and a glowing frost door with a face. Add a w.landmark that scares undead and spirit with aura sleep or freeze, plus a calm effect at night (act applying status 'calm' to villagers and 'sleep' to un

rows.name: Frozen Necropolis
rows.promise: A frozen city of the dead: pale ice towers, rime-glazed streets, crystal tombs and cold blue lanterns, peopled by gentle ghosts who tend the tombs.

rows.name: Gaia
rows.promise: A cosmic forest spirit, as tall as an ancient oak, rises and walks slowly, restoring blighted farmland and leaving undying wildflowers behind it.
rows.does: Rumbles and spawns one tree-folk 'gaia' creature (radius 2.2, resized 1.4). It wanders leaving gaia bloom, turns nearby ash, dirt or rubble into grass and crops every 25 to 35 seconds within 30 to 40 cells, and lures deer and rabbits.

Widen its reach to the whole island: seek ash, dirt and burnt fields with near around 150, and paint grass, crop and bloom over a radius of 8 to 12 per act. Open with a wide camera on

rows.name: Gamma Ray Burst
rows.promise: A blinding violet-white beam from the sky turns a circle about twenty paces wide to glowing glass, stuns every creature in it for a minute, and leaves the place hot and shining for a long while.
rows.does: Darkens the sky and gathers a falling glow, then drops a thin beam followed by a wide violet-white beam. It paints a radius-10+ circle with glowing, heat-holding starglass that turns to crystal after 15 minutes, heats the circle and sets scattered fires. Every creature inside takes damage, is stunne

rows.name: Garden of Eden
rows.promise: A glowing orchard of silver-barked, dawn-fruited trees in a glass-walled grove, an angel grown into its boughs, healing and warding ruined farmland.
rows.does: Grows a giant silver tree with glowing peach fruit and floating wing-shaped magic voxels, ringed by seven silver birches inside glass walls; it raises a 10-minute ward, lays spreading bloom soil that turns ash and dirt green, heals and grows the land, and offers food and healing to villagers.

rows.name: Geyser
rows.promise: A small hot spring pool that breathes steam in slow, roaring bursts and warms the frozen ground around it.
rows.does: Digs a spring-fed pond, rings it with stones around a stepped vent, and every 8 seconds puffs steam gas and a white burst, warming 4 cells around it by 30 degrees.

rows.name: Ghostfire
rows.promise: A pale blue cold flame that burns wood, cloth and stone with silver fire that dies within a minute and leaves no ash, while living things are only chilled and never harmed.
rows.does: Twelve pale blue flame bodies drift out and light ordinary fire on nearby trees, houses, bushes and crops, burn away voxels, and freeze every creature in reach for 30 seconds under a blue light.

It spreads with the wind, burns houses to rubble, leaves ash and stumps, and hurts or panics villagers (the test left 1 house and 1 villager). Stone never burns. So the harmless, ashless, one-minute silver ghostfire the name stands for never appears.
rows.fix: Declare a glowing silver-blue 'ghostfire' cover material with decays 60, becomes the cell's original cover (or none), no spreads, and no hurts. Set it on wood, house and rock cells instead of calling w.fire and burnVoxels. Replace the 30-second freeze with a light chill (w.temperature of a few degre

rows.name: Glacier
rows.promise: A blue-white ice sheet that creeps over the land, freezes rivers into crossings and carves a valley as it grinds stone to silt.

The ice spreads into water and snow very slowly (4 cells in five minut

rows.fix: Lay the ice in growing rings over several seconds from one edge (paint glacier ice with a rising radius each yield) so the sheet visibly creeps, give the crawler a visible ice look, carve once with w.land valley or a single shallow w.terraform along its path instead of every tick, paint sand or a si

rows.name: Gold
rows.promise: A small glowing spot of gold-veined soil ringed by pale yellow grass that stays warm at night and makes nearby crops ripen twice as fast.
rows.does: Raises a low mound, paints a glowing gold-vein ground patch that slowly creeps into grass and lures villagers, draws a glinting ore mound, and places an artifact that casts a generic grow every 15 s within 6 cells.

Replace the grow effect with an act that finds crop and field cells within radius and grows them. Remove the villager lure or make the veins ta

rows.name: Golem
rows.promise: A man-high clay golem with amber eyes that serves patiently: carries loads, digs trenches and guards fields until it cracks and crumbles back into soil.
rows.does: Spawns one fireproof clay golem (guard behavior, shield ability) and stacks a stone box and sphere with two glowing eyes as a statue. It also places a 'Golem' artifact that heals, grows plants, waters fires and arms villagers, and raises an hour-long ward dome over the village.

Add lifespan with onDeath 'dirt' so it c

rows.promise: A tall bone-white hooded reaper with a green-sparking scythe walks from dusk to dawn, gently laying the old and sickly to rest and raising seedlings where its scythe passes.

rows.promise: A gentle pale stag creature with glowing white-flowered antlers that roams gardens and sickrooms, calming and healing the sick and wounded.

rows.name: Healing Breeze
rows.promise: A soft gust rolls out in a ring about twenty paces wide, slowly mending creatures and plants inside it for about ten minutes.
rows.does: Draws a pale green circle with a whoosh, sends 20 glowing swarm wisps drifting outward and calms and heals everyone in reach. An invisible body then heals every creature in the ring by 1 each second for 600 seconds and now and then regrows plants, with drifting motes.

rows.name: Heavenly Radiance
rows.promise: Green and violet aurora ribbons gather into a canopy that, for ten minutes, heals wounds, eases fatigue, makes the land glow, quickens crops and keeps the night as bright as dawn.
rows.does: Draws five waving green and violet beam ribbons high overhead that converge into a canopy, with a choir and a magic circle. It heals and calms every creature in reach and lays a 600-second light. A 10-minute body redraws the ribbons, heals everyone every 3 seconds, grows crops and lights random patc

rows.name: Holy Avenger
rows.promise: A holy silver longsword whose edge cuts through curses and harms the undead, and which serves as a focus for wards and dawn-rites.
rows.does: Plants a block sword with a sunburst orb, raises an hour-long ward over the reach, lights the area at night and grants villagers prayer. Its hurt aura and scares are aimed at spirits, not undead.
rows.missing: The avenging edge never reaches the undead: nothing hurts undead or lifts curses, and its harm falls on spirits, which may be friendly wisps. The minor sword mostly acts as a village-wide dome.
rows.fix: Point the landmark's scares and hurt aura at undead (and hostile) kinds instead of spirit, and add an artifact effect {when: 'enemy'} or {when: 'night'} with an act that smites undead in reach (c.hurt plus a w.beam or a holy lightning). Keep the ward as the dawn-rite focus, but scale it to the sword

rows.name: Holy Barrier
rows.promise: A shimmering gold dome shields everyone inside from blows, missiles and falling stone for ten minutes, repels the first strikes, then fades like mist.
rows.does: Raises a gold w.ward for 600 seconds with a choir, a beam, a circle and light, pushes and stuns hostiles near the dome until a 100-force budget is spent, and lets out a mist of particles when it ends; the test run blocked fire, lava and blasts fully and most of the raiders' harm.

rows.name: Holy Fire
rows.promise: A white flame column strikes down, unmakes undead in its blaze, cleanses cursed ground to grass, leaves the living unharmed and warm, and scorches stone below.
rows.does: White beams and a falling white flame body strike with choir, roar and shake. Undead in reach are burned and hurt 25 every 0.25 s for 3 s (300 total). Villagers, animals and spirits are healed and calmed. Poison and smoke are cleared, ash and foreign ground become glowing hallowed grass, and rock, d

rows.name: Holy Frost
rows.promise: A silver sigil and hymn spread holy white ice over a ten-yard circle, holding every creature caught in it still for an hour before it melts.
rows.does: Draws a silver magic circle with a beam triangle sigil, then spreads a ring of glowing white 'holy rime' ground out to about R=4+ cells and chills the area by -60. Every creature inside is then frozen in place for 3600 s under a small star marker, and the rime turns to snow after an hour.

rows.name: Holy Tome
rows.promise: A glowing white, gold-edged holy book with a sun clasp that holds a shield of light over a village for as long as it lies open.
rows.does: Places a 2x2x2 wood block topped with a white-and-gold magic slab and one gold voxel, then raises a ward on arrival and again every 30 s (radius 8), plus light at night; in the test run the ward blocked most of the harm.

rows.name: Homunculus
rows.promise: A tiny pale waxy servant with amber eyes that follows its maker and runs errands: carrying messages, fetching things, keeping watch.

rows.missing: It never fetches or carries anything. Its deeds are a gardener's: a flower trail and growing plants. A finger-sized creature that frightens wolves contradicts its frailty.
rows.fix: Use goal 'gather' (or a custom goal that seeks the village and carries food or stone home) instead of 'tend', remove leaves 'flowers' and the grow ability, and remove scares ['wolf'] so it flees wolves (or set wolf prey on it) rather than frightening them.

rows.name: Hypernova
rows.promise: A crackling white gathering, then a golden ring of searing radiance for three heartbeats that knocks creatures flat unharmed, scorches leaves and cloth, and leaves no lasting mark.
rows.does: Gathers crackling white beams to a core, booms and flashes, then sweeps golden shockwaves and a gold glow over the whole island. Creatures are pushed outward and stunned without harm, brown embers drift like curling leaves, and three thumping gold pulses fade with no change to the land.

rows.name: Illusion
rows.promise: A shimmering glow that shows a false scene, such as a bridge over a chasm or a wall of trees across a path, for about a minute before it fades to a harmless shimmer.
rows.does: Shows a pale magic circle, a drone and a flash, calms and tints creatures in reach, and sets 8 glowing shards orbiting for 60 s over a faint flat ground decal of bars, with a soft light.
rows.missing: The false scene never appears as a thing: the 'bridge' is a translucent flat stripe painted on the ground wherever the spell lands, with no span, no trees, no wall and no reading of the land, so the player sees only glow and motes.

Remove them with w.unvoxel in the end() of a 60 s body so they fade to the shimmer, a

rows.name: Immortality
rows.promise: A dented chalice that never empties, spilling gold-silver liquid light that lets living things shrug off age, sickness and death.

rows.name: Inferno
rows.promise: A roaring sweep of flame scorches a path about ten wide and twenty long, setting creatures, crops and wood alight, leaving blackened ground and lingering heat.

It sets cells on fire, heats them, lays scorched earth that turns back to grass in 400 s, burns creatures near the arc and raises the area's temperature by 80 (test: 781 cells, 16 creatures chan

rows.name: Lady of the Lake
rows.promise: A blue water sword-spirit that takes in mages' spells, cuts through illusions and sends one clean strike across still water.

rows.name: Last Stand
rows.promise: A vow and a spreading ring of pale gold light that shields every ally inside for one minute, halving their harm, while nothing beyond the ring is touched.

rows.name: Last Survivor
rows.promise: A small glowing silver-quilled feather that slowly mends the wounds of dying beasts near it, but cannot raise the dead.

rows.name: Lava

rows.name: Lost Tome

rows.name: Maelstrom
rows.promise: A violent silver whirlwind with a dark pull at its heart sweeps across a valley, sucking in foes, stones and leaves, holding them three seconds, then dropping them dazed.

rows.name: Mana Potion

rows.name: Mermaid
rows.promise: A small silver-tailed half-human water creature that swims rivers and pools, guards springs from silt and poison, and sings restless water calm.
rows.does: Flashes and chimes, places an invisible Mermaid artifact that waters fields at dawn and gives villagers water, and spawns a glowing fish-based 'mermaid' wherever tapped that wanders, calms creatures nearby and clears mud, acid and poison within 3 cells every 20 s.
rows.missing: She is drawn as a plain glowing fish with no human upper body or face. She is spawned on the tapped cell even if it is dry land. The spring-guarding artifact is an unseen well whose custom effect uses do:'act', which the engine drops. Her song never calms water.

rows.name: Meteor Shower
rows.promise: A night shower of white falling stars over a wide area, each landing harmlessly with a flash, leaving glowing dust, and making creatures glimmer for a while.

rows.name: Mithril

rows.name: Molten Gold
rows.promise: A small glowing spot of cracked earth where slow liquid gold runs into hollows and the ground becomes a bright plain that yields a harvest.
rows.does: Quakes and opens a small crater, fills it with a glowing, hot, slowly flowing molten gold fluid, paints a spreading gilded field around it, and leaves an artifact that makes crops grow, feeds villagers and sends gold to the nearest village.

rows.name: Monster Hunter
rows.promise: A silver bracelet whose hound-spirit tugs toward a hunted beast like a compass and barks when the quarry is near.

rows.name: Moon Landing
rows.promise: An eclipse dims the sky, a silver sphere drops to hover, then drifts down and gently lifts anyone nearby before cracking into glowing moondust in a silvery crater ringed with moonlight grass.

rows.name: Moraine
rows.promise: A cold heap of dark gravelly earth glinting with glacier ice that raises stubborn frost-bound earth walls and chills the ground so it holds against the thaw.
rows.does: Raises a rock mound with dirt and ash paint, falling ice voxels, an ice spire and a gravel-and-ice model, then sets an endless ward dome over the area and an artifact that casts freeze every 30 s.

rows.name: Mud
rows.promise: A small spot of glistening brown mud that slows anything wading through it and dries back in the sun.
rows.does: Floods a 3.5-cell spot with mud and keeps topping it up. Every 3 s it stuns villagers and animals inside for 2 s, so they move stop-start. By day it turns about half the mud back to dirt once a minute.

rows.name: Necronomicon
rows.promise: A scorched black book that, when read, brings a rival's power or a cursed object's strength to sudden, total collapse amid drifting ash and dimmed light.
rows.does: Draws a black open book on a stone lectern with candles, dims the light and puffs ash. While charged, it kills the strongest hostile or undead within 12 cells with a dark beam every 20 s and leaves ash. Every 90 s it turns a nearby rubble, stump or boulder to ash, and it puffs ash at night. In the t
rows.missing: Cursed objects, other artifacts and landmarks are never touched, nothing is revealed, and beasts are scared for no reason. With no hostiles near, it mostly turns stumps to ash, which is thin for a legendary item. Many model edges sit off eighths and 0.05 thin, so the scorched page rims may be lost.
rows.fix: Add an act that finds nearby cursed landmarks or hostile artifacts and ends them (ash, burst, unvoxel), and let the enemy effect show a moment of reading the ending (stun 1 s, beam, then collapse) before the kill. Drop scares beast. Snap the model parts to eighths at least 0.125 thick.

rows.name: Nectar
rows.promise: A small glowing vial of golden nectar that heals wounds and restores the tired.
rows.does: Draws a glowing gold vial on a stone pedestal, heals everyone within 6 cells every 30 seconds from 6 recharging charges, and lets villagers come to it for healing.

rows.name: Noah's Ark
rows.promise: A pale-timbered ark among the houses that gathers the region's animals up its gangplank and keeps them safe and asleep while the world outside changes.
rows.does: Raises a barn with a salt-pale ark model beside it (stacked hull, cabin, lit windows, gangplank with animal pairs, a dove on the roof). It lures beasts, and every 12 s pulls animals within 14 cells toward it, heals and calms them and puts those at the door to sleep. A 15-minute ward over the area st

rows.name: Obsidian
rows.promise: A placed shard of glassy black volcanic stone with sharp ridges and trapped steam that holds a fierce heat, dangerous to touch.
rows.does: Paints a small disc of a black 'obsidian' ground and stacks a plain 2x2x3 black stone box, puffs steam every 25 s, and its artifact gives light at night, shields from fire, heals and is worshipped by villagers.
rows.missing: Nothing harms or burns despite the promised harm and fierce heat; healing, night light, fire shield and worship are unasked-for defaults; the look is a plain box, not a glassy ridged stone.
rows.fix: Drop heal, light, shield and worship, and give it a heat effect instead: an act that calls w.heat or w.fire on adjacent cells and hurt(n) on creatures within 1 cell; draw it with w.model as faceted, wedge-cut black glass with a faint glowing vein, and keep the steam.

rows.name: Part the Sea
rows.promise: Still water splits into two standing glassy walls around a lantern-lit trench where pearls and wrecks lie bare, for a long while, then the sea closes again.
rows.does: Finds the wettest line through the target, drains a trench about 8 cells wide along it, and lines it with water-blue floating voxel columns that rise above the surface. Fluid wards hold the sea back for 600 s, fish are pushed aside, glowing pearls (which lure villagers) and lanterns line the bed, an

rows.name: Pegasus
rows.promise: A gentle, cloud-white winged horse that lifts off on rushing wings and flies over valleys and rivers as a companion to messengers and healers.
rows.does: With a whoosh and a soft burst, it spawns one white, flying, four-legged pegasus with wings, mane and tail. It roams by day, tends and heals now and then, leaves flowers where it walks, draws villagers and scares wolves and bears; in the test it lived and moved 32 cells over two minutes.

rows.name: Pet Dodo
rows.promise: A small plump grey-brown dodo familiar that waddles after its keeper and chirps softly when danger nears.
rows.does: Spawns a small grey-brown bird-bodied 'pet dodo' that follows villagers, chirps with a few sparks when an enemy is near, preens now and then, tends plants, and scares wolves and bears.

rows.name: Portal Ward
rows.promise: A silver-thread ward on a threshold that bends the path of anyone passing through, carrying intruders sideways into thorns or the wrong hall.
rows.does: Raises a pale ward dome for 600 seconds, draws a silver circle on the ground, builds a small stone arch and an inert landmark, with a drone, a chime and a light.
rows.missing: The redirection, the heart of the name: nobody who crosses the threshold is moved sideways, there are no thorn bushes, and the arch is only decoration. It is a plain dome shield.
rows.fix: Keep the arch as the threshold and add an artifact or landmark with an act that each second finds hostile creatures within about 2 cells of the arch and teleports each a few cells sideways into a patch of bush painted beside it (w.paint bush), with a silver beam or burst at each shift; keep w.ward o

rows.name: Pyromancer
rows.promise: A calm, flame-wrapped human mage with ember eyes who kindles hearths and ritual fires, and whose flame can be read for omens.
rows.does: Spawns a hooded, glowing two-legged 'pyromancer' creature with a torch and glowing eyes. It wanders to the village, calms villagers and scares beasts. Its 'kindle' goal only warms a cell by 60 degrees with a brief light, and it breathes fire at enemies.
rows.missing: No visible flame curls around its hands and head, only a glow and a torch. Its kindling lights no fire a player can see, nothing reads omens in the flame, and its fire breath makes it aggressive rather than calm. It is also a spawned creature, not one of the island's own people.
rows.fix: Make it with w.person({title: 'Pyromancer'}), or keep the creature and give it an ability whose act emits w.particle flames from its hands and head. Have the kindle act light a small contained hearth or ritual fire, for example a model fire pit with w.fire at low intensity next to a house. Replace '

rows.name: Quasar
rows.promise: A light column and dust ring; the ground collapses; everything is pulled to a humming dark core for ten heartbeats, then flung out in a blinding burst. People are set down unharmed and the scoured land glows for a day.
rows.does: A downward beam, a dark orb and a spinning flame disc pull creatures inward for 10 s while lightning strikes and cover is cleared. Everything within 4 cells is killed. The finale is a power-5 explosion, a crater, +300 heat, fires and a coat of glowing quasar glass. The test run lost about half the v
rows.missing: The entry says creatures are set down unharmed, but the spell kills them, strikes them with lightning and burns them. They are never flung back out and set gently down. It also sets fires the entry never mentions.
rows.fix: Remove c.kill(), the random lightning, w.ignite and the +300 temperature, and drop the quasar glass's heat. Lower the explode power, or use w.shockwave plus clearing cover. At the burst, give each creature in reach status('levitate', 2) and push it outward (c.push away from the center with some upwa

rows.name: Ragnarok
rows.promise: The ground splits in jagged lines across a wide field; pale silver roots burst through the cracks and tangle what they touch; everyone is knocked down unharmed; the roots wither after a day.
rows.does: Paints seven flat basalt lines out from the target and clears every cover along them. It quakes six times, lifts and stuns every creature once for 2 seconds, grows pale dead trees on the lines and lays patches of silverroot cover that turn to rubble after 1440 seconds.
rows.missing: The cracks are flat dark paint with no real split, and the roots tangle nothing. Clearing cover along the lines, plus the quakes, wrecks about 18% of houses, though the entry says no one is harmed.
rows.fix: Cut the cracks with w.raise or w.terraform lowering the line cells instead of only setting basalt. Skip house cells on the lines and paint silverroot around them. Repeatedly stun creatures standing on silverroot so the roots visibly tangle, and keep the quakes gentle so houses stand.

rows.name: Rain
rows.promise: A soft drizzle over a village-wide circle that waters crops, settles dust and swells streams without flooding.
rows.does: Six grey clouds drift in and drop rain particles (snow where it is below freezing) for about 50 seconds. They lay thin water on fields, crops, dirt and ash, douse fires, steam lava and clear smoke, with no flood.

rows.name: Rainbow
rows.promise: A hovering arc of seven colored bands over a still basin that scatters light, reveals hidden paths, warms the cold and glows forever.
rows.does: Lays a 3-cell water pool in a rock ring with seven arcs of magic voxels above it, fires seven colored beams for 3 seconds, then an artifact that lights its surroundings by day and night, waters dry fields in drought and gives villagers water.
rows.missing: Nothing is revealed and nothing is warmed: no temperature change and no hidden path or thing uncovered. The 'light' effect just drives off night hunters, and scaring spirits is unasked for.
rows.fix: Add an act effect that warms nearby cold or frozen cells (w.temperature with a small plus, melting snow and ice within its radius) and one that reveals something, such as periodic colored w.beam rays plus w.light along a path or onto a nearby hidden landmark or creature. Drop the spirit scare.

rows.name: Rainbow Flame
rows.promise: A blaze in seven colored bands for a minute, about ten paces across: red scorches, gold heals, green rots weeds, blue chills, violet dims sight.
rows.does: A prism shard sends seven colored beams, then a turning wheel of colored glowing flame particles burns for 60 s. Red/orange bands hurt, burn and lightly ignite, gold heals, green clears bushes and flowers to dirt, blue cools and freezes, and violet stuns.

rows.name: Raise Dead
rows.promise: Soft, clay-like earth over graves; pale, harmless, obedient shades rise from the dead, walk one night, and turn to grey dust at dawn.
rows.does: Paints mud and a pale light with a drone, then revives up to 5 corpses within 0.4 w.r as wandering hooded shades (3 hp, weak to light, 120 s lifespan); with no corpses nearby nothing rises (test: 1 creature).
rows.missing: Nothing rises where there are no corpses. Shades cast by day die of daylight within seconds. They only wander, so they never look obedient, and there is no grey-dust end.
rows.fix: When w.corpses finds too few, w.spawn a few shades at the mud anyway. Drop weak light or raise hp so they last until dawn. Use behavior follow with a leader, or guard at the grave. Add onDeath "ash" or a grey burst when they fade.

rows.name: Rebuild
rows.promise: A silver seam races out and one broken cottage-sized structure (wall, bridge, cart) nearby knits itself back together for good.
rows.does: Draws a silver ring and flash, then sends glowing shards from up to 200 nearby rubble cells home, turning each into a house cell; with no rubble in reach (as in the test run) nothing changes at all.
rows.missing: Nothing happens where there is no rubble, broken walls or voxels are never mended, and up to 200 rubble cells can become houses, far more than one cottage.
rows.fix: Find the nearest rubble with w.nearest('rubble', x, y, w.r*1.5) and mend only that one ruin (a few cells) with w.building(x, y, {job:'house'}) or w.set 'house'; when there is none, glide the shards back into the nearest damaged house or wall so the player sees it knit, instead of ending on a ring an

rows.name: Reincarnation
rows.promise: Silver mist wraps a recently fallen body, which knits whole and wakes alive at full health.
rows.does: Draws a pale circle and steam mist, then for each corpse in reach a glowing cloud with spiralling motes gathers for 25 seconds before revive() raises it with a light and a burst. With no corpses it only shows the circle and mist.

rows.name: Remove Curse
rows.promise: A gold thread coils round the afflicted and draws the curse out as dark motes, lifting it for good from a person, object or patch of land.
rows.does: Draws a gold circle and an orb spiralling over the spot, then heals 5 and calms every creature within 0.6 r, hostile ones included, with a puff of dark and pale motes over each.
rows.missing: Nothing cursed is uncursed: undead stay undead, poison gas and blighted or cursed ground stay put, and fear, sleep or stun are never lifted, so it reads as a small generic heal.
rows.fix: Read w.here() first and lift curses only from the afflicted: transform its undead back to villager (or kill and revive them), give the cursed ones calm and heal(n), clear poison gas with w.clear(x, y, 'gas') in a small disc, and repaint ash or any spreading cursed material back to grass on the cell

rows.name: River Styx
rows.promise: A long, still black river between grey banks where the dead are laid to rest and whatever drinks from it sleeps a day and a night.
rows.does: Carves a winding black channel about 15 cells long with spreading grey banks, dead trees and a ferry model; every 8 s it puts every creature within 9 cells to sleep for 14 s, clears crops and fire, and spawns sleep-aura shades.
rows.missing: Nothing lays the dead to rest. Sleep hits anyone nearby for 14 s instead of drinkers for a long time. Scaring beasts keeps them from ever drinking. The shades die in daylight, and the river is small for a legendary region.
rows.fix: Add a pairs or act effect that takes corpses near the styx water (w.corpses, then clear them with a small grave or mist); sleep only creatures standing on or next to styx water cells, for a long duration; drop the beast scares and lure beasts to drink instead; spawn shades only at dusk (or remove th

rows.name: Rocket
rows.promise: A small silver-banded rocket that streaks skyward on golden flame and bursts into warm sparks above the rooftops.
rows.does: Places a slender banded rocket model; every 90 seconds it launches a golden flaming body that climbs about 28 voxels trailing embers, then bursts into a shower of falling warm sparks with a small flash. It also lights the area at night.

rows.name: Rocket Fleet
rows.promise: A hand-held bundle of brass rockets that leap up in glittering arcs and burst into colored blossoms of light in the sky.
rows.does: Draws a small brass-tube model with a brief light, then only lights the night every 60 s; the test run shows no bodies, so the rocket launch never runs.
rows.missing: The fireworks effect uses do: fleet (a function), which the engine drops, so no rockets ever fly or burst; the night 'light' effect stands in for the item's whole point and is not promised.
rows.fix: Move the launcher into act: {when:'every', every:25, cost:1, act(self,w){...launch the six meteor bodies that burst on descent...}} (or when:'night'/'dusk' so the blossoms show), and drop the unpromised do:'light' effect; optionally fire one volley on placement in cast.

rows.name: Saint
rows.promise: A glowing pale-gold winged knight of light that patrols village borders, guards sleepers and drives back night shadows.
rows.does: Spawns an ordinary villager titled Saint with the knight calling, places a static sword-and-floating-halo model beside it, and raises an hour-long ward dome with a pulsing light.
rows.missing: The Saint itself is a plain dressed villager, with no gold light, no wings and no armor of glow. Its halo floats on a separate model, not on it. Nothing walks the borders or drives shadows back; the dome does the guarding.
rows.fix: Declare a spell.creatures 'saint' (base golem or spirit, body two legs, features wings, armor, sword, glowing eyes, glow true, color #fff4c0, behavior guard, goal guard, prey undead and hostile, aura fear on night hunters), w.spawn it, and keep the ward only around it or the village. Drop the w.pers

rows.name: Shockwave
rows.promise: A pale gold dome of force bursts from the caster and shoves everything within about ten yards back, raising a ring of dust and leaving the pressed ground with a faint gold sheen.
rows.does: Gold flash, hum and glowing orb, then an expanding ring to 0.8 w.r that pushes each creature it reaches outward, lifts dust at its edge and leaves patches of glowing gold sheen that decay after 15 minutes.

rows.name: Sinkhole
rows.promise: Three stamps shake the ground and a ten-pace pit opens, swallowing those on it into cold dark mud, sealing again after an hour.
rows.does: Three quake jolts with shaking and rumble, then a dark circle, a crater about 5 cells across and 6 deep with a dirt rim and a mud floor; creatures inside are pushed down, stunned and frightened, and a one-hour body raises the land back and regrasses it.

rows.name: Sky Castle
rows.promise: A pale brick castle keep with towers held aloft above the clouds by Air, with a swaying spiral stair, high storm-watching balconies, and a small village of its own.
rows.does: Raises one ordinary watchtower building, draws a thin 0.7-cell pillar about 3.8 tall with a lamp and a few stair-like slats beside it, and every 30 seconds nudges the wind randomly and emits a single faint particle.
rows.missing: Nothing floats or reads as a castle: there is no keep, no towers aloft, no clouds, no real spiral stair or balconies, and no village of its own. The weather effect is an invisible wind nudge and one particle.
rows.fix: Lay a small w.village, then raise a w.island(x, y, {z: ~18, r: 4}) above it with a pale crenellated keep and round towers drawn with w.model or w.tower on it. Add a spiral stair of float voxels or model steps climbing from the ground to the island, with balconies at the top. Give the artifact a visi

rows.name: Sonic Boom
rows.promise: A double snap releases a pale blue ring of air that shoves everything nearby hard away, scatters leaves and dust, and cracks fragile things.
rows.does: Two zaps and a whoosh, pale blue shockwave rings, creatures within about 0.45 r pushed outward (harder near the center) and frightened, a few houses turned to rubble and flowers stripped, leaf and dust particles thrown out.

rows.name: Spaceflight
rows.promise: After a blue countdown the caster and up to three companions rocket high into the sky past clouds and birds, then drift back down to land softly where they stood a minute later.
rows.does: A blue beam and circle with three rising pings, then a roar and shake. Up to four nearest villagers (or a new Astronaut wizard) are carried on flame bodies to about 140 voxels past spawned clouds and birds under a darkened starry sky. They descend over about 16 seconds and are set back on their own

rows.name: Spaghettification
rows.promise: A person near the spot stretches long and thin toward an unseen point for about a minute, then snaps back unharmed, leaving a glowing rope-like scar of stretched ground that fades.
rows.does: Draws a fading spiral and wobbling threads on the ground for 60 s, tints nearby villagers (and creatures of kind 'beast') pale blue, stuns them, drags them to the center and grows them uniformly to about 1.5x, then calls resize(1) and untints them with a ping.
rows.missing: No one stretches: resize scales the whole body evenly, so they swell instead of narrowing like taffy. If resize compounds each frame, the per-frame call blows them up and resize(1) never restores them. The ground never stretches: the scar is only a canvas sketch. The 'beast' filter misses deer, rabb
rows.fix: Stretch each creature along one line instead of resizing it: lift it with push up to a few voxels, or stack a short column of thin glowing voxels or particles from its feet toward the unseen point, and remove them after 60 s. Call resize only once at the start and once at the end (or not at all). La

rows.name: Spellbook of Flight
rows.promise: A pale blue spellbook on a lectern whose drifting script lifts its readers and their companions off the ground.
rows.does: Draws a small lectern with a blue book; every 12 s it levitates any villagers within 6 cells for 4 s, with one glowing mote each and a soft whoosh.
rows.missing: Nothing draws readers to the book, so in the five-minute test it lifted anyone only once. The drifting letters are a single particle per villager. The 0.04-thick page part is below the 0.05 minimum and is not drawn.
rows.fix: Give the artifact lures: ['villager'] or grants [{what: 'prayer'}] so villagers come to read it. Emit a few rising letter particles from the open pages each time it fires. Make the page part at least 0.05 thick.

rows.name: Spirit Guide
rows.promise: A silver mist fox with trailing tails and gold eyes that leads people along safe paths through the land.
rows.does: Spawns one glowing silver spirit with gold eyes that wanders and explores, lures villagers after it, scares wolves, leaves flowers where it goes and grows plants now and then.
rows.missing: It is drawn as a generic floating spirit, not a fox. Its flower trail also contradicts the 'leaves no footprints' in its entry.
rows.fix: Use body 'four legs' (base spirit, flying, glow) with features ['tail', 'glowing eyes'] and a silver color so it reads as a mist fox. Drop leaves 'flowers', or swap it for a faint glowing path material that decays.

rows.name: Spirit Lights
rows.promise: Drifting green-violet aurora spirits that hover over people as wardens and lanterns, flaring brighter when danger nears and dimming to a pulse when calm.
rows.does: Spawns three glowing green-violet flying spirits that follow villagers, shield when an enemy is near, heal now and then and scare beasts, and raises an hour-long ward dome with a steady pulsing light over the spot.
rows.missing: Their signature warning is absent: nothing brightens when danger nears or dims when calm, so the reveal half is gone. The ward and light are a fixed dome on the spot, not carried by the lights, and outlast them if they die. The heal is not promised.
rows.fix: Give the spirit light an ability of its own, when 'enemy near', that calls w.light on itself in bright green and a w.beam or w.burst toward the threat, with only a faint pulse otherwise. Tie the ward to the creature, a short w.ward over the villagers it follows when an enemy is near, instead of a pe

rows.name: Star Hunter
rows.promise: A lean silver beast with stone claws and blue-fire eyes that leaves scorch marks and digs up meteor fragments, carrying them back.
rows.does: Lays six glowing 'meteor fragment' cells that lure villagers, then adds an ordinary villager guard titled Star Hunter.
rows.missing: No beast appears: the hunter is a plain human villager, with no silver hide, blue eyes or scorch trail, and it never seeks or carries the fragments itself.
rows.fix: Declare a spell.creatures kind 'star hunter' (base beast, four legs, silver color, glowing eyes, color2 blue, leaves ash or scorch) with a custom goal that seeks 'meteor fragment', works there and carries stone home, then w.spawn it instead of w.person.

rows.name: Starblade
rows.promise: A humming blue-white sword that cuts through stone, launches its wielder skyward in a burst of light, and pulls toward the stars.
rows.does: Draws a sword standing in a split boulder. Every 25 s it fires 6 random 12-cell rays that clear boulders and rubble and turn rock to dirt, but only if a ray happens to hit stone. By day it shoots one villager upward on a beam; at night it lifts nearby creatures; sparks fall every 4 s.
rows.missing: No one ever wields it, so the launch hits random villagers and nothing is a wielder. The stone cutting depends on random rays, so beside a village it barely happens (2 cells in the test run), and its harm never reaches anything but stone.
rows.fix: Add grants [{what: "arms"}] so a villager takes it up and is the one launched. Aim the cut at w.nearest("rock") or the nearest wall instead of random rays, so it slices visible stone each time.

rows.name: Starchild
rows.promise: A small glowing silver companion creature that calms frightened animals and eases the sick with a sleepy hum.
rows.does: Spawns one glowing cat-sized spirit that follows villagers, calms everyone within 5 cells, heals now and then, scares wolves and leaves flowers where it walks.

rows.name: Steam
rows.promise: A small sealed glass flask of swirling silver-white steam that hisses, warms the cold around it and can drive lifts that raise stones.
rows.does: It builds a stubby ring of whole-cell pale blocks 3 voxels tall around a blue disc. A cloud body hovers over it, puffs steam gas and adds +4 degrees in radius 3 every half second forever. A landmark heals and lures villagers.
rows.missing: No flask is drawn, only a block stump, and the steam leaks out of a vessel meant to be sealed. The healing aura is never promised. The heat stacks without limit. The lifting or driving power (move) is absent.
rows.fix: Draw the flask with one w.model (cyl glass body, narrow neck, stopper, glowing vapor inside). Make it a w.artifact whose effects act warms cold or frozen cells nearby to a capped temperature, with a faint steam wisp. Optionally have it lift a nearby boulder or push something with its pressure. Drop

rows.name: Stone Wall
rows.promise: A grey rock slab rises in a straight line ten paces long and three high, pushes anyone in its path aside, and crumbles to dust after a day.
rows.does: Raises a 10-cell, 3-high grey stone wall along an east-west line with a thump and a dust burst, and also throws a clear 30-second ward dome over the whole area.
rows.missing: A dome over the village is not a wall, and the entry never promises one. No one on the line is pushed aside, and the wall never crumbles back to dust.
rows.fix: Drop the w.ward. Before raising the wall, push each creature from w.creatures on the line aside with c.push. Build the slab from a declared stone material (w.build or w.set along w.line) with decays set to about a day and becomes dirt or sand, so it crumbles on its own.

rows.name: Storm
rows.promise: A dark churning cloud with driving rain and strong gusts over a valley for ten minutes that soaks crops, puts out every fire beneath it and knocks travelers over.
rows.does: Draws a spiral of grey particles and a dark cloud body that drifts for 600 s, sets a turning wind, and shows rain as particles only. Every half second it checks 40 random cells and wets the burning ones, makes crops grow, pushes creatures outward and frightens some, and strikes lightning every 5 s.
rows.missing: The rain is only a look: crops are never soaked and fires go out only when a random sample hits them (41 cells changed in the test). The lightning, which the entry never mentions, sets trees alight, the opposite of a storm that snuffs fires.
rows.fix: Each second, run w.disc over R to put out every cell with c.fire (w.set water) and lay a thin layer of water on field and crop cells. Drop the lightning or keep it off wood, and keep w.darken for the cloud's whole life.

rows.name: Storm Curse
rows.promise: A bruise-colored cloud rains on one village-square patch for an hour, soaks those inside, puts out flames, and drops a harmless lightning bolt each minute that singes the grass.
rows.does: Eight cloud bodies drift into one dark cloud over a 7-cell patch. Rain particles fall for an hour, creatures inside are tinted dark blue, and fires there are put out every 2 s. Starting at 60 s, a thin pale beam with a crackle sound leaves a small ash spot once a minute.
rows.missing: Nothing reaches the ground in the first minute: no bolt, no wet ground. The rain is only particles, so the cells never get damp. The 'lightning' is a faint beam with a crackle, with no thunder or flash, so it hardly reads as a strike. The test run changed 0 cells.
rows.fix: Strike once right after the cloud forms, then every 60 s. Give each strike a brighter, wider beam, w.flash, w.sound('boom') or 'rumble', and a small w.shake. Lay a light film of water or mud over the patch with w.paint(cx, cy, R, 'water', 0.3, 0.2) so the soaking shows on the land.

rows.name: Supersonic Flight
rows.promise: A traveler (or a few birds) launched with a thunderclap and flown faster than sound, leaving sonic cracks that shake leaves and rattle shutters along the path.
rows.does: Picks any nearby creature or a bird plus 3 spawned birds and gives them levitate. A glowing meteor body then drags them at about w.r*0.15 cells/s (a slow glide) for 9 seconds, with a small shockwave, boom, jolt and unvoxel every 1.5 s.
rows.missing: Nothing about it is supersonic: the streak crawls a few cells a second and covers only ~20 cells, and the takeoff is a soft thump, not a thunderclap. Leaves are deleted by unvoxel rather than shaken loose, and the flight ends after 9 s, not ten minutes.
rows.fix: Launch with w.sound('boom') plus w.shake and a big w.shockwave. Move the body at several w.r per second, looping or zigzagging across the valley for the whole cast. At each crack, drop leaf particles (w.burst) over trees and houses near the path instead of w.unvoxel. Prefer a villager from w.here().

rows.name: Swamp
rows.promise: A valley-sized dark bog of mud and standing pools, with reeds, rising bubbles and rot, that slows whoever crosses it.
rows.does: It shapes the land into a swamp with w.land, floods water and mud pools, and paints a dark bog that keeps creeping over grass and fields. It grows willows, dead trees and brush, and sends up a few bubbles and steam while it is cast.

rows.name: Swamp Wraith
rows.promise: A lean, mud-and-shadow wraith trailing black fog rises from the reeds to guard fens and lead travelers off dangerous boggy ground, then sinks back into the murk.
rows.does: Puffs smoke and spawns one dark hooded spirit that stays put. It lures villagers to itself, leaves mud wherever it walks, digs every 40 s and teleports when hurt.
rows.missing: Nothing leads travelers off dangerous ground. Its mud trail makes ground more boggy, not safer, and luring villagers to a mud-maker draws them into the bog. Guard has no prey, so it guards against nothing. Its fog is only a puff at arrival, and it never sinks back.
rows.fix: Give it a custom goal that seeks villagers standing on mud, deep water or near fire and moves them to the nearest dry ground (w.nearest of grass, then push or teleport). Add a prey list (hostile, wolf) for its guard. Replace the mud trail with a low black fog gas material, and have it sink into mud

rows.name: Thunderclap
rows.promise: A loud rolling boom and a pale blue ring of air that shoves everything nearby back, flings dust and leaves, and briefly knocks small creatures down, leaving the ground unharmed.
rows.does: Flashes, booms and draws a pale blue circle, then grows blue shockwaves outward to 1.2 w.r. Each creature it reaches is pushed away from the center and stunned for 1.5 s, while dust and leaf particles fly outward. A rumble and a second, softer boom linger afterward, and the land is left untouched.

rows.name: Tidal Wave
rows.promise: A great rolling wall of seawater rises from nearby water, surges about twenty paces, knocks back and hurts foes, scatters small creatures, then leaves a shallow flood that drains after a minute.
rows.does: A blue cloud-look body (r 3) rolls 24 cells due east from just west of the target, flooding water along an 8-cell-wide strip and pushing every creature it touches east and up.
rows.missing: The wave is an 8-cell blob, far too small for a grand valley-scale spell. It always starts at the target heading east instead of rising from the nearest water. It does no harm (no hurt) and treats villagers like foes, and nothing drains the flood after a minute.
rows.fix: Start at w.nearest('water') and aim with w.angle toward w.x, w.y. Make the front span about w.r with w.line across the heading, shown as a row of tall water bodies or voxels rather than one cloud. Call c.hurt on hostile and animal creatures as you push them. After about 60 seconds, w.drain the soake

rows.name: Tidecaller's Tome
rows.promise: A sea-green water tome that calls up small waves, calms rough currents and reads the moods of distant harbors.
rows.does: Stands on a lectern; every 30 s it pulses a small light ring and a spray of sparkles and trims deep water within 5 cells by 10%, waters fields in drought, and grants villagers water.
rows.missing: No wave is ever called: the ring is a 2-cell flash and the depth trim is invisible. Calming does nothing a player could see, nothing reveals distant harbors, and away from water it only sparkles.
rows.fix: In act, find w.nearest('water') and send a wave across it: a body with look 'cloud' (white foam) moving over the water with a 'splash' sound, laying a brief w.flood strip of water along its path. Calm the water by setting w.wind(0, 0) and giving creatures in it 'calm'. Briefly light the nearest vill

rows.name: Tornado
rows.promise: A spinning wind funnel that tears across the land for a minute, lifting stones, scattering crops, tossing small creatures up and setting them down, leaving a flattened scar.
rows.does: Draws a circle, adds wind, then a low 'cloud' blob drifts about 1.4 cells/s for 60 s. Its path turns grass to dirt and deletes crops, and it swirls and lifts nearby creatures.
rows.missing: There is no spinning column: it uses look 'cloud' at z 0 instead of a vortex funnel. No stones or debris are lifted, crops simply vanish rather than scatter, and creatures get no gentle set-down.
rows.fix: Use look 'vortex' (or stacked rising particles) for a tall funnel. Pull boulder/rubble cover into orbiting w.particle debris, and w.burst crop-colored bits as crops clear. Cap the lift and reduce the push once creatures leave the funnel so they come down gently.

rows.name: Tsunami
rows.promise: The earth shudders, then a dark curling wall of water rolls across the land, tossing creatures, scattering crops and wrecking things, and drains within a minute to leave mud.
rows.does: Quakes and shakes the ground, then sweeps a band of water across about 2.4 w.r. The front clears crops, turns some houses to rubble and trees to stumps, throws dark-water and foam particles forward, and pushes, stuns and hurts the creatures it reaches. The water drains in two stages (about 22 s and

rows.name: Twilight Flame
rows.promise: A dusk-colored flame drifts to the target and burns for a minute, searing away curses, darkness and the undead without harming the living, and leaves what it touches glowing silver.
rows.does: Dims the sky and whispers, then a violet-gold flame body drifts to the target and hovers for 64 s. Each second it lights the area, hurts undead and hostiles, frightens hostiles and calms the living while tinting them silver for 10 minutes. Every 2 s it clears poison and smoke and turns some ash and

rows.name: Undead Legion
rows.promise: A single towering host of knotted skeletons and rusted chain that marches slowly and grinds down walls and armies.
rows.does: Raises one large armored, horned golem-bodied undead (900 hp) out of a patch of grave dust. It marches on houses, quakes them into rubble, sheds skeleton spearmen, raises the dead at night, scares villagers and fights big beasts.

rows.name: Undead Plague
rows.promise: A grey mist spreads over fields and villages, sickening the living, who then rise as shambling corpses.
rows.does: Paints spreading grey 'grave rot' soil, releases poison gas with wind and grey bursts for about 10 s, turns corpses already in reach into shamblers and spawns 6 shamblers that hunt villagers and convert their victims.
rows.missing: The shamblers are weak to light with no night handling, so a daytime cast likely loses them within seconds. Villagers the mist kills later never rise, because only corpses present at 2.5 s are raised. Six shamblers is small for legendary.
rows.fix: Drop 'light' from the shambler's weak list (or give it active: 'night' with a den or shade to wait in), re-run the corpses-to-revive-and-transform loop on each gas tick so mist victims rise, and spawn shamblers across the gassed area scaled to w.r.

rows.name: Unicorn
rows.promise: A white horse with a spiral horn and a rainbow mane that heals wounded animals and stills nearby water.
rows.does: Spawns a glowing white four-legged unicorn with horn, mane and tail. It wanders and tends, leaves flowers, heals every 15 s and scares wolves. Every 20 s it re-floods the nearest water and draws a pale circle with a crystal sound.

rows.name: Void Nexus
rows.promise: A void-and-ley crossing that pulls things in and sends those who step on it through the ground to a far place, with cold, silent stone around it and violet-dimmed sky and bending starlight above.
rows.does: Lays cold voidstone with a crystal ley line, draws a stone ring around a black orb, and raises a twin exit stone across the island. Every 2 s it pulls creatures within 7 cells inward and beams the one at its heart to the exit, sometimes sending one back. At night starlight particles spiral in under

rows.name: Void Storm
rows.promise: A spiral of violet lightning that peels whirling shadows off the ground, dims the lights, numbs everyone inside for a minute and flings loose stones, branches and dust into a spinning ring that settles after ten minutes.
rows.does: Darkens and tints the region under a violet vortex. A 26-strike spiral of violet lightning winds inward, each strike with muffled thumps and a dark swarm that whirls and rises. Everyone within 1.2 R is stunned for 60 s and briefly frightened. Rubble, boulders, bushes and stumps are lifted into a rin

rows.name: Wall of Force
rows.promise: A flat violet pane about 12 wide and 3 tall that hums like a bell and blocks arrows, flame and charging beasts for an hour.
rows.does: Lays a single row of violet magic voxels one high across the spot, then raises a round ward dome of radius w.r (asked for 3600 s, capped at 600) that keeps out fire, fluids and beasts, with a flash, sparks and a chime.
rows.missing: The wall itself: the player sees a dome, not a standing pane three tall, the hum is a chime rather than a struck bell, and the hour lasts ten minutes at most.
rows.fix: Stack magic voxels at z 1 to 3 along a line about 12 cells long to form a translucent violet pane, back it with a few small w.ward calls along that line (seconds 600) instead of one big dome, use the gong sound, and burst drifting motes along the pane when it ends.

rows.name: Ward
rows.promise: A pale grey shimmering circle that pushes back and stops blades, beasts and gusts for a long while, then fades, leaving a faint chill.
rows.does: Raises a pale grey ward dome over the spot for 600 seconds against fire, fluids, lightning, creatures, harm and cold, marks it with a grey ground circle, and adds a small glowing book block and four 14-voxel stone spires; the test run blocked 54–91% of the harm.

rows.name: Warlock
rows.promise: A hooded, shadow-edged warlock that lurks outside the light as a sentinel and whisperer, carrying messages through the dark.
rows.does: Plays a drone, draws a dark circle, then adds one villager to the nearest village with calling necromancer and title Warlock, with a puff of dark particles.
rows.missing: Nothing makes it a watcher or messenger: its necromancer calling gives it dead-raising work the entry never mentions, and no smoky shadow marks its arrival.
rows.fix: Give w.person a sentinel-like job (watchtower or guard, active at night on the village edge) instead of calling 'necromancer', and open with a small w.gas smoke puff and a 'whisper' sound rather than a drone and burst.

rows.name: Werewolf
rows.promise: A grey, amber-eyed wolf-man that roams and hunts by moonlight, guards camps, howls warnings at strangers and spreads its curse by bite.
rows.does: Raises a 60-second ward dome over the spot, then spawns one grey two-legged werewolf that stands guard where it was placed and only acts when an enemy comes near; its curse needs a wolf or boar within 2 cells at night and a 30% roll.
rows.missing: The test saw it idle: its howl fires only on an enemy and the curse almost never triggers. It guards in place instead of roaming and hunting by moonlight, roars instead of howling, and is weak to light with no den to survive the day. The village ward is not a werewolf's doing.
rows.fix: Remove w.ward. Give it a night-roaming goal (hunt, or a custom goal that seeks wolf/boar and transforms them, so its bite carries the curse). Make the howl fire on when "night" every ~30s with w.sound('howl') and fear on non-villager strangers. Raise the curse reach to ~6 cells. Give it a day den or

rows.name: Whirlwind
rows.promise: A small dust-and-leaf funnel sent at a group of foes that, for ten seconds, gently tosses them off their feet and spins them a few paces in every direction, harmlessly, leaving scattered leaves.
rows.does: After a whoosh and a ground circle, a 'swarm'-look body starts west of the target and drifts east in a straight line for 10 s. It nudges creatures within 3 cells sideways and slightly up each frame, drops an occasional leaf particle, then ends in a short-lived burst of leaf colors.
rows.missing: The funnel is drawn as a 'swarm' (reads as insects), not a vortex. It slides along a fixed east-west line instead of going after the foes. Its tiny pushes barely toss anyone, it never flings them outward, and no leaves are left on the ground afterward.
rows.fix: Use look 'vortex' with dust and leaf colors. Aim it with b.seek at the nearest group from w.here().hostile, or at creatures near w.x, w.y. Give stronger, periodic push(dx, dy, up) kicks with a final outward fling. Lay real scattered leaves with a light w.paint of 'flower', or a leaf cover, along its

rows.name: World
rows.promise: A cosmic starlit ring across the horizon that raises hills, rivers and forests over a whole region under drifting constellations, lasting until dawn.
rows.does: Raises one hill of radius 10 with a small pond, a 10-cell water line, 10 trees, grass, flowers and a globe model, plus a few drifting star bodies; at night more stars drift, and at dawn it adds a bump and three trees.
rows.missing: Far too small for cosmic: it touched 4% of the island with a 13-cell circle instead of a horizon ring and reshaped no region. It also never ends at dawn; it renews itself instead.
rows.fix: Work at w.r across the island: ring of starlight (w.circle and w.shockwave) near the island edge, several w.land hills and a valley or canyon carrying a long river, w.grow forests in many places, and a wide camera; make the dawn effect smooth the land back or end the artifact instead of regrowing it

rows.name: Adam
rows.promise: A green-skinned man of living clay who walks the land tending gardens, waking seeds where he steps.
rows.does: Spawns one Adam creature (green two-legged figure with a basket) with goal tend that leaves flowers where he walks, grows plants, heals, calms nearby creatures and sometimes casts Rain, arriving with a heartbeat and a patch of flowers.

rows.name: Alchemy
rows.promise: A honey-gold elixir with silver threads that transmutes substances, such as lead to gold or stone to clear crystal.
rows.does: Lays a glowing honey-gold pool in a rock rim. Every 12 s it turns nearby rock into crystal and dirt into gold, which lures villagers to carry it home. It also sends gold to the nearest village.

rows.name: Alpha Werewolf
rows.promise: A silver werewolf that appears for one night to guard a single herd, hearth or camp, steadies those near it with its howl, and fades at dawn.
rows.does: Spawns one glowing silver four-legged beast that roams and hunts wolves, boars and bears, calms creatures within 5 cells and howls every 25 s to calm them again, then expires after 240 s.
rows.missing: It never guards anything: its behavior and goal are hunt, so it wanders after prey instead of staying by a herd or hearth, and with active night it may idle if placed by day.
rows.fix: Set behavior 'guard' and goal 'guard' with prey ['wolf','bear','hostile'], spawn it beside w.nearest('village') or the nearest animal herd, drop or relax active:'night' so it guards when placed by day, and keep the calming howl.

rows.name: Angel
rows.promise: A pale gold winged figure, about a tall man's height, that holds back the dark and heals and saves the living near death.
rows.does: Raises a static column of magic voxels about 11 tall with two detached bars for wings, a sphere head and a halo ring. It places a 300 s ward and an artifact that lights the night, heals the hurt, revives the dead nearby and shields every 60 s.
rows.missing: The Angel is a creature that never appears as one: it is a frozen voxel pillar, five times a man's height, with wings that never stir, not a moving winged figure.
rows.fix: Declare an 'angel' in spell.creatures (base spirit, flying, glow, features wings and halo/crown, colors pale gold, goal tend, aura heal, ability heal when a friend is hurt, revive the dead) and w.spawn it. If it stays an artifact, draw it about 2 tall with w.model in fine parts instead of w.box and

rows.name: Animate Stone
rows.promise: A tapped boulder shudders, grows stubby limbs and rises as a slow stone servant that digs, carries and stands watch for an hour.
rows.does: Rumbles and draws a circle, then clears up to 8 boulders or rubble piles nearby, each with a jolt and a burst of stone chips, and spawns a slow golem 'stone servant' that guards, digs every 25 s and lasts 3600 s; with no stones near, it spawns one at the target.

rows.name: Arcane Barrage
rows.promise: A fan of up to five glittering violet bolts that streak out, each stinging one nearby foe for a few points and dazing it.
rows.does: Casts a violet circle and flash, then launches five glowing violet shards that home on the five nearest non-villager creatures, dealing 3 harm and a 3-second stun on contact. They move at about 1.5 cells per second and last 2 seconds. In the test run no creature was touched.
rows.missing: The bolts crawl instead of streaking. With a 2 s life at about 1.6 cells/s they die about 3 cells out, so targets near the edge of the 0.8 w.r search are never hit, and the test changed 0 creatures.
rows.fix: Raise vx/vy and the seek speed to about 15 to 20 cells/s and keep life near 1.5 s, so every chosen target within w.r*0.8 is reached and gets hurt(3) and status('stun', 3). Optionally aim at hostile creatures first (w.nature(c) === 'hostile') before wild animals.

rows.name: Arcane Surge
rows.promise: A violet wave of humming light rolls outward, swirling the grass, flaring lanterns and lifting every creature it passes for about three seconds before setting them down.
rows.does: A violet flash, a zap and sparks, then a glowing ring that widens to about 1.3 w.r. Glowing particles circle its edge at ground level, and every creature the ring reaches levitates for 3 seconds.

rows.name: Archaeologist
rows.promise: A slow bone-and-amber creature that wanders ruins and cliffsides, digs out buried relics and reads old stone.
rows.does: Spawns a slow bone-colored, amber-eyed two-legged creature with a lantern. It walks to rock, digs for 5 seconds, leaves dirt, and carries gold home to the village. Every 40 seconds it glows briefly as it 'reads the stone'.

rows.name: Armada
rows.promise: A huge silver sky-ship with starlit sails that ferries sailors and cargo across the island and settles on the water when its voyage ends.
rows.does: Two small flying silver figures appear after a flash. They wander between villages, popping sparkles and adding gold, eat fish, cast Rain every 90 s and strike enemies with lightning.
rows.missing: It never carries any sailor or villager and never rests on water. At radius 2.4 it is a small figure rather than a great vessel for a legendary tier, and the rain and lightning are not part of its promise.
rows.fix: Spawn one armada with a larger radius (about 6) and a hull-and-mast model. Give it a custom 'ferry' goal: seek a village, then teleport a nearby villager to another village and carry gold there. At dusk have it seek water and rest there (active: day). Drop the Rain cast and the lightning ability.

rows.name: Army of the Dead
rows.promise: A legendary shambling host of bone and grave-cloth that rises from the earth and guards, marches or holds a road for its summoner until the night's work is done.
rows.does: A small quake and a patch of grave dirt, then one bone marshal and two spear-skeletons appear. The marshal holds near a village, hunts wolves and bears, and musters one more skeleton every 25 s (up to 8) and raises the dead every 35 s. All crumble to grave dirt after 10 to 15 minutes.
rows.missing: At arrival it is three figures, not an army. A legendary host only builds up over minutes, the 'one grinding mass' never shows when placed, and its end is tied to a timer rather than to night or dawn.
rows.fix: Spawn the full host at once in the cast: the marshal plus about 12 to 16 legion bones clawing up in ranks over 1 to 2 s, each with a grave-dirt burst. Raise the muster cap to about 20 to refill losses, and end it at dawn (or make it active: "night" with a den) so it matches 'until the night's work i

rows.name: Ascension
rows.promise: A golden spiral stairway of light unfurls; every soul lifts about 30 m, floats for an hour on a thread of starlight, then drifts back down.
rows.does: Draws a rising golden spiral of beams over a magic circle, then levitates every creature on the island for 3600 s, pushing each up to about z 30 with a trailing star body that follows it and vanishes when it lands.

rows.name: Ash
rows.promise: A small blackened patch of warm gray cinders under lingering smoke, where a brief flame rekindles once a day.
rows.does: Paints a radius-4 spot with ash and clears its cover. It warms the ground, releases smoke and a few embers, then leaves an artifact that flares a small fire and heat at dawn and puffs smoke every 30 seconds.

rows.name: Assassination
rows.promise: A silent shadow-curtain that hides whoever it touches for an hour, so guards and crowds overlook them (the name itself suggests a silent kill).
rows.does: Draws closing dark arcs and a puff of dark motes, then tints creatures in reach dark and keeps them calm for an hour, each with a glowing star hovering over its head.
rows.missing: Nothing makes the touched creatures go unnoticed: calm only soothes the cloaked themselves, and the glowing star marker makes them more visible, not less.
rows.fix: Drop the glowing star mark (use look 'none'). Have each follower body's tick calm or sleep the guards, hostiles and villagers within 3 to 4 cells of the cloaked creature every few seconds, so watchers ignore them. Optionally give the cloaked a faint dark particle trail instead of a beacon.

rows.name: Astral Storm
