rows.promise: A churning dark dome crawling with silver lightning pulled over one place for a minute: those inside are blinded and buffeted by scattering gusts, then glittering ash is left behind.
rows.does: Thirty dark cloud bodies sink into a rotating dome for 60 s under a night darken. Silver beams crawl over its skin and occasional real lightning strikes inside. Everyone beneath is feared for 60 s and pushed by shifting gusts with debris bursts. At the end it fades in a glittering burst and paints g

rows.name: Atlantis
rows.promise: A small white-stone Atlantis isle of terraces and glowing bronze-ringed canals, with a warm ember heart steaming through gardens, that revives groves and rebuilds shorelines.
rows.does: Raises a single hill with grass, a sand-and-coral rim and an ember-rock core, adds white towers, arches, blossoming trees and steam, and lays two water rings beside glowing bronze bands; the artifact then grows plants at dawn, steams, regrows ash or dirt patches and turns shallow water into coral.
rows.missing: The canals are 1-deep water set on a sloping hill and will likely run off, leaving only bronze bands. There are no stepped terraces. Placed by a village, the terraform crushed about 15% of its houses (housesLeft 0.85).
rows.fix: Cut the canals with w.land or lower the ring cells before w.flood, so the water sits level and stays. Build the terraces as stepped w.terraform or w.build rings at falling heights. Check w.wouldHurt and shrink R or shift the centre off houses before terraforming.

rows.name: Avalanche
rows.promise: A churning slab of mud and rubble rolls about thirty paces, burying and pinning those in its path for about a minute, then leaves soaked ground and scattered stones.
rows.does: After a rumble and quake, a brown cloud body sweeps about 35 cells east across the target. It lays mud and the odd boulder along a strip about 6 cells wide and stuns every creature it touches for 60 s, then ends in a patch of dirt and a thump.

rows.name: Avatar
rows.promise: A luminous, many-faced figure that walks among villages for a season, settling quarrels and guiding them, then fades back into light.
rows.does: Spawns a glowing two-legged 'avatar' with behavior and goal guard, so it stays near where it lands. Its calm aura (radius 7) quiets fights, it heals every 20 s, raises the dead, scares beasts, and after 900 s dies into seeds.
rows.missing: It never walks among villages or guides them (guard keeps it near its spot; it moved 16 cells in two minutes). It scares beasts and raises the dead, which the entry never mentions. It ends in seeds, not fading into light.
rows.fix: Make it roam: behavior wander, plus a custom goal that seeks village and uses an act that reads w.fights(x, y, 6) and gives both attacker and target status('calm', 10). Drop scares: ['beast'] and the raise-the-dead ability. Replace onDeath seeds with a fade into light, e.g. a glowing material or a b

rows.name: Banish
rows.promise: A pale glowing circle that pulls every spirit and restless dead within ten paces toward the caster and casts them out, leaving the living untouched.
rows.does: Draws a pale circle and a rising ring, spirals every creature whose kind is exactly "spirit" in toward the center over four seconds, then bursts and kills them; the living are spared.
rows.missing: Only the built-in "spirit" kind is caught: undead (ghosts, skeletons, the restless dead) and custom spirit kinds such as wisps are never touched, though the entry names them first.
rows.fix: Select targets with w.nature(c) === "spirit" || w.nature(c) === "undead" instead of c.kind === "spirit", and optionally add a brief w.temperature(x, y, R, -5) for the lingering chill.

rows.name: Banish Undead
rows.promise: A blue-white halo of fire hangs for a minute; any undead it touches pales, crumbles to grey ash and its spirit drifts away, while the living pass unharmed.
rows.does: A glowing ring body hangs 4 voxels up over the target for 60 s. Undead whose kind matches a name regex and who come within 1.5 cells of its rim get tinted pale and frightened, then after 2.5 s turn to a patch of grey ash with a rising spirit orb and die.
rows.missing: It finds undead by a name regex, so undead kinds like vampire, ghost, banshee or spectre are never touched. Undead standing inside the halo, away from its rim, are never touched either, so a horde under the ring can survive the whole minute.
rows.fix: Detect undead with w.nature(c) === 'undead' (or w.here().undead) instead of the regex, and doom every undead within R of the center rather than only those near the rim.

rows.name: Banshee
rows.promise: A cold blue flame spirit that guards a hall or valley and keens warnings, a wail that chills and frightens whoever comes too close.
rows.does: Spawns one glowing blue flying spirit after a whisper and a burst; it hunts rabbits, deer and birds, scares villagers, and casts freeze now and then.
rows.missing: It never wails: no keening, only a whisper and a drone at arrival. It guards nothing, since it hunts small game and frightens the villagers it should be warning or protecting.
rows.fix: Use behavior 'guard' with prey ['hostile', 'undead'] (or the night hunters, such as wolf) instead of rabbit, deer and bird. Give it a fear aura or a custom ability that plays w.sound('howl') as a keening wail and puts fear and freeze on intruders near its post. Drop scares: ['villager'] so it warns

rows.name: Baptism
rows.promise: A silver thread of water rises and veils a target, washing away curses, poisons and fevers, calming the mind for an hour, and cleansing a stretch of river when cast on one.
rows.does: A glowing orb rises, then a ward lasts an hour over the reach, everyone nearby is healed 4 and calmed for an hour, and glowing droplets drift down.
rows.missing: Nothing is actually cleansed: poison gas, acid and tainted water stay, and casting on a river does nothing different. The hour-long dome that stops lava and raiders is not what the entry describes and is too much for a cantrip.
rows.fix: Clear the poison gas (w.clear gas) and any acid or poison fluid in the spot. On water (w.here().water), clear acid and poison along a line about 30 cells down the current. Heal and calm whoever it touches, then drop the lasting ward or cut it to a short veil.

rows.name: Bard
rows.promise: A slender singer whose voice carries far, rouses sleepers and shatters glass or ice with a held note.
rows.does: Adds a villager titled Bard and hires one villager for a 'sing' job: now and then a small golden ring, a faint whisper sound, and any ice or crystal within about 1.5 cells is cleared.
rows.missing: The song is a whisper, not a song, and rousing sleepers is absent. The shattering reach is tiny and seldom meets ice or crystal by a village. The hired singer may not even be the Bard.
rows.fix: In act, use w.sound('pluck' or 'choir') with musical note particles, and shatter over the full radius 3 (drop the k>0.5 test). Also wake sleeping villagers and creatures nearby with w.creatures plus a short calm status, and burst glass voxels with w.unvoxel. Hire the Bard himself, or give the person

rows.name: Barrow Downs
rows.promise: A grey, cold rolling downland with a ring of sunken burial mounds and ancient stones that hush magic, hold the place still, and hum softly on quiet nights.
rows.does: Raises a ring of six low mounds around a central rise, paints spreading grey barrow grass, chills the soil, sets a ring of eight standing stones round a pale glowing slab, keeps a lasting ward over the area, and hums with a faint light and drone at night.

rows.name: Barrow Haunt
rows.promise: A misty hollow of pale barrow hills and old graves where blue lanterns burn at dusk, the restless dead stir, and the mist thickens on those who linger.
rows.does: Raises one hill with pale grass that creeps over nearby grass, puffs smoke once, and draws a ring of six headstones and three blue glowing lanterns. Afterwards it summons fear-aura wisps at night, revives a corpse every 45 s and casts light at dusk.
rows.missing: The mist is a single smoke puff at arrival and never returns or thickens. The land is one hill, not a hollow among barrow mounds.
rows.fix: Add an effect {when:'night', every:20, act(self,w){w.gas(self.x,self.y,6,'steam',0.4)}} for a returning mist, and shape the land as a valley ringed by two or three small w.terraform mounds (the barrows) instead of a single hill.

rows.name: Barrow Wight
rows.promise: A pale frost-mist wight that stays at a tomb or crypt, drifts among the stones and freezes intruders still until dawn.
rows.does: Chills a small patch with a cold circle and a burst of mist, then spawns one glowing hooded frost spirit that roams (goal explore), hunts wild animals, scares villagers, leaves ice and casts freeze on nearby enemies.
rows.missing: It never guards anything: it wanders off exploring and hunts beasts instead of staying put and chilling whoever intrudes near its tomb, and the freeze is not tied to lasting until dawn.
rows.fix: Set behavior 'guard' and goal 'guard' so it stays where it is spawned, set prey to intruders such as ['villager','beast'], and keep the freeze ability on 'enemy near', optionally with status 'freeze' long enough to hold them through the night; optionally add a small w.model of grave stones or a barr

rows.name: Basilisk
rows.promise: A small mottled green serpent with silver-ringed eyes that fades from sight and reappears somewhere unexpected.
rows.does: Spawns one small green serpent that hunts rabbits by day and teleports every 15 seconds and whenever hurt; the test saw it roam, chase a rabbit and use its magic 8 times.

rows.name: Basilisk Brood
rows.promise: A nest of small glowing slate serpents, kept in warm sand as watchdogs, whose gaze puts intruders to sleep until dawn, and which multiply into a whole nest.
rows.does: Hisses, bursts green sparks and spawns three glowing slate serpents that guard their spot by night with a 3-cell sleep aura, freeze enemies every 20 s, dig, hunt rabbits and respawn one copy when killed.
rows.missing: The sleep aura hits everyone nearby, villagers included, not only intruders. The freeze ability is not in the entry. There is no warm-sand nest. The brood never grows: a death only replaces itself one for one.
rows.fix: Add scares: ['wolf','boar','bear','undead'] or similar so the sleep aura touches only intruders. Replace the freeze ability with {do: 'summon', when: 'every so often', every: 120} so the brood multiplies. Paint a small patch of sand under them with w.paint(w.x, w.y, 2, 'sand', 0.8). Drop the nonexis

rows.name: Black Mirror
rows.promise: A mirror that shows a faint double of whoever gazes into it, a copy that moves a heartbeat late.
rows.does: Draws a small obsidian mirror on a stand and spawns one dark glowing spirit that follows any villager. Every 30 s the mirror only draws a beam to the nearest villager and whispers.
rows.missing: No villager ever gets their own double: the one Echo is a generic spirit spawned once, not a copy of a gazer. The recurring effect is just a flash and a sound.
rows.fix: In the effect's act, when a villager is within radius, w.spawn an Echo beside that villager and copy its look: give Echo body 'two legs', a translucent villager-like color and a lifespan of about 60. Set it to follow that villager so it trails a heartbeat late, and drop the lone spirit spawned in ca

rows.name: Blight
rows.promise: A sour mist spreads from the caster, greying grass, curling leaves and cracking bark, and weakens plants and small creatures for a day before the soil recovers.
rows.does: Eight green mist clouds drift out painting a grey 'blight' ground that spreads over grass, fields and flowers and decays to dirt. Poison gas and five hits of 3 damage strike rabbits, birds, boars and villagers, and every creature gets a green tint.
rows.missing: Trees, bushes and crops never wither, so there are no curled leaves or cracked bark. The 'weakening' is only damage plus a cosmetic tint, and the poison gas kills some villagers (6% lost). The blighted patch (about 5% of the island) is small for a grand valley-wide spell.
rows.fix: Wither cover in reach: turn a share of trees to 'dead' style or stumps and crops or bushes to a withered material. Weaken small creatures with a lasting status or slow instead of repeated hurt and poison gas. Paint blight across about w.r rather than w.r*0.5.

rows.name: Blood Moon
rows.promise: A crimson moon rises over the whole island for a night, and every creature beneath it grows restless and jumpy.
rows.does: A red beam climbs to a glowing crimson voxel moon high above the island. The whole land is darkened and tinted red for 300 seconds. Every 2 seconds every creature on the island is jostled, and some are briefly frightened into bolting.

rows.name: Bloom
rows.promise: Green shoots and oversized flowers rise in a small circle, ease the hunger of creatures inside for a day, then wither into compost.
rows.does: Draws a green circle, lays grass, raises six 5-voxel green stalks, scatters flowers and growth, then for about 10 minutes heals and calms creatures in the circle before clearing the plants into dark dirt.

rows.name: Bog
rows.promise: Land sinks into a dark breathing mire that swallows paths and slows and harms intruders who walk in it.
rows.does: Shapes a swamp, paints a patch of dark 'bog mire' ground that slowly spreads into grass, dirt and fields, and puffs smoke every 20 s, with a small mound model.
rows.missing: Nothing slows or harms anyone. The mire has no hurts, there is no slowing effect, and no artifact act touches creatures, so the promised harm never happens. Smoke reads as fire, not wet breath.
rows.fix: Give the artifact an act that finds creatures on bog mire cells (w.creatures plus w.cell) and applies a short stun with a little hurt, or set hurts on the material. Swap the smoke for steam or poison gas and lay some mud for the sucking muck.

rows.name: Bog Mummy
rows.promise: A shuffling peat-and-linen mummy that guards sunken shrines, hauls loads through bogs, leaves water-filled footprints and hums a sad tune.
rows.does: Spawns one hooded, lantern-carrying bog mummy that guards, leaves mud and scares wolves, beside a small grave-marker model, and raises an hour-long ward dome over the whole area.
rows.missing: Most of the protection comes from a village-wide dome, not from the mummy guarding anything. It never carries loads. The heal and lantern are not in its entry. Its hum is only a hiss when it spawns.
rows.fix: Remove lib.lastingWard and the heal ability so the mummy's guard goal does the protecting. Add a custom goal that hauls stone or wood (carry) across mud or water to the village. Replace the lantern with a staff or no item, and play a low 'drone' as it rises."

rows.name: Boogeyman
rows.promise: A man-tall smoky shadow with a pale face that keeps watch over sleeping villagers and frightens off thieves and prowlers without ever harming anyone.
rows.does: Spawns one dark hooded spirit with glowing eyes that guards its spot, scares beasts, and gives off a fear aura on everyone within 3 cells. It is weak to daylight, active at night, and teleports now and then.
rows.missing: The fear aura is unscoped, so it also terrifies the villagers and children it is meant to watch over. It does not guard a home or sleepers and does nothing about thieves or hostiles. It is weak to light with nowhere to wait out the day. There is no pale face.
rows.fix: Drop the blanket aura 'fear' and set scares: ['beast','hostile'] plus any thief kinds such as goblin. Use goal 'guard' on the nearest house (spawn it beside w.nearest('house')). Give it a pale color2 for the face. Either remove weak: ['light'] or have it wait as mist in shade until dusk.

rows.name: Breath of Life
rows.promise: A pale green mist drifts to the target and restores the exhausted or lightly wounded, strongest on living creatures.
rows.does: A green cloud floats to the spot and revives every corpse there, then heals creatures under 10 hp by 1.5 a second for 6 seconds and sprouts a little grass.
rows.missing: It raises the dead, which a cantrip that only eases exhaustion and minor wounds never promises, and it skips wounded creatures that have 10 hp or more.
rows.fix: Drop the corpses/revive() call, heal every creature in w.here().wounded (or all creatures within R) with c.heal(n) whatever their hp, and drop or keep the w.grow aftermath small..

rows.name: Cave
rows.promise: A floating bubble of dim stone with glowing walls over an ever-open sinkhole pit, a pocket shelter and a cool store out of the sun.
rows.does: Digs a small 2-cell crater and draws a boxy stone room on four pillars about 6 voxels up with glowing strips on three walls and a ring of stones around the pit. The artifact waters fields by day and in drought, lures villagers, scares beasts and grants food.
rows.missing: Nothing on the island is ever sheltered or protected, though the entry calls it a shelter. It is a square box on pillars, not a hanging bubble, and the field watering does not come from anything the entry describes.
rows.fix: Add a protecting effect such as {when: 'enemy', do: 'shield', radius: 3} (or {when: 'fire', do: 'shield'}) so villagers can shelter in it, drop or justify the 'water' effects, and redraw the hollow as a rounded shell of 'dome' parts floating free above the pit instead of a box on posts.

rows.name: Celestial Lights
rows.promise: A slow green and violet aurora across the whole sky with starbursts, calming everyone below and leaving glowing grass for the night.
rows.does: Darkens the sky and frames the whole island; three rippling bands of green and violet glowing particles drift high overhead for about 20 seconds; 14 starbursts pop among them with light; every creature is calmed for an hour and tinted pale; most grass turns to glowing starlit grass that returns to g

rows.name: Celestial Realm
rows.promise: A fist-sized floating orb of pale gold light with blue depths and winking stars that gives a steady guiding glow and reveals hidden paths.
rows.does: Builds a stone plinth with a gold-and-blue magic voxel sphere and orbiting sparkles. It lights the night against hunters, heals at dawn and summons a spirit at full moon. Every minute it lays a glowing starpath line in a random direction that fades back to grass.
rows.missing: Its paths are random lines that lead to nothing, so nothing hidden is revealed. Dawn healing, prayer and worship grants, and full-moon spirit summons are extras the entry never promises.
rows.fix: Aim each starpath with w.nearest (water, a wonder, a cave mouth, a field or the village) so it reveals a real destination. Drop the heal effect, the prayer and heal grants, the worship use and summon:spirit, and keep the night light as its steady glow.

rows.name: Charon
rows.promise: A hooded ferryman of black Styx water who poles a boat across still water, dripping cold water, carrying travelers and cargo to the far shore.
rows.does: Spawns a dark hooded two-legged figure with red eyes that stood motionless for two minutes; it may drip a little styx fluid, but there is no boat and no ferrying.
rows.missing: He never moves, crosses water or ferries anyone. The 'ferry' goal is declared inside the creature rather than in spell.goals, so it is unknown. His act only draws a shockwave. There is no boat. Being active at night and weak to light leaves him idle or dying by day.
rows.fix: Move the goal into spell.goals as {name:'ferry', seek:'water', like:'explore'} with an act that takes a nearby villager and teleports it across the water. Add a flat boat w.model under him at the nearest water (w.nearest('water')) and spawn him there. Drop weak 'light' and active 'night' so he works

rows.name: Civilization
rows.promise: A cosmic-scale city of stone houses, markets and granaries in rings around a central square, sheltering its people, with hearths glowing at dusk and bells ringing the hours.
rows.does: Raises one 14-house village with eight market, granary, chapel, watchtower, bakery and smithy buildings in two rings, an octagonal stone wall, a bell-tower model and a permanent ward. Its Civic Bell artifact lights the town at dusk, adds food at dawn, waters fields in drought and heals.
rows.missing: At cosmic tier it builds a single walled town covering about 8% of the island, not a civilization. The bells never ring: no gong marks the hours.
rows.fix: Use w.village for several districts or towns across the island, joined by roads (w.line) inside layered walls, and give the Civic Bell an effect with every: 60 and an act that calls w.sound("gong") so its bells mark the hours.

rows.name: Clone
rows.promise: A silver outline around a nearby creature, then a shimmering living double of it steps out of a nearby pool and dissolves into mist after an hour.
rows.does: Rings the nearest creature in silver light, finds water within 8 cells, raises a glowing orb from it, spawns a silver-tinted creature of the same kind there, and kills it in steam after 3600 seconds.

rows.name: Consecrate
rows.promise: Holy ground a few paces wide: clean bright earth, restless undead laid to rest, and a day-long safety from the dead.
rows.does: Paints dirt, glows gold and raises a day-long ward that pushes out undead named by a fixed list; undead whose kind matches that list sleep for 2 minutes and are frightened at the same time.
rows.missing: The restless dead are never laid to rest: they only sleep for 2 minutes. Undead are picked by a name pattern that misses kinds like ghost, revenant or mummy, so the test run changed 0 creatures. Corpses ('bones') are untouched, and the ward also stops fire and lava, which the entry never promises.
rows.fix: Pick undead with w.nature(c)==='undead' and lay them to rest for good (c.kill() with a soft burst, or a sleep that lasts the whole blessing, without the fear). Handle w.corpses in reach so they cannot rise. Set the ward to against: ['creatures'] and keepOut: ['undead'].

rows.name: Corona
rows.promise: A dusky gold ring flickers over the caster, then spreads over all around, dimming the sun's glare, calming everyone and keeping the grass green through the heat.
rows.does: Puts a ring of gold voxels over the caster, then raises a dark eclipsed sun with a gold corona in the sky, darkens and tints the land for 22 s and sweeps a golden ring outward. It calms every creature, cools the land by 15 degrees, regrows grass, and leaves a 600 s ward and a calm landmark.

rows.name: Cosmic Storm
rows.promise: A spinning violet ring overhead rains silver stars while every creature in a wide circle is lifted and gently spun in a rainbow whirl, and the grass glows like glass before returning to normal.
rows.does: Darkens the island and shows it whole. A violet ring, a vortex and orbiting rainbow stars hang high over the centre for about 22 s while silver stars fall all over the island and burst in rainbow sparks. Every creature gets levitate and calm, is nudged around the centre and sparkles. A wave turns al

rows.name: Creation
rows.promise: A cosmic burst of white light that seeds the whole island with life: moss on bare stone, fish in the waters, new animals, flowers and shoots, permanently.
rows.does: A swirling white vortex, a big flash, shockwave and drifting star particles, then a ring sweep that sets per-cell chances. The test run changed only 23 cells (0.2% of the island) and 13 creatures.
rows.missing: The seeding of life is nearly invisible for a cosmic spell: almost no moss, flowers or saplings appear and only a dozen animals spawn, so the light show is most of what the player sees.
rows.fix: Lay the life with the area helpers instead of tiny per-cell chances: w.paint(x, y, R, "moss", 0.6) over rock, dirt and ash, w.grow(x, y, R, 0.3) for flowers and saplings. Spawn fish at w.nearest("water") spots and a few dozen young animals spread over the island so the change reads everywhere.

rows.name: Crypt
rows.promise: A squat grey earth-brick stone crypt among the houses, its doorway ringed by cracked drifting arches, with whispering haunts at dusk and a soft hum of old songs at night.
rows.does: Raises an ordinary village house (w.building job 'house') with a one-cell stone model beside it: a tiny block with a ring of seven cubes and two glowing dots. An artifact on the house scares beasts and summons a light-weak guard wisp every 40 seconds at night.
rows.missing: The building the player sees is a normal house, not a squat stone crypt. The crypt look is a one-cell miniature beside it, and its arches sit still instead of drifting. There is no night hum or song at all, and scaring beasts is not in the entry.
rows.fix: Drop the house building and draw the crypt itself as one 2x2-cell model of grained grey brick with a dark arched doorway and cracked arch fragments around it, set beside a few float voxels for the drifting pieces. Add a night effect act that plays w.sound('drone' or 'choir', low) with a faint w.ligh

rows.name: Crystal
rows.promise: A palm-sized clear faceted crystal with a slow spark of light inside that hums, gathers light and glows brighter the longer someone holds it.
rows.does: Draws a small clear crystal with a glowing core on a stone plinth, chimes on arrival, lures villagers (one took it), and casts a steady light pulse every 40 seconds and at night.
rows.missing: Its signature, glowing brighter the longer it is held or tended, never happens: the light stays the same, and nothing gathers light or steadies anything.
rows.fix: Give the artifact an act effect (when every, every ~10) that counts villagers within its radius and calls w.light with a radius and strength that grow while someone stays near it, then fade when they leave; drop the plain daytime light pulse.

rows.name: Crystal Cavern
rows.promise: A cool, humming crystal cave of quartz spires where resonant shards can be gathered and whispers echo back.
rows.does: Raises a cave mouth wonder with five stacked-cone quartz spire models, a calm-aura landmark, a 3-second glow of particles, then nothing; w.artifact is called but spell.artifacts is never declared.
rows.missing: The resonant shard material is declared but never laid, so there is nothing to gather. There is no echo, hum or coolness, and the calm aura is unrelated to the entry. The test run found it idle.
rows.fix: Declare spell.artifacts [{name: "Crystal Cavern", radius: 6, effects: [{when: "dawn", do: act that w.set()s a few 'resonant shard' cells around it, plus w.sound("crystal") echoes}, {when: "day", do: act that runs w.temperature(x, y, 4, -10) to keep it cool}], grants: [{what: "gold"}]}]. Paint some s

rows.name: Crystal Cluster
rows.promise: A patch of land where glowing violet mana crystals as tall as an oak push up, humming, with a steady violet shimmer, where mages draw power from the ground.
rows.does: Raises a small hill, paints a glowing violet crystal ground that slowly creeps into dirt and grass, and draws a model of four thin crystal clusters about 2 to 3.5 cells tall. A violet light lasts 2 seconds, and the artifact only lures villagers.
rows.missing: The clusters are a third of oak height, the violet light fades after 2 seconds instead of staying, nothing hums, and nothing is drawn from it: villagers come but get no power.
rows.fix: Make the clusters 6 to 10 tall, either with w.spire crystal spires or with model heights at that scale. Give the artifact a recurring effect, such as {when:'night', every:20, act(self,w){w.light(self.x,self.y,5,'#a98bff',20); w.sound('drone',0.2);}}, and a grant villagers use, such as {what:'gold'}

rows.name: Cursed Water
rows.promise: A vial of dark cursed liquid whose drop sours a well or pool, turning clear water foul and harmful.
rows.does: Draws a vial on a pedestal; every 20 s it turns about 4% of water cells within 5 cells into a dark 'cursed water' fluid that creeps slowly into water. That fluid hurts nothing, and the vial scares villagers and lures spirits.
rows.missing: The soured water harms nothing: no hurts, no poison, no sickened fish or drinkers. It also does nothing unless water lies within 5 cells, and the test run saw it act only once.
rows.fix: Give the 'cursed water' material hurts (and a poison gas wisp over it) so fish and waders sicken. Have the act use w.nearest('water', self.x, self.y, 8) to seed a drop there. Put the code under act with a valid effect, not do: 'act'. Thicken the 0.02 and 0.03 model parts to 0.05 or more so they are

rows.name: Cycle of Life
rows.promise: Within ten paces the grass withers and sprouts again, saplings grow tall, wilted flowers rebloom, leaves swirl back onto branches, and the soil is left richer.
rows.does: Paints a 10-cell disc to dirt, circles 22 leaf swarms over it, then paints brown 'rich loam', calls w.grow and grows 6 new birch saplings; the loam creeps into nearby grass and dirt and turns back to grass after a day.
rows.missing: Plants already there are never aged or renewed: no existing tree grows taller, no flower rebooms, and the leaves circle in the air instead of returning to branches. The loam also spreads into healthy grass beyond ten paces, browning the land instead of making it greener.
rows.fix: Drop 'grass' from the loam's spreads.into, or cap the spread so it stays local. Use w.here/w.nearest to find trees, flowers and stumps in R: regrow stumps and dead trees with w.tree({grow}) and repaint flowers. Steer the leaf swarms into existing tree crowns before killing them.

rows.name: Darkness
rows.promise: A house-sized circle goes dark for about a minute, lights inside die, those caught stumble unharmed, then the dark lifts gently.
rows.does: Draws a black disc on the ground that fades out over 60 s, paints a black 'shadow' ground that becomes dirt after 60 s, puffs smoke, and stuns creatures inside once for 2 s.
rows.missing: The stumbling lasts 2 s, not the minute. The dark fades steadily from the start instead of holding. Fires and lights inside stay lit. The shadow ground turns grass and fields to bare dirt, so the dark does not lift without a trace.
rows.fix: Hold the w.draw disc near full alpha until the last ~5 s, then fade it. Put out fire in the disc with w.clear(x, y, 'fire'). Re-apply a stun or slow status every couple of seconds while the cast runs, or leave a short-lived landmark with a mild aura for the full minute. Drop the shadow material's be

rows.name: Dawn
rows.promise: A golden seam splits the dark and pulls wide, lifting the night for a full hour: warm sunrise for creatures and crops, nocturnal beasts retreat to the shade.
rows.does: Darkens the island, sweeps two glowing gold fronts outward from the center with lights, beams, slight warming and growth, calms and heals villagers, scares every other creature, then holds a warm tint and light for about 9 seconds.
rows.missing: The night never really lifts. The brightness is lights and a tint that are gone about 10 seconds after the cast, not an hour of day. The opening darken makes a daytime cast darker first. Fear hits deer, rabbits and every other animal instead of only nocturnal ones.
rows.fix: Drop the opening w.darken. Make the dawn last: hold a long w.tint and a w.light over the island, or note the missing time-of-day control. Apply fear only to night hunters (wolves, undead, hostile, active-night kinds) and let grazers and crops warm with w.temperature and w.grow.

rows.name: Dead Sea
rows.promise: A broad, still basin of grey salt-heavy water where nothing swims, ringed by salt, that slowly chills whatever lingers on its shore.
rows.does: Sinks a crater about 24 cells across and fills it with grey, harmful, cold 'dead brine', crusts the shore in salt that creeps into nearby grass and dirt, chills the area to -60, then keeps cooling it every 6 s and freezing creatures within 10 cells every 10 s.

rows.name: Death
rows.promise: A hooded shadow of Death that drifts, guards old thresholds, gently herds lost spirits to rest and ignores the living.
rows.does: Spawns a dark hooded spirit with glowing eyes and a pale staff that guards its spot, calms and sleeps nearby spirits, hunts undead, scares wolves and bears, and keeps a 30-minute ward over the area.

rows.name: Deluge
rows.promise: A gray-green wall of water bursts from the ground, sweeps a wide field knocking everyone over unharmed, then drains, leaving fertile silt and a shallow pool for an hour.
rows.does: A jolt and green spray at the cast point, then a widening line of gray-green floodwater rolls about 1.4 w.r downhill, pushing and briefly stunning every creature it meets. It lays silt behind it and ends in a shallow pool; the floodwater decays in 10 minutes and the pool in an hour.

rows.name: Desert
rows.promise: A whirling sandstorm settles into a grand desert of rolling dunes, yellowed brittle grass and dried-up rivers, lasting until rain soaks it.
rows.does: Plays a whoosh, shakes the camera and shifts the wind, then raises dunes over the reach, paints dune sand and dry grass, and drains water within 0.6 of the reach. Both materials creep into grass and dirt and turn back with water.
rows.missing: The sandstorm is only a sound and a shake, with no sand in the air. The spread never stops, so over minutes it could turn every grass and dirt cell on the island to desert, far beyond a valley.
rows.fix: Add a short sandstorm: a vortex or cloud body, or w.burst of tan particles swirling over the reach before the land shifts. Bound the creep, either by giving dune sand and dry grass decays with becomes 'grass' or by dropping 'dirt' from spreads.into and lowering the rate.

rows.name: Dhampir
rows.promise: A pale grey vial of ichor with a crimson pulse that mends weary travelers and restores wilting saplings, its life borrowed from something hungrier.
rows.does: Places a grey stone voxel topped by a grey and red magic sphere, then an artifact that heals the wounded within 4 cells every 20 seconds; the night grass-drain effect is written as do: function, so the engine drops it.
rows.missing: Nothing restores saplings or plants. The 'borrowed' life-drain never runs because do must be a name, not a function. The look is a block and a ball, not a vial.
rows.fix: Move the night drain into act(self, w, target) with a valid when; add a {when: 'dawn', do: 'grow', radius: 3} effect for saplings; draw the vial with w.model (a glass cylinder, a stopper, a glowing crimson core) instead of w.box and w.sphere.

rows.name: Dinosaur
rows.promise: A great earth-and-fossil reptile that plods slowly, carries loads, guards against intruders and shakes the ground as it walks.
rows.does: A rumble and dust burst, then one slow, armoured, horned four-legged beast that roams hunting wolves, bears and boars, digs now and then, and stomps a small quake when an enemy is near.
rows.missing: It never guards anything: it roams as a hunter, and boars are not intruders. It carries nothing as a beast of burden, and its tread only shakes the ground when it stomps an enemy.
rows.fix: Set goal 'guard' with behavior 'guard' near the nearest village, with prey wolf, bear and hostile instead of boar. Add a custom goal that carries stone or wood to the village (carry: 'stone', like: 'gather'). Keep the stomp, and give it a tail-and-crest silhouette so it reads as a reptile.

rows.name: Dodo
rows.promise: A plump grey-brown flightless dodo that follows one villager and trumpets a warning when a stranger comes near.
rows.does: Spawns a grey-brown flightless bird creature that follows a villager, sounds a chirp with a small feather burst when an enemy is near, scares wolves, and leaves flowers and grows plants as it goes.

rows.name: Doppelganger
rows.promise: A silver-grey rippling double that walks beside its maker mirroring every step, then slips into water or glass to scout far places.
rows.does: Spawns one silver two-legged spirit that wanders to nearby water, leaves a small ripple circle there, teleports every 40 s or when hurt, and frightens wild animals.
rows.missing: It never follows or mirrors anyone: it wanders alone. Its scouting reveals nothing. Scaring beasts is not in the entry, and a flying, glowing spirit base does not suit a man-sized double.
rows.fix: Use behavior 'follow' with leader ['villager'] so it shadows a person. Make the scout act teleport it into a distant lake and show what it finds there (a w.light or w.circle at that water). Drop scares: ['beast'] and use a non-glowing two-legs base instead of spirit.

rows.name: Dracolich
rows.promise: A barn-sized skeletal dragon that circles and guards a tomb or keep, whose roar raises the dead and whose gaze chills the living, for about a day.
rows.does: Spawns a flying, glowing, bone-colored dragon creature that guards its spot with a fear aura, breathes fire on wild animals and raises the dead every 90 s. It also raises a clear dome over the area for an hour that keeps beasts, fire, floods and harm out.
rows.missing: The hour-long protective dome is not the dracolich; a creature whose dread and roar stir the dead becomes a village shield bubble. Its arrival rumbles instead of giving the hollow roar the entry names.
rows.fix: Remove lib.lastingWard and let the creature's guard behavior, fear aura and raise-the-dead ability do the protecting; open with w.sound('roar') and keep the fear (or a freeze) aura as its chill.

rows.name: Dracula
rows.promise: A pale, cloaked night creature that rises at dusk, holds one doorway against every intruder all night and is gone by first light.
rows.does: Raises a small crypt door with glowing red eye, spawns a hooded, crowned, glowing-eyed Dracula that guards it by night. He drains intruding wolves, bears, boars and undead with a blood beam, scares villagers and deer away, and mists back to the door.

rows.name: Dragon
rows.promise: A slate-scaled winged serpentine dragon that sleeps curled in its warm cavern, rouses at intruders and guards vaults and passes (hauling stone, clearing rockslides).
rows.does: Roars, shakes and spawns one slate-grey flying dragon that guards its spot, hoards, hunts deer and boar, breathes fire on enemies, digs every 40 s and scares villagers.
rows.missing: No cavern or lair is made and it never sleeps and wakes at intruders. Nothing hauls stone or clears rockslides, so the cave-guardian part of the entry is absent.
rows.fix: Raise a small cave lair with w.wonder(x, y, 'cave mouth') or w.land hill plus a warm glow, and spawn the dragon there with active/sleep behaviour that wakes on enemy near. Give it a custom goal that carries stone from rock or rubble cells and clears rubble on paths.

rows.name: Dragon Nest
rows.promise: A warm woven nest of red scales and eggs that hatches young flame-drakes and keeps a hearth-warmth through cold nights.
rows.does: Raises a rock mound with a stone-voxel blob, six glowing egg voxels and a gold ring, then an artifact hatches a fire-breathing flame-drake about every 60 s (3 charges) that hunts deer and boar and scares villagers; it also grants healing to villagers.
rows.missing: The night warmth effect is dropped because its do is a function instead of a valid name or act, so the hearth-fire never warms anything. The nest reads as a solid stone ball, not a woven cradle with eggs. The heal grant is not in the entry.
rows.fix: Move the warming code into act with when: 'night' (e.g. act(self, w) { w.temperature(self.x, self.y, 6, 15); }) and add a when: 'every' warming effect for cold or snowy cells. Remove the heal grant. Draw the nest with w.model as a woven bowl of red scale and gold thread parts holding speckled dome e

rows.name: Draugr
rows.promise: A tall horned bone sentinel with glowing blue eyes that patrols a hall or tower in silence and unsettles intruders with its gaze.
rows.does: Stacks a static pillar of grey and gold boxes with a sphere head and two glow voxels, raises a permanent ward dome over the area, and adds an artifact that zaps enemies with lightning and arms villagers.
rows.missing: No Draugr creature ever appears or patrols; it is a block statue with no horned helm, plus an endless dome that is far too much for a minor guard. Its gaze unsettles only beasts.
rows.fix: Declare a spell.creatures Draugr (base golem, body two legs, features horns, glowing eyes, armor, behavior guard, goal guard, aura fear on hostile kinds) and w.spawn it at the target. Drop the lastingWard dome, the box pillar and the lightning artifact.

rows.name: Druid
rows.promise: A slow bark-and-moss creature with lichen-lit eyes that wanders forests and meadows, heals wounded animals, makes seeds sprout where it walks, and calls beasts home.
rows.does: Plays a chime and makes one elder villager farmer titled Druid in the nearest village, then grows three ordinary oaks around them; afterwards it just farms like any villager.
rows.missing: No bark-and-moss creature ever appears. It never heals animals, nothing sprouts along its path, and it does not guard wild places or call beasts home.
rows.fix: Declare a spell.creatures kind 'druid' (base golem or spirit, body 'tree folk', bark and moss colors, glowing green eyes, slow speed, behavior wander) with goal 'tend', aura 'heal', leaves 'flowers' or grass, lures ['beast'], and an ability {do:'grow', when:'every so often'}. Spawn it with a creak o

rows.name: Dryad
rows.promise: A bark-and-leaf dryad rises from an old oak, guards its grove, makes seedlings bloom, mends wounded trees by night and stays bound to that wood.
rows.does: Picks the nearest tree (or grows an oak), bursts leaves and spawns a glowing two-legged bark-and-leaf spirit that guards the spot, tends plants, scares wolves, boars and bears, leaves flowers, grows plants every 25 s and heals at night.
rows.missing: Its guard prey is rabbit, so this grove protector attacks harmless rabbits; its night heal mends creatures, not wounded or burnt trees.
rows.fix: Set prey to ['wolf','boar'] (or none); add a night ability with its own act that regrows burnt trees and stumps near her home (w.grow on the spot, w.tree on stumps or ash), and keep goal tend and behavior guard so she stays by her oak..

rows.name: Each-Uisge
rows.promise: A dark kelp-bridled water-horse that swims and carries riders across rivers and drowned fields.
rows.does: Splashes a ring of shallow water, then spawns a dark, swimming, glow-eyed four-legged creature that wanders and explores, lures villagers, scares beasts, leaves mud and floods around itself every 40 seconds.
rows.missing: It never carries or ferries anyone across water, which the entry makes its purpose. Its base 'four legs' is a body name, not a built-in kind, and it has no kelp bridle.
rows.fix: Use base 'beast' with body 'four legs' and a kelp-green color2 for the mane and bridle. Add a custom goal or ability that seeks water near a villager and acts by teleporting that villager to the far shore (or pushing them across) while the horse moves alongside.

rows.name: Earthquake
rows.promise: Three stamps send a harmless tremor rippling out about thirty paces, lifting stones, cracking paths and knocking creatures down before the land settles flat.
rows.does: Three thumps each fire w.quake and a camera shake. Expanding rings toss stone shards up and stun the creatures they pass. Crack lines are drawn on the ground for 9 s, and nothing lasting is left.

rows.name: Echo
rows.promise: A double clap sends a pale blue ring of air out about thirty paces, voices return a heartbeat late, and touched stone hums for a full minute.
rows.does: Plays a ping, draws a small circle, and grows a glowing blue ring body out to 1.5 w.r over 3 s. Rock cells under its edge give off brief glowing particles (1.5 s) and a chime that can sound every frame. A second ping at 0.6 s and one at the end stand in for the echo.
rows.missing: The stone's minute-long hum never happens: its particles fade in 1.5 s and leave nothing behind. There is no clap: the opening is a ping, not two claps. Only 'rock' counts as stone, so basalt and crystal stay silent.
rows.fix: Open with two w.sound('click') claps. Mark each stone cell the ring passes (rock, basalt, crystal) and give it a faint w.light or glowing particles with a soft w.sound('drone') hum that fades over about 60 s. Repeat the caster's sound once, quieter, as the delayed echo. Sound the chime at most once

rows.name: Elixir of Life
rows.promise: A small glowing gold vial that heals wounds and revives a fading heart, restoring a body.
rows.does: Places a gold vial on a small stone plinth that heals the wounded within 5 cells every 30 s, grants healing to villagers who come, and revives a corpse laid within 3 cells once (the test saw one revival).

rows.name: Elysium
rows.promise: A silver-green meadow with glowing orchards and a pale river of light where the weary sleep through the night and wake healed.
rows.does: Paints a slowly spreading glowing silver-green grass with a glowing pale fluid river, pale orchard trees with gold-white fruit accents (some glowing), flowers and a standing-stone ring with a sleeper's slab and gate. At night it puts nearby creatures to sleep and heals them every 20s; it also lights

rows.name: Empire
rows.promise: A great walled city under one banner, with walls, roads, markets and busy streets of traders, scholars and farmers, its gates open to travelers.
rows.does: Raises a real 14-house village with a market, granary, chapel, smithy, tavern, barn and two watchtowers. It rings the village with eight wall segments, leaving gaps as gates, and four red-roofed towers. A banner standard acts as an artifact that feeds, arms and enriches the village. An hour-long war

rows.name: Enchanted Forest
rows.promise: A small living grove of silver-barked trees on breathing moss, with tiny dryads, that restores withered gardens, blighted groves and wilting crops.
rows.does: Paints glowing living moss that keeps spreading over grass and dirt, grows five pale-trunked glowing birches, and spawns flying healing dryads that tend, grow and leave flowers. An artifact keeps growing plants, waters fields in drought and heals, and villagers can draw water and healing from it.

rows.name: Ent
rows.promise: A tall, slow tree-folk guardian with glowing green eyes that shelters groves, tends saplings and watches over the woods.
rows.does: Spawns one slow, sturdy tree-folk Ent with glowing eyes that guards its spot, scares wolves, bears and boars, leaves flowers, heals, regrows plants and shields itself when hurt, under an hour-long green ward over the grove.

rows.name: Eternal Night
rows.promise: The sky turns violet midnight, silver frost creeps out freezing water and dimming fires, and everything sleeps in stillness for a long while before a slow dawn.
rows.does: Darkens and tints the sky violet with glowing stars for 10 s, spreads rime rings that freeze water, cool fires and put creatures to sleep and calm for 40 s, leaves a permanent sleep landmark, spawns 4 spirits, then brightens with a warm dawn.
rows.missing: The night lasts only about 10 s while the sleep runs 40 s, so the 'eternal' night is the briefest part. The rime overwrites fields, sand and snow and later decays into grass, wiping out farmland. The added spirits and the permanent sleep landmark are not in the entry.
rows.fix: Make w.darken and w.tint last as long as the sleep (about 40 to 60 s) and time the dawn light at its end; paint rime only on grass and dirt so fields are left alone; drop the w.spawn spirits and the permanent landmark, or give the landmark a duration.

rows.name: Eve
rows.promise: A graceful woman who walks the land tending plants, making seeds sprout and wilting growth bloom, leaving the ground lush where she goes.
rows.does: Places a villager named Eve on a small patch of glowing 'eden bloom'. She walks to ash and bare ground, repaints it with bloom, grows plants there and heals wounded nearby; the bloom slowly creeps into ash and dirt. In the test she moved and acted 20 times.

rows.name: Event Horizon
rows.promise: A cosmic scorched ring round a light-eating hollow: light spirals in, time slows at the rim, and whoever crosses is folded far across the island.
rows.does: Digs a 5-cell crater with a basalt/ash ring and a black-domed model with glowing spiral arms. Every 3 s it nudges creatures within 7 cells inward, stuns those within 4.5, and teleports anyone within 1.6 cells 20 to 40 cells away. It also sends inward glowing particles, scares beasts, lures spirits a
rows.missing: Far too small and quiet for cosmic: a 7-cell reach with a feeble 0.5 pull, and the test logged only one act in five minutes. The hollow also gives off golden glow and dawn beams instead of swallowing light and sound.
rows.fix: Widen the reach (pull radius about 15 to 20, push about 1.5, teleport within 2.5) and make the stun read as slowed time at the rim. Drop the dawn beam and the bright inward particles; have the center swallow light with a dark w.draw disc that pulls the glow in, plus a silence or a low drone.

rows.name: Excalibur
rows.promise: A glowing holy longsword that wards off curses and cleanses corruption from wounded land and creatures.
rows.does: Sets a pale-lit sword in a stone block under a 600-second ward. The artifact shields against enemies, heals the wounded, lights the night, arms and heals villagers, and every 15 seconds clears acid and poison and regrows grass on ash.

rows.name: Explosion
rows.promise: A palm-strike blast ring that hurls stones, knocks creatures flat unharmed, sends a hissing rocket up to burst in sparks, and leaves scorched, cracked ground that slowly seals.
rows.does: Orange circle, boom and shockwave; pushes and stuns every creature in reach; throws 14 stone shards; paints a ring of scorched earth that decays to dirt; draws fading cracks; a flame body rises and bursts into sparks; also sets fire to the centre with w.ignite.
rows.missing: w.ignite starts a real fire that spreads and burns houses and villagers (test run: 8% of houses lost), so creatures are not unharmed; the rocket bursts with a chime instead of the promised hiss.
rows.fix: Remove w.ignite and keep the blast to the scorched earth, push and stun; play w.sound('hiss') as the flame body rises and at its burst instead of chime.

rows.name: Fire Gem
rows.promise: A plum-sized glowing gem with an undying orange flame that gives off warmth and kindles fires without flint.
rows.does: Draws a small glowing gem on a stone plinth and warms cells within 2 at night. It also burns nearby enemies and grants villagers healing; in the test a villager simply took it.
rows.missing: Healing has nothing to do with a fire gem. Its central use, kindling hearths and warming cold camps, only shows as a faint night-time heat that changes nothing visible.
rows.fix: Remove the heal grant. Add an act that warms cold cells (w.temperature +30 within 2), melts snow and ice near it and kindles a small w.fire on a nearby wood or house cell at dusk, plus a lasting w.light glow at night.

rows.name: Fire Giants
rows.promise: Three identical ash-grey, molten-veined giants as tall as hills that stride with ground-shaking steps, guard lava fields and passes, and smash paths through stone.
rows.does: Paints three glowing patches and spawns three fireproof golem-based giants (radius 2.2, never resized) that hunt wolves and bears, quake lightly every 7 s, cut 3-cell dirt hollows into nearby rock, breathe fire, burn whoever stands close and leave tread that hardens to basalt.
rows.missing: Nothing makes them giant: they are drawn as two-legged golems at a creature's usual scale, nowhere near hill-tall for a legendary summon. Their burn aura and fire breath also hit the villagers they are meant to guard.
rows.fix: After each w.spawn, call c.resize(4) or more on the giant so it towers over houses, and point the burn aura and breath at hostile kinds only, so villagers walking by are not scorched.

rows.name: Fire Opal
rows.promise: A small glowing lava stone that quietly warms its surroundings like a hearth for many hours, without fuel.
rows.does: Draws a small glowing-veined stone on an iron stand, then every 3 s for two hours heats cells within 3 by up to 30 degrees and has a 2% chance each time of setting fire to the cells within 1.
rows.missing: The random ignition turns a warming stone into a slow fire-starter that can light grass, fields or houses beside a village, which no hearth-stone owner expects; the warmth itself shows nothing a player can see.
rows.fix: Remove the w.ignite call and keep the gentle w.heat aura; make the warmth visible and useful by melting snow and ice nearby (w.temperature with a small positive delta) and clearing freeze from creatures in its radius (c.status calm, or skipping frozen ones); optionally add a dusk/night 'light' effec

rows.name: Fire Ruby
rows.promise: A plum-sized glowing ruby with living flame inside that stays hot, warms its surroundings and can set things alight (harm).
rows.does: Stacks a 3x3 stone block with a 3-cell orange magic sphere and places an artifact that lures villagers, scares spirits and lights the night. Its heat effect is a bare function in 'do', so the engine drops it.
rows.missing: Nothing hot or burning ever happens: no heat, no ignition, no melting snow. The 'gem the size of a plum' is a big voxel ball on a block, not a fine model.
rows.fix: Move the heat into act (when 'every', every 15, act(self, w) { w.temperature(self.x, self.y, 2, 40); if (w.chance(0.3)) w.ignite(self.x, self.y, 1, 0.3); }) or use do 'burn'. Drop the 'light' effect and the spirit scare. Draw the ruby with w.model as a small faceted glowing red gem on a fine stone p

rows.name: Fire Staff
rows.promise: A placed staff of blackened oak and copper whose glowing fire ruby warms the frozen, kindles hearths and lights the dark.
rows.does: Flashes and chimes, lays a 10-cell plank of dark wood flat on the ground (box sized 1x10x1), drops a red glowing ball from z 11, and gives a brief light. The artifact is never placed.
rows.missing: cast never calls w.artifact, so no warmth, light or healing ever happens. Every effect also puts code in do instead of act, so the engine would drop them anyway. The staff lies on its side as a whole-cell plank, not a fine model.
rows.fix: Call w.artifact(w.x, w.y, 'Fire Staff'). Move each effect's code into act with a valid do (e.g. {when:'night', do:'light'}, plus an act that heats nearby snow and heals frozen villagers). Draw the staff with w.model: an upright slender rod, a copper cage and a glowing ruby. Use a crackle sound inste

rows.name: Fire Ward
rows.promise: An amber shimmer that makes one creature immune to flame, heat and burning ground for ten minutes, and nothing else.
rows.does: Draws three amber rings and raises a 10-minute dome of radius 1.3·w.r with every default protection (fire, fluids, lightning, cold, creatures, harm); the test shows it stopping fire, lava, blasts and pushing out raiders.
rows.missing: The entry says it does nothing against cold, lightning or blunt force, but the ward blocks all of them and repels raiders, over an area instead of the one named creature.
rows.fix: Center the ward on the nearest creature (w.nearest('villager') or w.creatures) with a small radius, pass against: ['fire'] (plus fluids only if lava counts as heat) and seconds: 600, and drop the default creature and harm protection.

rows.name: Fireball
rows.promise: An orange ball of fire is hurled at the target and bursts, setting the grass alight and burning creatures within a few paces for about a minute.
rows.does: An orange circle and a rising sound, then a glowing flame body flies low to the target. There it bursts with sparks, a flash, a boom and a shockwave, ignites and heats a 3-cell radius and sets every creature there burning for 60 seconds.

rows.name: Fireworks
rows.promise: A traced spark spiral starts about a minute of red, gold and violet bursts over the rooftops that warm a little, set birds singing and leave people below glad.
rows.does: Draws a fading spiral with sparks, darkens the sky and launches 3 rockets that burst in red, gold or violet with booms, light and slight warmth, pushing birds up with chirps and calming villagers for an hour. A launcher body at z 0 is meant to keep firing for 60 s, but the test logged only 3 bodies.
rows.missing: The minute-long show seems to stop after the first three shells: the launcher body probably ends on touching the ground, so the long-lasting display the entry promises never plays.
rows.fix: Start the launcher body in the air (z: 6 or more), or keep it from ending on ground contact, so its tick goes on launching shells for the full 60 s while the dark sky lasts.

rows.name: Flaming Sword
rows.promise: A pale Adam blade wreathed in red-gold hellfire whose flame bites hardest into curses, wards and anything made by spells.
rows.does: Places a small sword-in-pedestal model and an artifact that burns enemies within 3 cells every 12 s, lights the night, gives off sparks every 20 s and arms villagers who claim it.
rows.missing: Nothing about cutting curses, wards or spell-made things: it never targets magic creatures (spirits, undead, summons) or dispels anything. Its blade parts are 0.04 to 0.08 thick and off the eighth grid, so the blade and flame may not draw at all. The night light and scaring beasts are generic extras
rows.fix: Add an effect act that finds spirits, undead and spell-made kinds nearby (w.creatures filtered by w.nature) and hurts them harder with burn. Remove the night light and the beast scare. Redraw the blade at least 0.125 wide on eighths with glowing red and gold flame parts along its edges, and use a va

rows.name: Flesh Golem
rows.promise: A slow grey stitched golem with green-veined joints that tends the wounded and mends fallen companions.
rows.does: Spawns a grey, fireproof golem creature with green accents and the tend goal that heals the wounded, plus heal abilities every 20 s and when a friend dies. The test shows it moving and acting over two minutes.

rows.name: Flood
rows.promise: A single cold wave spills out from the caster over the nearest field, drowns low ground knee-deep, makes creatures swim or climb, and drains after an hour into soft dark soil.
rows.does: After a whispered circle and three small jolts, a ring of floodwater rolls outward over about a valley's reach. It fills cells up to 2 voxels above the cast point (4 on wet ground) about knee-deep, pushes and frightens the creatures it reaches, and turns to mud after 3600 seconds.

rows.name: Fog
rows.promise: A thick grey-white fog bank about village-sized rolls out over the ground, blinds sight and muffles everything for minutes, then thins and drifts away.
rows.does: Rolls out 42 cloud bodies for about 4 s with a wind sound and an 8 s pale tint. It lays a custom fog gas and keeps a hidden body that calms animals and fights and adds fog for about 150 s, but the test run recorded 0 cells of gas.
rows.missing: The lasting milky bank never shows up on the island (0 cells changed), so after the first seconds there is only a sparse puff of 4 particles every 2 seconds and a brief tint, not minutes of blinding fog.
rows.fix: Remove reacts heat:"none" (it likely erases the fog at ordinary temperature) and check that w.gas lays fog cells. Keep slow-drifting look:"cloud" bodies (life 120+, low speed) over the whole radius for the duration, emit far more particles per tick, and hold a stronger w.tint for the fog's lifetime.

rows.name: Fossil
rows.promise: A small etched fossil stone glowing faintly from its cracks that wakes the ground nearby, bringing up roots, seeds and old springs.
rows.does: Puts a bone-grey stone on a pedestal, then every 30 s makes plants grow within 3 cells, waters dry fields in a drought, lights up at night and lets villagers take water from it. In the test it acted only once in five minutes.
rows.missing: The etched creature outline and the glowing cracks are drawn with 0.02 to 0.04 boxes, which fall under the 0.05 limit and are not drawn, so it reads as a plain stone. No spring ever surfaces outside a drought.
rows.fix: Redraw the etched creature (spiral shell or skeleton) and the cracks as glow parts at least 0.125 thick on eighths. Swap chime for a low drone. Add an occasional act effect that sets a little water seeping up beside it so a forgotten spring shows.

rows.name: Fountain of Youth
rows.promise: A white marble basin of ever-welling pearl water that heals wounds, restores vigor and tends withering gardens nearby.
rows.does: Raises a marble ring model around a small pool of glowing pearl water, heals within 5 cells every 15 s, spreads green moss every 30 s, waters fields in drought, grants water and healing to villagers, and revives any corpse within 3 cells.
rows.missing: Nothing makes anything young, the only deed in the test was raising the dead, which the entry never promises, and it oddly scares spirits and lights up at dawn.
rows.fix: Drop the corpse revive pair, scares spirit and the dawn light; put the youth in an act effect that fully heals and rids of status those who drink, and add a grow effect on nearby crops and flowers for the gardens.

rows.name: Frost Lich
rows.promise: A gaunt ice lich with glowing eyes that stands guard at its post, freezes intruders, and leaves frost creeping wherever it walks.
rows.does: Spawns one hooded, crowned, glow-eyed frost lich that guards where it was placed, attacks wolves, boars and bears with a freeze aura and freeze abilities, scares villagers and deer, and leaves spreading rime that chills the ground around it.

rows.name: Furnace
rows.promise: A squat sooty brick furnace with an iron-ringed mouth and a steady orange glow that warms the cold, tempers metal and bakes clay.
rows.does: Raises a plain 3-tall brick tower with a stone ring on top and one glow voxel hidden inside it, then registers an artifact whose effects are dropped; only the heal and arms grants and villager guarding can work (the test saw just a guard).
rows.missing: All three effects put functions in do instead of act, so the engine drops them: no night warming, no smoke, no heat, no glow. The glowing belly is buried inside the tower, there is no visible mouth, and the heal grant is not in the entry.
rows.fix: Move the effect code into act(self, w) with a valid when (night warming via w.temperature, smoke via w.gas), draw it with w.model as a squat cylinder of grained brick courses with an iron-ringed mouth and a glowing orange opening on its face, keep the arms grant, and drop the heal grant.

rows.name: Genesis
rows.promise: A turning sphere of starlight bursts into motes that sprout grass, start little streams and open a patch of pale flowers wherever they land, calming creatures near the caster.
rows.does: A growing star orb circles with motes above the caster for 4.5 s, then bursts. It calms and heals creatures within 18 cells and sends 90 glowing motes across the whole island, each painting grass, growing plants and laying glowing dawnbloom flowers; every fourth one also floods a small spring of wat

rows.name: Geode
rows.promise: A fist-sized grey stone with glowing violet crystal inside that breathes a thin plume of warm mist and coaxes a nearby ember into a steady glow.
rows.does: Draws a tiny grey stone with glowing violet crystal points on top. Its artifact is set to warm its cell slightly every 3 s and puff a 0.2 wisp of steam every 6 s. When fire is near it heats itself and lights a violet glow on its own spot.
rows.missing: The test run changed 0 cells and the artifact acted only twice in five minutes, so the mist plume the entry centres on is barely seen. The fire glow lights the geode itself, not the ember it should coax.
rows.fix: Add a body or particle tick that sends a steady thin column of pale steam particles up from the crack every second or two, and raise the gas amount. In the fire effect, find w.nearest('fire', self.x, self.y, 4) and put the warm light on that ember (a gentle w.light there), not on the stone.

rows.name: Ghost
rows.promise: A pale, faceless cloaked mist-spirit that drifts on its own, chills the air around it and reveals hidden things.
rows.does: Places a freeze-aura landmark and an artifact (night freeze, periodic light) and a glowing cloud body that circles within 3 cells of the spot for 10 minutes, then vanishes.
rows.missing: No ghost creature is ever spawned: it is a looping cloud pinned to one spot, not a cloaked figure that moves on its own, and nothing is revealed.
rows.fix: Declare a spell.creatures ghost (base spirit, pale color, hood, glowing eyes, flying, behavior wander, aura freeze, goal explore, active night with a hiding rule by day), spawn it with w.spawn, and drop the tethered cloud body and the freeze landmark.

rows.name: Ghost Light
rows.promise: A small forgotten ruin whose old stones glow cold blue at night, with pale drifting flames that lead travelers to rest at its edges until dawn.
rows.does: Draws a ring of six grey stone stubs on a slab with one tiny glowing orb and five glowing specks, and places an artifact that lights the area every 20 s at night, summons a wisp at dusk and lures villagers to its center. Two wisps spawn, follow villagers anywhere and put them to sleep.
rows.missing: The stones themselves never glow, since only a tiny center orb and specks shine. The wisps wander off with villagers and sleep them wherever they are instead of staying over the walls and guiding travelers to the ruin's edge.
rows.fix: Add glowing pale-blue caps and edges to the wall stubs. Give the wisp behavior guard (stay at the ruin), with lures villager and aura calm instead of following villagers with sleep. Add a night act effect that walks nearby villagers to the ring's edge to rest until dawn.

rows.name: Gold Vein
rows.promise: A patch of ordinary ground that glows gold and yields gold ore to those who work it, giving a little less over time.
rows.does: Raises a low mound, paints a glowing gold seam that lures villagers and is taken as gold, and places an artifact that sends gold to the nearest village every 30s and repaints the seam; the seam spreads slowly and decays back to dirt.

rows.name: Golden Age
rows.promise: A cosmic slab of ever-warm honey-gold metal with moving veins of light that brings a calm, steady abundance like a good harvest.
rows.does: Drops a 5x3 two-layer block slab, sows glowing golden wheat on a few cells within 6, then slowly spreads wheat within 8, lights the night, warms the air slightly and sends gold to the nearest village every 90 seconds (test: 19 cells changed, 0.2% of the island).
rows.missing: For a cosmic item the abundance is a tiny patch around one slab, far too small. The slab is a plain glowing box with no rippling veins.
rows.fix: Spread the abundance island-wide: loop over every village with w.nearest/w.here, paint golden wheat on their fields, w.grow their land, give gold to each, and raise the artifact radius well beyond 8. Draw the slab with w.model as tiered gold plates with glowing vein parts, and swap the chime for a w

rows.name: Graveyard
rows.promise: A small plot of weathered grey headstones and mossy grave mounds, watched over by a hooded Grim Reaper who calmly guides wandering spirits to peace.
rows.does: Paints ash-grey ground and draws ten grey headstones (some with glowing candles) and six moss-topped mounds in one model, beside a dead tree. It spawns a hooded, glowing Reaper spirit with a calm aura that guards the spot. The Graveyard artifact lures spirits, scatters flowers on the graves, lets sm

rows.name: Guardian Angel
rows.promise: A pale-gold winged angel bound to a ley line that watches over a settlement and shields it from storms, sickness and wandering monsters.
rows.does: Lays a glowing ley vein and spawns a flying, glowing, winged pale-gold guardian with a heal aura. The guardian scares and attacks predators and uses shield and lightning abilities. The program also raises a 600-second ward over the village and leaves an artifact that heals, brings rain on fires and

rows.name: Hallowed Ground
rows.promise: A small spot of faintly glowing pale gold soil with silver grass rings around one stone, where anyone standing inside feels a quiet peace.
rows.does: It paints glowing gold earth in a 4-cell disc, rings of silver grass, a tiered standing stone with glowing runes and a ring of pebbles. It adds a calm-aura landmark and an hour-long ward that keeps out fire, lava, blasts and predators.

rows.name: Halo
rows.promise: A small floating ring of pale gold holy light that sheds drifting Corona motes, shines like a lantern and soothes the wounded nearby.
rows.does: Hangs a glowing ring of pale gold magic voxels and a glowing ring body 9 voxels up. The body keeps rising gold motes drifting off it, a heal-aura landmark of radius 4 sits beneath, and a brief light opens it.

rows.name: Haunted Graveyard
rows.promise: A small graveyard of leaning headstones and crosses, wrapped in grey mist, where pale ghosts drift and follow travelers.
rows.does: It lays spreading dark grave moss and scattered rubble, and draws six headstones with a glowing marker, three dead trees and a puff of smoke. A graveyard artifact then breathes smoke every 20 s, keeps spreading the moss and at night summons calm-aura wisps that follow villagers.

rows.name: Haunted Marsh
rows.promise: A haunted swamp of reeds, dark pools and rising pale mist, with glowing wisps dancing over the water.
rows.does: Shapes a swamp, floods its center, releases steam mist, spawns 4 glowing fear-aura wisps and places an artifact that adds mist at night and a new wisp every two minutes.

rows.name: Haunted Ruins
rows.promise: A crumbling castle fragment glowing with Black Flame in its cracks, whose ghostly sentries drift through the stone and warn off trespassers, and which echoes old voices and reveals hidden passages.
rows.does: Raises two whole stone towers, a wall, an arch, scattered rubble and one purple magic orb, then holds an hour-long ward dome over the area. A landmark scares beasts, three light-weak spirit sentries spawn at once and more come each night, and the place also heals at dawn and arms villagers.
rows.missing: The towers stand whole, not broken, and no Black Flame glows through the cracks. Nothing echoes voices or reveals passages. Sentries spawned by day die in daylight, and they attack villagers, which contradicts the ward over those same villagers. The dawn heal and the arms grant are not promised.
rows.fix: Draw the ruin as a w.model of broken tower stumps and cracked walls with glowing dark-purple seams. Spawn the sentries only at dusk, or give them a den by day, and make them warn and frighten trespassers (aura fear, scares hostile and beast) instead of hunting villagers. Add a reveal effect, such as

rows.name: Haunted Tomb
rows.promise: A squat grey stone crypt among the houses, its door sealed by ghost-light, keeping the village's dead at rest and guarding the living from restless spirits at night.
rows.does: Raises an ordinary village chapel and puts a tiny one-cell crypt model with a few glowing door cubes beside it. It places an artifact that scares undead, lures spirits and gives light at night.
rows.missing: The building players see is a village-style chapel, not a grey crypt; the crypt itself is a trinket smaller than a house. Nothing keeps the dead at rest, and luring spirits into the village works against guarding it from them.
rows.fix: Make the crypt the building: draw it as a 2x2-cell, about 2-tall w.model of grey grained stone courses with a glowing ring over the doorway, and drop the chapel or keep it only for its burial job. Remove lures:['spirit']. Add a night act effect that lays nearby corpses to rest (clears w.corpses with

rows.name: Healing Light
rows.promise: A warm honey glow gathers, then ripples out slowly, healing the wounded and reviving wilted plants within about a dozen paces.
rows.does: Draws a honey-gold circle and light, then sends four expanding golden rings with rising motes that heal every creature they reach (8 each step); it then grows plants and scatters flowers within about 12 cells.

rows.name: Healing Potion
rows.promise: A small rose-gold vial whose sip closes wounds and eases aches, but cannot raise the dead.
rows.does: Draws a small corked vial of glowing rose-gold liquid and places an artifact that heals the hurt within 4 cells (3 charges, recharging) and grants villagers a healing sip; in the test run a villager came and took it.

rows.name: Heat Death
rows.promise: A spreading disk of darkness drains light and heat from a huge area, leaving every creature, plant and stone cold, still and asleep until dawn.
rows.does: Darkens and tints the world and draws a growing dark rippling disk with a vortex and inward-swirling dust. It cools the area by about 6 degrees a second, puts every creature in reach to sleep for 5 minutes with a pale tint, then dusts snow lightly near the center.
rows.missing: Nothing is harmed despite the name Heat Death and the harm promise. Plants and stone are not visibly chilled or stilled, the light snow covers only 1.5 w.r of a world-wide disk, and the sleep lasts a fixed 5 minutes instead of until the next dawn.
rows.fix: Use much stronger cooling (w.temperature around -60 over the disk) so lakes freeze and snow lies widely. Wear creatures down with cold (freeze status plus c.hurt, killing the weakest). Rime the trees with ice voxels or paint ice and snow across the whole radius. Set the sleep's length from w.time to

rows.name: Heavenly Bastion
rows.promise: A great squat white citadel with glowing walls and towers seen for leagues, sheltering the town from storm, flood and beasts and catching the first dawn light.
rows.does: Raises one 2x2 watchtower building with a 2x2, about 3-voxel-tall white model beside it, a permanent ward over the town, an artifact that grants arms and shields when enemies come, and a gold beam and choir at dawn.
rows.missing: The citadel is house-sized: a tiny model and a watchtower are not walls and gleaming towers seen across the plains, which is far too small for a legendary bastion.
rows.fix: Build the citadel itself at scale: a ring of w.wall in white stone with glow trim, four w.tower corners 10 to 15 tall with roofs, and a central keep, with a grow time. Keep the lasting ward, the shield effect and the dawn beam on the keep's roof.

rows.name: Heavenly Host
rows.promise: Summon one radiant winged being of two fused archangels whose lantern light reveals the true intent of those in it.
rows.does: A pillar of gold light descends and spawns one large glowing winged spirit with crown and lantern. Every 8 s it beams, stuns and frightens wolves, bears and hunting or hostile creatures within 10 cells, and heals the others. A light, lightning and healing artifact is placed where it lands.

rows.name: Holy Grail
rows.promise: A golden cup brimming with glowing Salvation that heals and steadies the wounded, blesses healing water and protects those near it.
rows.does: Raises a golden cup on a stone plinth filled with glowing honey-light, heals and revives everyone nearby, turns nearby water into glowing holy water and fire out, and keeps a lasting golden ward plus heal, revive, dawn-watering and shield effects that villagers use.

rows.name: Holy Ground
rows.promise: A small hushed clearing of silver, softly glowing grass where the wounded heal, the dead rest and shadows and undead shy away.
rows.does: Paints a disc of glowing pale-silver turf that slowly spreads, rings it with flowers and sets a small glowing stone cross with a ring of stones. It adds a landmark that heals and scares undead kinds, plus a pulsing light and an hour-long ward that keeps out fire, lava and hunters.

rows.name: Holy Light
rows.promise: A warm golden beam heals and refreshes a wounded or weary creature, clears minor curses and leaves it faintly radiant.
rows.does: Draws a gold circle and light, then beams the nearest creature within 3 cells (wounded or not), heals it 20, calms it for 30 s, tints it pale gold, with a burst and light; it fizzles with a hiss if no one is within 3 cells.
rows.missing: It targets the nearest creature rather than the wounded one, nothing clears curses, and a single 20 heal on one creature is very small for a major spell.
rows.fix: Pick from w.here().wounded first (fall back to the nearest), widen the search to about w.r * 0.5, heal it fully with c.heal(c.hp-scaled amount), and clear curse-like statuses on it (for example status('calm') against fear, or undoing poison or sleep).

rows.name: Holy Order
rows.promise: Two shining armored sentinels that stand guard over a village or crossroads and turn back shadows and danger.
rows.does: Spawns two fireproof, glowing armored guard creatures with swords. They attack and scare undead, wolves and bears, and they shield and call lightning when hurt. It also raises an hour-long ward over the village that keeps those kinds out, and leaves a small sword model on the ground.

rows.name: Holy Scripture
rows.promise: A glowing holy book on a lectern whose words reveal answers and guide healers and judges through hard choices.
rows.does: Draws a lectern with an open book and a glowing arc, grants villagers prayer, and every 40 s shines a beam and a choir sound at the nearest villager, with no effect; it acted once in five minutes.
rows.missing: Nothing is ever revealed or guided: the beam is a cosmetic flash on a random villager and changes nothing, so the 'reveal' promise is empty.
rows.fix: Make the effect's act reveal something real: find the nearest hostile, undead or wounded creature with w.here or w.nearest, beam to it and mark it with w.light, give nearby villagers calm, heal the wounded it points to with c.heal, and add a grants heal entry for healers who read it.

rows.name: Holy Sword
rows.promise: A pale gold sword that hums and glows like sunset, cuts curses, breaks dark enchantments on those it protects and drives shadows and undead back.
rows.does: Stacks a few boxes into a gold cross-shape and places an artifact that lights the night, heals, and grants prayer and healing to villagers who worship it. It also raises a permanent ward dome over the area.
rows.missing: It never harms or breaks anything dark: no hurt to undead, no curse or status lifted, and it scares spirits, not undead. A permanent village-wide ward is far too big for a cantrip and is not what a sword is. The worship and healing are add-ons.
rows.fix: Remove lib.lastingWard and the prayer and heal grants. Give the artifact an effect {when: 'enemy' or 'night', every: 10, act} that hurts undead and hostile creatures within about 4 cells (c.hurt) and clears fear and sleep from nearby villagers. Set scares to the undead kinds. Draw the blade, guard a

rows.name: Humanity
rows.promise: A tall being made of a crowd of near-identical brown-and-pale figures moving as one, which tends gardens, raises walls and teaches the young.
rows.does: Spawns one ordinary-sized hooded golem-like walker. It leaves flowers, grows plants every 25s, heals and calms nearby villagers every 30s, raises a 3-cell low stone wall every 90s, and chases off wolves.
rows.missing: The central look is missing: there is no crowd of figures moving as one and no shifting brown-to-pale skin, only a single villager-sized creature. Its 'teaching' is just heal and calm, which is small for a cosmic, tall being.
rows.fix: Spawn several near-identical figures with behavior follow and leader humanity around a resized, taller lead body, and vary their tints from brown to pale. Make teaching change villagers' work (e.g. w.hire a gardening or building job nearby) instead of just healing and calming.

rows.name: Hurricane
