rows.promise: A legendary whirling column of wind and sea spray that lifts and circles everything caught in it for ten seconds, scatters crops, creatures and small buildings, and leaves the land slick for a minute.
rows.does: A vortex body wanders for 10 s under a darkened sky with wind and spiralling spray particles. It pushes creatures around it in circles, briefly levitating, frightening and hurting them. It clears crops, flowers and bushes, turns some houses to rubble with flying debris, stumps a few trees and lays a
rows.missing: Too small for legendary: the core is about 0.3 w.r and the test run changed only 1% of the island, about 109 cells and a tenth of the houses, not a region. A hurricane also brings no rain or storm cloud, only spray particles.
rows.fix: Widen the vortex to about 0.6–0.8 w.r and let it track across more of the land. Raise the house and tree damage chances. Add driving rain along its path, with w.flood of shallow water or w.gas steam bands under a w.body cloud wall, so the storm reads as a regional hurricane.

rows.name: Hydra
rows.promise: One pale green many-headed serpent that guards its place or master, regrowing and multiplying its heads when struck.
rows.does: Spawns three separate serpent 'Hydra Heads' that guard and hunt every wild animal, each respawning once as one new head on death. Raises an hour-long dome ward over the area plus a heal and arms artifact, with floating green magic orbs and a voxel spiral.
rows.missing: There is no single many-headed body, only three loose snakes. A cut head only replaces itself and never multiplies. The hour-long ward, heal aura and arms grant turn the creature into a village shield. Prey 'raider' and 'bandit' are not existing kinds, so the heads attack all wild beasts instead.
rows.fix: Spawn one Hydra creature (body serpent, or a model with several head boxes), behavior guard, prey hostile/undead kinds. Use a custom 'hurt' ability or onDeath that spawns two smaller near-twin heads (resize/tint) so it multiplies when struck. Drop the lastingWard, heal effect, arms grant and floatin

rows.name: Hypercane
rows.promise: A roaring storm column with a ring of gale winds that tears roofs, uproots saplings and flings debris over a region, then breaks into soaking rain.
rows.does: Raises a drifting grey vortex ringed by orbiting clouds for 90 s. It turns the wind around, whirls debris, sometimes strikes lightning, wrecks houses into rubble, rips out crops, bushes and trees, and spins, stuns and hurts creatures. It ends by releasing steam that rains back down.

rows.name: Ice
rows.promise: A lasting glassy sheet of ice over a small patch of land or water that holds it frozen and makes walkers step carefully.
rows.does: Chills half the reach by 60 degrees, paints ice over a small disc with scattered ice at the rim, and places a tiny model of blue shards, then does nothing more (62 cells, idle afterward).
rows.missing: Nothing keeps it cold, so the outer ice can melt back to water, and nothing makes walkers step carefully; the test failed it as idle.
rows.fix: Add a cold ice material (heat -10, reacts fire: water) or spell.artifacts 'Ice' with an effect {when: 'every', every: 10, act(self, w) { w.temperature(self.x, self.y, 3, -40); }} placed by w.artifact so the sheet stays frozen and refreezes water, and optionally briefly stun creatures that cross it.

rows.name: Illusionist
rows.promise: A prism-cloaked humanoid companion that conjures illusions (false doors, distant voices, phantom crowds) over a village.
rows.does: Spawns a glowing, hooded two-legged spirit with a staff that follows villagers, lures villagers and scares beasts. Every 25s it puts a lavender light, a whisper sound and six motionless pink-blue cloud puffs near a villager, and it teleports when hurt.
rows.missing: Its mirages are only static pastel clouds and a whisper: no phantom crowd, no false door, nothing that fools anyone. Its cloak is pale and pink rather than shifting rainbow light.
rows.fix: Declare a short-lived 'phantom' creature kind (base spirit, body two legs, translucent rainbow tint, lifespan ~40, lures villager, no attack) and have the mirage ability w.spawn 3-5 of them as a crowd that draws villagers astray. Optionally add a small w.model false door that fades. Give the illusio

rows.name: Immortal
rows.promise: A gentle, silver-glowing human-shaped guardian that walks slowly, heals wounds and makes the grass greener wherever it rests.
rows.does: Spawns one pale silver, glowing two-legged hooded creature that guards its spot, tends, heals all around it (aura and ability), leaves flowers, grows plants and shields itself when hurt; also raises a 10-minute ward over the spot.

rows.name: Kelpie
rows.promise: A floating black mane in a restless water column that calms frightened or sleeping people by drawing their terror away into the water.
rows.does: Floods a small pool and stacks seven floating dark boxes topped by a dark sphere. It places an artifact that calms every creature within 4 cells at night and floods a little more water. Every 25 s it adds another floating dark sphere, waters dry land in drought and grants water.
rows.missing: The look is a blocky dark pillar, not a rippling mane in a water column. The calm only fires at night and hits everyone, not the frightened. Effects use do:'act', which is not a valid do name, so they may never run. The repeated spheres pile up voxels.
rows.fix: Draw the mane and water column with one w.model of thin black ribbon parts (glow accents) inside translucent blue cyl courses. Remove the every-25 s w.sphere. Use effects with do 'act' replaced by a valid form: {when:'every', every:12, act(self,w,...)} that finds creatures with fear or sleep in radi

rows.name: Khazad-dûm
rows.promise: A deep dwarven city carved into a mountain's roots, its vaulted halls lit by gleaming silver veins, a sheltered home where dwarves forge, sing and sleep.
rows.does: Lays out an ordinary 12-house village, raises a mountain north of it with a glowing mithril-traced gate model on its flank, and paints spreading mithril veins on its slopes. Adds a smithy, market, granary and tavern at the foot, plus three 'Dwarf' delvers who mine the veins for gold, and a gate arti
rows.missing: The city is a surface village beside the mountain, not carved into it. Past the gate there are no halls, nothing is underground, and nothing is lit inside, so the 'deep city in the mountain' reads as a door and a normal town.
rows.fix: Make the mountain the city: cut into its flank with w.land canyon or w.wonder 'cave mouth' behind the gate, and set the smithy, tavern and houses on terraces or in the cut inside the slopes. Draw a vaulted hall with mithril-glow pillars in a model at the opening, and keep the outside village small o

rows.name: Kiln
rows.promise: A cracked, faintly glowing lump of fired clay that breathes ash threads and holds warm, banked power, healing those near it.
rows.does: Draws a plain 3x2x3 brown stone box with six orange glowing voxels on top. The artifact heals within 3 cells every 6 seconds and grants heal. Its second effect puts a function in do instead of act, so the engine drops it and no mud is ever baked.
rows.missing: Nothing glows from within through cracks and no ash threads rise and curl back. The look is a single brick box, and the mud-baking effect never runs.
rows.fix: Draw the kiln with w.model as a rounded, cracked clay dome with glowing fissure parts. Add a small recurring body or particles of grey ash rising and curling back. Move the mud-to-rock code into act on that effect (do is only a name) or remove it.

rows.name: Kiss of Death
rows.promise: A violet mist kisses one living target: it pales and chills over three breaths, its heart stops for a minute, then it wakes weakened; a plant withers.
rows.does: A violet mist drifts to the nearest living creature, which pales over three heartbeats, loses 40% of its health and lies stunned and asleep for 60 seconds. With no creature near, the nearest tree or plant withers to a stump or dirt.

rows.name: Kraken
rows.promise: A living knot of black tentacles in a sphere of brine that, when loosed, pours out as a rolling wave and drags whatever it touches into the deep.
rows.does: Sets a stone slab with a blue-black voxel ball on it, floods a 3-cell puddle, and registers an artifact that rarely nudges nearby creatures inward (acted once in five minutes), waters dry fields and is worshipped by villagers.
rows.missing: No creature and no tentacles ever appear. There is no rolling wave and no dragging under, so it reads as a garden well, not a Kraken; the 'act' effect barely fires, and villagers worshipping it contradicts the monster it scares them as.
rows.fix: Declare a kraken creature in spell.creatures (base beast, body serpent or a tentacle model, color #0b1a2e, swims, behavior hunt, prey villager and beast, aura hurt, an ability that pulls prey into deep water) and spawn it in the nearest water. Arrive as a rolling wave body that floods along its path

rows.name: Landslide
rows.promise: A rolling wave of earth sweeps about thirty paces down a slope, carrying everyone caught in it gently to mud at the base, scattering stones and leaving loose ground.
rows.does: Raises a small bump, then sends a brown cloud body about 31 cells in a random direction, painting temporary 'slide earth', pushing and tinting creatures in its path, dropping a few rocks and stone voxels, and leaving a 2-cell mud puddle where it stops.
rows.missing: The slide ignores the terrain: its direction is random, so it can run uphill or across flat ground. No earth actually moves, only colour changes, and the mud at the base is too small to set the carried creatures down in.
rows.fix: Pick the downhill direction by sampling w.cell(...).height around w.x,w.y (or aim toward w.nearest('water')). In tick, lower the land behind the wave with w.raise(-) or w.terraform and pile it up at the end. End with a w.flood of mud of radius 4 to 5 where the pushed creatures land, and give 'slide

rows.name: Legion of the Damned
rows.promise: A cursed banner that calls the restless dead to rise and stand in disciplined undead ranks that harm the living.
rows.does: Raises a rusted pole with a tattered, face-stitched standard on ash, spawns 12 armored undead legionaries in a 3x4 formation and turns nearby corpses into legionaries. The banner keeps summoning at dusk and by night and revives the dead, while its legionaries guard, attack villagers and beasts and c

rows.name: Leprechaun Gold
rows.promise: A handful of green-and-violet glimmering coins with grinning faces that tempt luck, bargain with spirits, and always come back to their owner.
rows.does: Draws a grey pedestal with a leather pouch, pays gold to the nearest village at dawn and every minute, and lets villagers take gold for a charge. The test saw it give gold once in five minutes.
rows.missing: The coins are 0.03 to 0.04 thick, below the 0.05 minimum, so they are not drawn and the player sees only a stone block and a pouch. Their colors are rainbow, not green and violet. Nothing is tricky or returning: no coins come back and no spirits are drawn, so it reads as a plain gold source.
rows.fix: Make each coin at least 0.125 thick, placed on eighths, in glowing green and violet tones. Drop the box pedestal for a small heap of coins spilling from the pouch. Add an act effect at dusk that takes back part of the gold it gave (the coins 'return to the pocket'), and add 'spirit' to lures so spir

rows.name: Ley Lines
rows.promise: A glowing green seam of earth veined with humming mana crystal, smelling of rain in drought, that quickens the steps of whoever stands on it.
rows.does: Lays a 24-cell glowing 'ley seam' with crystal veins and a model of crystal clusters and standing stones. An artifact shoves every creature standing on the seam along its length with a green burst and whoosh every 2 s, grows plants at dawn and waters fields in drought.

rows.name: Lich Tower
rows.promise: A brick spire with a glowing phylactery that guards nearby houses and rings a low warning bell when undead or dark magic come near, staffed by watchful apprentices.
rows.does: Raises a watchtower building with a tall brick-and-slate spire model and glowing phylactery studs beside it. It also raises a village-sized ward that lasts an hour, keeps undead out and lets villagers in. A Lich Tower artifact scares undead, sounds a gong with a pale shockwave whenever an enemy is n

rows.name: Life Drain
rows.promise: A thin silver thread drains about a quarter of a creature's life and heals the other end by the same amount, while nearby plants and small beasts wilt.
rows.does: It stuns the creature nearest the cast point and pulls a quarter of its hp over five silver beam pulses into the weakest nearby villager or creature. It greys the victim and kills or turns to dirt some flowers, crops and grass within 2.5 cells, hurts nearby rabbits, birds and fish slightly, and leav

rows.name: Lilith
rows.promise: A dusk-stitched woman summoned from an ash circle who walks its edge, guides, and keeps thresholds, lingering at doorways and crossroads by night.
rows.does: Lays an ash ring and spawns a glowing hooded figure that guards her spawn point with a calm aura and drives off wolves, bears and boars. A 15-minute ward covers the area, and she trails ash as she walks.
rows.missing: She never walks the circle's edge or keeps doorways or crossroads, and nothing guides anyone. She also heals and shields, which the entry never mentions.
rows.fix: Add a custom goal (seek: "home" or "village", work of about 60 s, active: "night") so she lingers at house doors and the plaza at night, and have her circle the ash ring a few times before setting out. Drop the heal ability, and stop leaving ash everywhere she walks.

rows.name: Lost Soul
rows.promise: A small glowing blue-white spirit that drifts at night and gently leads villagers away from bogs and water.
rows.does: Spawns a flying, glowing pale-blue spirit, active at night. It lures villagers and scares wolves. Every 15 s at night it finds the nearest mud or water within 6 cells and nudges nearby villagers away from it with a faint glowing particle.

rows.name: Magic Mirror
rows.promise: A shimmering driftwood-framed mirror that reveals distant places and the health of people and fields, and holds a healing warmth.
rows.does: Raises a voxel-box frame around a glowing glass pane, opens with a flash and chime, and leaves an artifact that heals the wounded within 4 cells every 8 seconds and lures villagers to be healed.
rows.missing: The mirror shows or reveals nothing (no distant view, no sign of anyone's health or a field's state), and it is drawn as plain w.box slabs rather than a framed mirror.
rows.fix: Add an act effect (for example every 15 s) that finds the wounded and the crops with w.here over a wider radius, marks each with w.light and a w.beam from the mirror's glass, and briefly w.camera to the farthest one before w.cameraBack; draw the mirror with w.model: a driftwood frame, a stand and a

rows.name: Magic Missile
rows.promise: Three shimmering arcane darts streak at one target for modest harm, leaving glowing trails that fade after about ten seconds.
rows.does: Zaps a white trace line, then fires three glowing violet star darts that home on the first creature in reach. Each dart hurts it for 3 with a burst and leaves a violet beam lasting 10 seconds; with no creature in reach they strike the ground spot.

rows.name: Magma
rows.promise: A small basin of glowing molten rock under a cooling stone crust that stays hot for days and warms the area around it.
rows.does: It rumbles, digs a small spring-fed lake basin, floods it with ordinary lava, paints basalt around it, heats the area once, then adds a short orange light, a burst of sparks and a puff of smoke.
rows.missing: Nothing keeps it hot: plain lava hardens into basalt and the one-off heat fades. The 'lake' shape's spring may also feed water that quenches the lava, so the lasting warm pool the entry promises soon becomes cold rock.
rows.fix: Dig with w.land shape 'crater' instead of 'lake', and declare a 'magma' fluid in spell.materials with glow, a high heat and no decays (crust made by a basalt rim), or add a w.artifact whose effect act re-heats the spot (w.temperature, re-flood lava) every so often.

rows.name: Mana Crystal
rows.promise: A small humming violet crystal shard that gathers arcane energy and keeps a light spell burning steadily for hours.
rows.does: Places a small violet faceted crystal on a stone plinth with glowing motes, and an artifact that sheds steady light through the night (and every 40 s), driving night hunters off.

rows.name: Mana Rocket
rows.promise: A small blue-white crystal rocket that climbs in a hissing spark trail and bursts into glittering motes overhead, as a signal or festival light.
rows.does: Places a tiny crystal-and-cradle model and an artifact that only gives light at night; the launch effect is written with do as a function, so the engine drops it and nothing ever flies or bursts (test: idle, 0 bodies).
rows.missing: The rocket never launches or bursts, the only working effect is a night light the entry never promises, and most model parts (rails, fins, bands, tip under 0.05 thick) are too thin to be drawn.
rows.fix: Move the launch code into act(self, w, target) with do omitted, e.g. {when: 'every', every: 120, cost: 1, act(self, w) { w.body({... vz: 12, life: 2.5, end: burst + light + sound('whoosh'/'sparkle') }) }}, and fire one in cast too. Drop the night 'light' effect or make it 'dusk' launches. Thicken ev

rows.name: Mana Storm
rows.promise: A violet arcane whirlwind drifts for about thirty seconds, lifting loose stones and sweeping foes off their feet, sparing sleepers and oaks, then leaves glowing motes.
rows.does: A glowing violet vortex body (r 6) drifts slowly for 30 s, sheds sparks, deletes free voxels under it, throws and stuns every creature in reach each frame, and leaves lingering motes at the end.
rows.missing: Loose stones are erased with w.unvoxel instead of lifted, and that can erase tree voxels, so oaks are not spared. Villagers are thrown like foes. The sleeper check reads c.data.asleep, which probably does not exist. There is no wind.
rows.fix: Lift stones: spawn stone or shard bodies with upward and spiral velocity instead of w.unvoxel, and skip cells whose cover is tree. Push only creatures whose w.nature(c) is hostile or undead, and skip sleepers by their sleep status. Add a swirling w.wind as the body drifts.

rows.name: Mandrake
rows.promise: A small glowing green root that makes plants grow around it, keeps tilled fields steady, and hums sleepily when living things are near.
rows.does: Places a small root figure with glowing leaves and an artifact that grows plants within 4 cells every 12 s, paints grass within 3 cells every 20 s, waters fields in drought, lights up and drones at night, and draws villagers to worship it.
rows.missing: Its grass paint can turn tilled fields back into grass, the opposite of steadying them; the hum plays only at night rather than when living things are near; the worship and lure are extras the entry never mentions.
rows.fix: Drop the w.paint 'grass' act or skip cells whose ground is 'field' (use w.water/grow on fields instead); trigger the drone/rustle in an act that checks w.creatures(self.x, self.y, 4).length > 0; remove uses worship and lures villager unless tied to the water grant.

rows.name: Marsh Light
rows.promise: A pale-green glowing marsh liquid that gives a steady ghostly light in bogs and calls wandering wisps to it.
rows.does: Lays a small glowing pale-green fluid pool under a 3-voxel wooden post with a magic voxel on top. An artifact lights the area at night, sparkles over any spirits within 7 cells, and fires a random beam every 15 s.
rows.missing: Nothing ever calls wisps in: no spirit is spawned, and the lure only works if spirits already happen to wander near. The item is a creature, yet no creature appears, and the lantern is bare voxels rather than a drawn lantern.
rows.fix: Declare a pale-green 'wisp' creature (base spirit, glow, behavior wander, goal tend or explore, active night) and add an artifact effect {when: 'dusk', every: 60, do: 'summon:wisp'} so wisps really gather. Spawn one wisp on arrival, and draw the lantern post with a w.model.

rows.name: Marsh Lights
rows.promise: Drifting pale green flame-orbs at shoulder height that serve as undying lanterns and lead the way across bog and fen.
rows.does: Raises a stone post with a glowing green orb, puffs steam, and spawns three glowing green spirit wisps that follow villagers and scare beasts; an artifact lights the dark at night.
rows.missing: The wisps never mark or lead a path across marsh or water. They are weak to water, so they die in the fen they belong to. The second artifact effect puts a function in `do` instead of `act`, so the engine drops the mist. The item is a creature but was built as a lantern-post artifact.
rows.fix: Drop the post and the artifact. Make 'marsh wisp' a creature with no water weakness, `active: "night"`, `lures: ["villager"]`, and a custom goal that seeks water and swamp, plus an act that leaves a trail of dim light or w.light along dry cells. If the mist effect stays, move its code to `act`. Use

rows.name: Mausoleum
rows.promise: A small grey weathered stone hall among the houses, its doorway carved with names, where the dead rest and a quiet hush keeps the ground around it calm.
rows.does: Raises a village chapel building and a 1x1 stack of grey boxes with a dark door beside it, places a calm-aura landmark, then domes the whole village in a 600-second ward against everything, with periodic healing and night light.
rows.missing: The look is a stock chapel plus a tiny stone column, not a stone hall with carved names. Nothing touches the dead. A village-wide ward, healing and night light are added though the entry promises only a calm hush, not a shield.
rows.fix: Remove the w.ward and the heal and light effects. Draw the mausoleum itself with w.model (plinth steps, columns, pediment roof, a carved lintel with glowing names). Keep the calm landmark. Tie it to the dead, e.g. pairs {with: 'corpse', do: act that lays the body to rest} or a priest burial job.

rows.name: Merfolk
rows.promise: A slender silver-scaled sea-person who lives in water and scouts wrecks, guards harbors and carries messages across deep water.
rows.does: Spawns a fish-bodied glowing creature at the tap point, whether there is water or not, that guards, heals nearby and shields. It also raises an hour-long ward over the whole spot and places an invisible artifact that heals every 40 seconds.
rows.missing: It has no sea-person look (it is a plain fish body) and is never sent to water. It does no scouting or message carrying. An hour-long dome over the village is far too big for a minor creature and becomes the main thing the player sees.
rows.fix: Use body 'serpent' or 'two legs' with a tail and color2 scales. Find water with w.nearest('water') and spawn it there. Give it a custom goal that swims to wrecks or between villages and carries goods or messages, with 'guard' as its fallback. Drop lib.lastingWard and the heal artifact, and use a spl

rows.name: Meteor Storm
rows.promise: The sky splits with a roar and cart-sized burning stones rain across a wide area for about ten seconds, cratering the land, knocking creatures flat, scattering birds and leaving long-lasting scorch marks.
rows.does: Opens a glowing rift in the sky and drops about 40 meteor bodies over 10 seconds across w.r. Each impact explodes, digs a crater, lays ash and basalt, starts fires, puffs smoke, and pushes, stuns and hurts nearby creatures. Birds are flung and frightened, and dark scorch marks stay on the land for 1

rows.name: Midgard
rows.promise: World Tree roots break the soil into a sheltered valley ringed with pale meadow, where crops grow fast, people settle, and the meadows hum at dusk.
rows.does: Carves a valley (r 12), lays a ring of spreading pale meadow, sows crop fields, and rings it with trees. A model shows seven arching roots with glowing sap around a stump-mound. At dawn the place grows plants, it feeds the village, and at each dusk it drones, glows, sends up motes and brings a farme

rows.name: Mine
rows.promise: A stone mine-mouth cut into the earth, with knocking picks, that brings ore, gems and buried water up to the surface.
rows.does: Raises a small hill with a dirt track and a stone tunnel mouth (dark opening, lantern, rails, ore cart, spoil heap). It sends gold to the nearest village each dawn, grants gold to visiting villagers, scatters crystal around the mouth every 40 seconds, and clangs and shakes faintly at night like dist

rows.name: Mirror
rows.promise: A small black-glass scrying mirror in bronze that reveals hidden rivals and exposes impostors, and stares back at whoever holds it too long.
rows.does: Draws a bronze-rimmed disc on a stand. About every 20 seconds it beams a gold ray at a nearby enemy and frightens it for 3 seconds. It lures villagers but offers them nothing, and gives off one gold mote a minute; the test saw it act once in five minutes.
rows.missing: Nothing is ever revealed: no hidden, disguised or night creature is exposed or marked, so the central promise of watching and unmasking is absent. The fear-gaze only loosely covers 'stares back'.
rows.fix: Add an effect, every 20 seconds and at night, that scans w.creatures(self.x, self.y, radius) for hostile, undead or spirit kinds and marks each one with w.light and c.tint, plus a short w.beam from the glass. Grant villagers who come to it something real, such as fear on any lurker it exposes, or dr

rows.name: Mirror Image
rows.promise: Three flickering heat-haze copies of the caster appear and draw attacks, which find only a puff of warm smoke.
rows.does: Opens with a ground circle, a smoke puff and a burst. It raises a 20-second ward dome, then spawns three glowing generic spirits that guard their spot for 60 seconds with 1 hp.
rows.missing: The copies mirror no one and decoy nothing: they lure no attackers, follow nobody and die without smoke. The protection really comes from a ward dome that the name never mentions.
rows.fix: Make the copies follow the nearest villager (behavior follow, leader villager, its colors via tint) with lures: ["hostile"] so raiders strike them, and onDeath "smoke". Drop the ward or make it a brief extra.

rows.name: Mist
rows.promise: A silver bowl of drifting cool vapor that hangs over the place and carries soft rain to dry fields.
rows.does: Rings a small silver-grey voxel rim, puffs steam, and leaves a slowly bobbing cloud above it; the artifact rains at dusk, waters dry fields in drought and gives villagers water for their crops.

rows.name: Mithril Vein
rows.promise: A spot where a thin, silver-bright mithril seam runs under firm green ground and can be mined for wealth.
rows.does: Raises a small hill, lays a glinting stripe of mithril ore that creeps slowly into dirt, sets a small stone-and-silver-crystal model there, and leaves an artifact that sends gold to the nearest village, grows plants and sparkles.

rows.name: Moonlit Lake
rows.promise: A still, silver lake that glows faintly from below, ringed by reeds, that lulls nearby creatures and weary travelers to sleep.
rows.does: A glowing orb falls and opens an ordinary water lake (about 166 cells) with sand and scattered bushes at its edge. An artifact then shines a light at night, puts up to 6 creatures within 8 cells to sleep every 25 s, re-sands and grows plants every 40 s, and grants heal.
rows.missing: The water is plain water, not silver and not glowing (only a passing w.light at night), and the bushes do not read as reeds. The lake is small for a grand item, and the sleep reach (8 cells) does not cover a lake that can reach 16 cells.
rows.fix: Declare a 'moonwater' fluid in spell.materials (pale silver colors, glow: true, flow low) and flood the lake bed with it, ring it with tall reed-like bushes or a reed model, make the lake grand-sized (r around w.r*0.5), set the artifact radius to the lake radius plus 2, and drop scares: ['spirit'].

rows.name: Moonstone
rows.promise: A never-melting cold ice stone that soothes and heals the feverish and keeps food fresh in summer heat.
rows.does: Places a tiny ice-and-gold lozenge on a plinth with an artifact that grants healing (3 charges) and casts 'freeze' in radius 4 every 30 s and when fire is near; in the test a villager took it, and no cell changed.
rows.missing: The chill showed nothing on the land (0 cells changed), the periodic 'freeze' may freeze bystanders instead of soothing them, and nothing keeps food fresh.
rows.fix: Replace the every-30 s 'freeze' with an act that calls w.temperature(self.x, self.y, 2, -15) for a gentle cool, keep the fire-triggered freeze and the heal grant, and add a food-keeping effect (e.g. a 'food' effect at dawn for the nearest village's stores).

rows.name: Morning Breeze
rows.promise: A gentle golden draft that spirals out, stirs and cools the air over a field or village, and leaves the people there rested and bright.
rows.does: Opens with a golden circle, a whoosh and a soft light, sends eight golden rings spiraling outward with glowing trails, and sets a light wind. It cools the area by 6 degrees, heals and calms every creature in reach, and leaves a lasting healing aura over the area.

rows.name: Mud Golem
rows.promise: A stooped, dripping mud-and-clay golem that walks about leaving wet footprints and works as a patient digger and carrier.
rows.does: With a squelch and a splash of mud-colored specks, it spawns a brown golem-bodied creature with glowing eyes. The golem wanders, gathers and carries goods, leaves mud on the cells it walks (which dries into dirt), digs now and then, and turns to mud when it dies.

rows.name: Mudslide
rows.promise: A house-tall brown wave of earth sweeps across the target area, knocks creatures down, buries crops in sludge and leaves a slick crust that dries over about ten minutes.
rows.does: One brown cloud body, 3 cells across and low to the ground, drifts west through the center for 8 seconds, laying slick mud and a shallow mud flood in a strip about 5 cells wide. It pushes, frightens and hurts creatures in that strip every frame, and the mud decays to dirt after 600 s. The test run d
rows.missing: There is no wave front: a single low puff paints a narrow strip instead of a house-tall wall sweeping the whole area, and it runs on to 2.8 w.r. Creatures are feared, not knocked off their feet, while hurt(1) every frame makes it a killer. Painting and flooding every frame likely stalled the run.
rows.fix: Send a row of 5 to 7 bodies spaced across about 1.2 w.r as one front, each drawn tall (r 2 to 3 at z 2 to 3) with a brown wall of particles, and stop it after about 2 w.r of travel. Paint and flood only when a body has moved a cell or more, or lay the mud once with w.line along each path. Hit each c

rows.name: Nebula
rows.promise: A spot under low, slowly shimmering violet and gold sky ribbons, with faintly glowing grass and drifting star mist where sleepers wake calmer.
rows.does: Paints glowing violet starlit grass and violet-gold star mist, and draws a dais, sleeping hollows, standing stones and glowing ribbons. A lasting body keeps circling violet and gold particle ribbons overhead. The artifact puts villagers to sleep in the mist at night and calms everyone nearby by day.

rows.name: Necromancer
rows.promise: A pale, tendril-veined necromancer who leaves frost where it walks, gathers bones, whispers to the restless dead and silently guards a forgotten tomb.
rows.does: Adds an ordinary villager titled Necromancer, a small glowing grave-lantern model and a near-invisible hour-long ward over the whole village that blocks fire, floods, lightning, cold and raiders.
rows.missing: There is no necromancy at all: no dead are raised or summoned, no bones are gathered, no frost trail and no tomb to guard. The generic village-wide shield stands in for 'guardian of tombs' and is large for a minor creature.
rows.fix: Replace the hour-long village lastingWard with a small crypt or grave model plus w.landmark. Hire the necromancer with a custom spell.goals job that seeks corpses or bones and carries them to the crypt. Declare a skeleton spell.creatures entry (base: undead, behavior: guard) raised at night via an a

rows.name: Necromancy
rows.promise: Pale blue mist rises and the recently dead in reach stand up restored, peaceful, for one hour, then lie back down to rest in green grass.
rows.does: Pale blue circle and rising mist, then revives every corpse within w.r, calms it for an hour and sets grass under it; after an hour a hidden body puts the risen to sleep for 10 minutes.
rows.missing: The risen never return to death: after the hour they only sleep for 10 minutes and then live on, so the temporary return the entry centers on never ends.
rows.fix: In the body's end(b, w), call c.kill() on each risen creature that is still alive (with a soft burst and w.set grass under it) instead of c.status('sleep', 600); optionally lay a short-lived green cover so the grass reads as kept green.

rows.name: Necropolis
rows.promise: A settlement of pale stone streets and tomb-houses with blue lanterns over the doors, where the quiet dead dwell and the living come to tend graves.
rows.does: Raises an ordinary 12-house village, paints scattered rock, rings it with eight plain stone boxes, adds a chapel and four blue-glowing lanterns at the plaza; its artifact lights the night, revives a corpse every two minutes and is worshipped.
rows.missing: The houses are normal village houses, not tombs or crypts, and the tombs are bare boxes. No pale streets are laid. The quiet dead never appear. The 'gravekeeper' job is hired but never defined, so no one tends the markers.
rows.fix: Lay pale stone streets with w.line. Draw crypts and grave markers with w.model instead of w.box, and set blue lanterns at house doors. Add a night-active, calm-aura 'shade' spirit kind that lingers among the tombs. Define a spell.goals 'gravekeeper' that seeks the tombs and tends them, so the w.hire

rows.name: Nexus
rows.promise: A glowing meadow where two ley lines cross, with pale blue mana crystals that glow at dusk and draw mages to meditate and recharge their power.
rows.does: Paints glowing mana crystal ground (radius 4) that slowly spreads into grass, and draws a stone ring, blue crystal cones and two thin glowing lines crossing 3 cells each way. The artifact lights up at dusk, grows plants every 30 s and grants villagers healing.
rows.missing: No mages ever come to draw power or meditate; a generic heal grant stands in for that. The crossed ley lines are a thin 6-cell decal, small for a grand place.
rows.fix: Replace the heal grant with grants [{what: 'prayer'}] for meditation. Add an effect whose act calls w.person with calling 'Mage' near the crossing now and then. Lay the two ley lines as long w.line strips of mana crystal running well beyond the circle, so the crossing reads at a distance.

rows.name: Night
rows.promise: A circle of land falls into indigo night with silver stars, its creatures fall asleep and lights sputter, and dawn returns after a long while.
rows.does: Sweeps a half-arc of dark clouds out from the caster, darkens the sky for 8 minutes, paints an indigo gradient over a region of radius 1.4 w.r with twinkling stars, puts every creature in that circle to sleep every 3 seconds, then ends with a warm dawn tint and light.

rows.name: Nightmare
rows.promise: A smoldering black-violet flame horse with ember mane and spark hooves that guards, calms a frightened village and lights the dark road.
rows.does: Spawns a glowing dark-violet horned horse that guards at night with a calm aura, scares wolves and bears, breathes fire at enemies and teleports when hurt.
rows.missing: Nothing shows it is made of flame: no embers rising from the mane, no sparks at the hooves, no light on the road. Its fire breath can also set alight the village it is meant to calm.
rows.fix: Add a custom ability act every few seconds that emits rising ember w.particle from the mane, spark particles at the hooves and a small w.light at night. Replace 'breathe fire' with an act that frightens off enemies, or skip it near houses using w.wouldHurt.

rows.name: Ninja
rows.promise: A lean shadow ninja appears, slips unseen across rooftops, blinks away into dusk and reappears at a distance, scouting and guarding, leaving a trace of cold ash.
rows.does: A smoky puff, then an ordinary guard villager titled 'Ninja' joins the nearest village and patrols like any guard.
rows.missing: Nothing makes it a ninja: no shadowy look, no blink into dusk and reappearing elsewhere, no stealth, no ash trail. The summary's 'vanishes into cold ash when threatened' is not in the code.
rows.fix: Keep w.person for the human role and add the signature: a custom ability (act) that, when an enemy is near or every ~20s, bursts dark-grey ash and moves it with teleport to a spot a few cells away (e.g. near a rooftop), plus a small ash puff with w.burst where it lands, and dark clothing via tint.

rows.name: Noah
rows.promise: A swimming tortoise-horse with a garden on its back that ferries travelers and seeds across floods and calms rough water.
rows.does: Spawns a glowing four-legged 'noah' (armor, tail, mane) that swims, wanders, leaves flowers, heals, grows plants, has a calm aura on creatures, lures villagers and scares wolves and bears; the cast also floods a small puddle and paints grass.
rows.missing: Nothing ferries anyone or carries seeds across water, its breath never calms water, it has no shell or back-garden look, and its hide never shifts colors; the healing and the wolf/bear scaring are extras the entry never promised.
rows.fix: Give it a spell.goals 'ferry' (seek villager near water, act: teleport them to the far shore with carry 'seeds') plus an ability whose act calls w.drain on flooded cells nearby. Draw a domed shell with moss and fern parts as a model. Drop the heal abilities and the wolf/bear scares.

rows.name: Oasis
rows.promise: A small shallow pool ringed by grass, reeds and palms, with the sand around it turned fertile for a while before it dries again.
rows.does: Uses the engine's oasis shape (a spring-fed pool), lays a spreading fertile loam that takes over sand and decays to dirt over about 25 minutes, and adds grass, growth, four growing palms and a ring of bushes.

rows.name: Oblivion
rows.promise: A dark sphere that pulls everything it touches inward and unmakes it to grey dust, stills creatures, then collapses and leaves a bare scorched ring.
rows.does: A violet spiral sigil gathers into a black orb and vortex. A widening ring turns cover, water and ground to cold dust and kills creatures inside it while pulling outer ones inward. It ends in a crater, a shockwave and an hour of sleep for all creatures nearby.

rows.name: Obsidian Throne
rows.promise: A black volcanic-glass throne veined with slow red Underworld light that rises toward a resting hand and steadies a mage's mind.
rows.does: Draws a dark throne model and places an artifact that calms every creature within 6 cells every 20 s with rising red sparks. It also lights the night, shields against enemies, heals and is worshipped by villagers.
rows.missing: The red veins are drawn 0.02–0.03 thick, so the model loses its threaded glow. Night light, shield, heal and worship are unpromised extras.
rows.fix: Thicken the glowing vein parts to at least 0.125 on eighths, and drop the night light, the shield effect, the heal grant and the worship use. Keep the calm act and rising embers, and maybe give it a grant of its own, like a short 'steady' calm/stun-immunity granted to villagers who sit.

rows.name: Orpheus
rows.promise: A slow, pale, lantern-eyed walker that wanders settlement edges murmuring the names of the dead and briefly sings the fallen back, leaving the living colder.
rows.does: Spawns a grey two-legged glowing creature with a constant freeze aura (r 2.5) that raises the dead every 40s, heals when a friend dies, and drops one glowing mote at villages; in the test it moved only 4 cells in two minutes.
rows.missing: It barely wanders (4 cells), never murmurs, and its constant freeze aura locks nearby creatures in place instead of a slight chill when the song fades; the dead may stay up for good, and the healing and wolf/bear scare are unasked.
rows.fix: Have the remember goal's act play w.sound('whisper') with its mote and seek houses at the village edge with short work; replace aura freeze with a custom raise ability that revives nearby corpses for a set time, then calls w.temperature(self.x, self.y, 3, -10); drop the heal ability and wolf/bear sc

rows.name: Paladin
rows.promise: A tireless plate-armored knight who walks beside the lost and frightened, guiding them along a road and spreading calm courage around it.
rows.does: Plants a glowing sword model, makes one villager titled Paladin with the guard job, raises an hour-long ward dome over the spot and slowly heals that villager under a gold star.
rows.missing: It never walks beside or guides anyone and gives no calm courage to those nearby. It is a stationary guard under a fixed dome, not an escort on a road.
rows.fix: Drop or shrink the fixed hour-long ward. In the Paladin's lasting body tick, every few seconds find frightened or wounded villagers within about 4 cells with w.creatures(p.x, p.y, 4), give them status('calm'), and lead the nearest lost one toward w.nearest('village') (push or seek), with the Paladin

rows.name: Paradise
rows.promise: A sunlit meadow of fruit trees and spreading rare herbs round a clear spring, whose dawn paths restore weary land.
rows.does: Raises a spring pond in a stone rim inside a grass-and-flower meadow, with eight blossoming fruit trees, stone paths, an arbor, a bench, herb beds and spreading eden herbs. At each dawn, four glowing orbs travel out along the paths, turning ash and dirt to grass, clearing acid, poison and smoke, and

rows.name: Paradise Lost
rows.promise: A cracked glass seed whose dust wards land, withers blight and reclaims poisoned fields, leaving a quiet hush behind.
rows.does: Hangs a voxel glass seed over a stone block, raises a 600 s ward, lights it, heals and shields on fire or enemies, and seeds a ring of slowly spreading loam that turns ash, basalt and dirt to grass (24 cells in five minutes).
rows.missing: Nothing clears poison gas or acid or restores blighted crops, and the reclaiming barely spreads. Prayer, worship, a beast scare and a calm aura are extras the seed never promises, and the 'silence' is not shown.
rows.fix: Add a dawn effect with act(self, w) that runs w.clear on poison gas and acid within about 14 cells, repaints ash and dirt as eden loam or field, and grows crops back. Let eden loam also spread into acid-eaten and poisoned cells at a higher rate. Drop the prayer and worship grants, the beast scare an

rows.name: Pebble
rows.promise: A small smooth grey river stone that hums, ripples like rain on a pond, stays cool, and reveals the depth of nearby wells and water.
rows.does: A ping, a flash and a small ripple ring, then a 3-cell lump of stone voxels. An artifact waters dry fields within 4 cells in a drought and grants water to villagers.
rows.missing: Nothing reveals anything: no sensing or showing of nearby water or its depth. There is no hum, and the look is a crude voxel ball rather than a smooth pebble on a model.
rows.fix: Draw it with w.model as a small rounded grain stone with a faint glowing ripple. Add an effect act that finds w.nearest('water') and marks it with w.circle or w.light, sized by its cell depth, to show the depth. Use a 'drone' or 'water' sound for the hum instead of 'ping'.

rows.name: Phoenix Flight
rows.promise: The caster and up to three companions rise on shimmering phoenix wings for a minute: faster, harder to hit, leaving a gentle warm trail that never burns.
rows.does: Lifts up to four nearest villagers (or a new Phoenix Rider) with levitate for 60 s, tinted gold, with flickering flame-wing particles, an afterimage trail, extra push for speed, mild heat, and recovery of most damage taken.

rows.name: Phoenix Flock
rows.promise: A roosting flock of small ember-red and gold phoenixes that glow warmly, rekindle fires they gather round, shed drifting feathers and watch over hearths.
rows.does: Raises a stone spire with a glowing orb, spawns 4 flying, glowing, healing 'phoenix' spirits that guard the spot, and adds a healing, night-lighting artifact under an hour-long ward that keeps fire, lava, blasts and raiders out.
rows.missing: The birds never rekindle fire (the ward even blocks fire) and never shed feathers; the healing aura and the hour-long dome over the village are extras the entry never promises and they dominate the item.
rows.fix: Drop lib.lastingWard and the heal effects; give the phoenix a custom goal or ability that seeks hearths and houses at dusk and uses w.fire or w.heat for a soft ember glow, or rekindles a nearby fire, and leaves warmth. Emit drifting feather particles when the flock stirs, and draw the roost as a w.m

rows.name: Photosynthesis
rows.promise: Golden sunlight pours into a small circle and every plant in it surges a season's growth: crops, hedges and saplings thicken and green.
rows.does: Gold beams fall into a gold-green circle, glowing motes rise, empty field cells sprout crops and w.grow fills the ring with grass and plants over three seconds (94 cells changed), ending in a green-gold burst and light.

rows.name: Phylactery
rows.promise: A small tarnished-silver vessel that anchors souls: the fallen near it come back, paler and colder, and it keeps them from harm.
rows.does: Stacks a stone box and a silver sphere with an amber voxel, heals within 4 cells every 12 s, revives a corpse within 3 cells on a death, and raises an endless low ward that the test found stopped no blast or raiders.
rows.missing: Its protection barely works (0% against a blast or raiders), and a revived villager pays no cost in memory or warmth, which the entry makes central.
rows.fix: Call w.ward(w.x, w.y, r, {seconds: 30}) directly over the nearby villagers instead of the Infinity lib ward; replace the revive with an act that calls c.revive() then c.tint a pale grey and c.hurt part of its hp, to show the price.

rows.name: Pirates
rows.promise: A few tentacled kraken-sailor pirates that rove the water, steal treasure and, as sea guardians, hunt down whatever threatens their waters.
rows.does: Spawns 2 or 3 eight-legged, hatted, sword-bearing swimmers that raid villages for loot and hunt fish and birds, and raises an hour-long dome ward over the landing spot.
rows.missing: The guardian part is a static dome rather than pirates hunting threats; they prey on harmless fish and birds instead of reef-wreckers or hostiles. They also raid the same village their ward protects, and nothing keeps them on the water.
rows.fix: Drop lib.lastingWard and set prey to ['hostile'] (or a declared reef-wrecker kind), with goal 'guard' or a custom sea-raiding goal that seeks water and carries loot. Spawn them at w.nearest('water') so they appear and rove at sea.

rows.name: Prism
rows.promise: A fist-sized frosty crystal with a drifting rainbow inside that freezes moments: slows rain, calms storms and stills blades.
rows.does: Leaves a small round ball of pale magic voxels. Its artifact freezes everything within 4 cells every 25 seconds and when fire is near, lights the night, and raises a ward every 60 seconds; rainbow sparks show only for the first second.
rows.missing: Nothing stills a fight or calms rain or storms, and the rainbow is gone after arrival. The ward and night light were never promised, and a round blob does not read as a faceted crystal.
rows.fix: Draw a faceted crystal with w.model on a small stone, in ice tones with glowing rainbow facets. Replace the light and shield effects with an 'enemy' act that stuns or freezes the fighters from w.fights in its radius, and add a 'drought' or 'every' act that stops rain or wind nearby.

rows.name: Prismatic Storm
rows.promise: A rainbow whirlwind of light for ten seconds that dazzles foes and sweeps them, with leaves and pebbles, into a vortex that lifts them a hand's height before they settle.
rows.does: Converging rainbow beams, then a 10 s stationary vortex body (r 3) that nudges every creature within 0.7 r in a faint swirl, levitates and randomly stuns them, while sparse rainbow motes rise and voxels near the center are silently deleted.
rows.missing: No storm wind and no leaves or pebbles swirling: unvoxel erases nearby voxels instead of lifting them. The beams converge rather than scatter, the per-frame push is tiny, and villagers are dazzled and lifted along with foes.
rows.fix: Add w.wind and spawn swirling leaf and pebble particles or small bodies orbiting the funnel instead of w.unvoxel. Stun and lift only w.here().hostile (or skip villagers), strengthen the tangential push, and fire some beams outward from the funnel so the light scatters.

rows.name: Purification
rows.promise: Within about ten metres, cursed creatures and blighted soil glow for a while, then shed their corruption and are restored; curses and blight only, not wounds or death.
rows.does: Circles a white ring overhead, then raises a day-long ward against fire, lava, blasts and raiders. It paints 40% grass over whatever ground lies within 0.7 r, and in four pulses hurts, scares and pushes away undead (and raiders and bandits) while healing and calming every other creature.
rows.missing: Nothing is cleansed: undead are hurt and driven off, not restored. The ground gets grass wherever it is, not just where it is blighted. Wounds are healed although the entry says they are not. The 24-hour ward is a protection the entry never promises.
rows.fix: Drop the lastingWard and the c.heal. Find blight (ash, poison gas, acid, mud or a custom blight material via w.cell or w.here) and replace only that with grass or dirt, clearing poison gas with w.clear. Let shadow-touched creatures glow with tint or light for a few seconds, then transform them back

rows.name: Purifying Flame
rows.promise: A short fan of white fire from the palms that burns undead in the cone with silver flame for about ten seconds, sparing the living and plants.
rows.does: Gathers white sparks at the target, then fans nine pale flame bodies and a glowing cone toward the nearest undead. Every undead in that arc is tinted silver, stunned and frightened, and hurt every half second for ten seconds amid white sparks and falling grey ash until it crumbles; nothing else is t

rows.name: Quagmire
rows.promise: A small circle of black, clinging tar for about a minute that holds creatures inside without harming them, then hardens again.
rows.does: Paints a 3.5-cell disc of black tar that decays to rock after 60 s. A ring and rising bubbles mark it, and a body re-stuns every creature inside every half second for the full minute.

rows.name: Quintessence
rows.promise: A lasting wisp of humming, pale gold mist hanging in the air, slowly spiralling, brightening when people speak near it and lending lightness to what it touches.
rows.does: A glowing gold vortex circles about 5 voxels up, shedding spiral particles and lighting up and levitating creatures that come near. It seeps a glowing fluid that lures villagers and later hardens to crystal. It leaves a calm landmark, then bursts and vanishes after 240 s.
rows.missing: The object does not last: the mist is a timed body that ends after four minutes (the test saw it working for 104 s), and the calm landmark is all that stays. It never hums, only chimes and pings.
rows.fix: Make it a persistent w.artifact with spell.artifacts effects (an act every few seconds that sets levitate on creatures nearby and brightens with w.light), and draw the hanging mist with a glowing w.model or a re-spawned body. Use w.sound("drone") for the hum and drop the unpromised calm aura.

rows.name: Radiance
rows.promise: A slow golden wave pours out and leaves everything it touches lit in warm light for ten minutes, shadows fading and those inside rested.
rows.does: Golden shockwaves expand to 1.4 r over six seconds, growing plants, healing and calming every creature for 600 s and tinting them gold, with a lasting light of only 0.5 r at the center.
rows.missing: The ten-minute brightness covers only the inner third of the area the wave touches, so most of the bathed land and creatures are not left lit.
rows.fix: Make the lasting w.light cover the whole wave (radius R = w.r * 1.4, 600 s), or add a few glowing lights along the wave's path, so everything it touched stays bright.

rows.name: Rainbow Phoenix
rows.promise: A small rainbow bird of living light, perched on a brass stand, that renews itself and heals wounded birds with its embers.
rows.does: Spawns a flying pink-and-cyan bird with a heal aura that tends and wanders, places a plank box and an invisible stand artifact that revives nearby corpses and casts light, with a one-time rainbow burst and beams on arrival.
rows.missing: The bird is only two-toned, so the rainbow shows only in the arrival flash. It never renews itself on death, the 'brass stand' is a plain brown wood box, and its healing is not aimed at birds.
rows.fix: Give the creature a spectrum look (cycle tint() through the seven colors or use a model with rainbow feather boxes) and onDeath: 'spawn:rainbow phoenix' for rebirth. Draw the perch as a w.model brass stand with a ring and base. Have it heal birds and beasts, not only villagers.

rows.name: Renaissance
rows.promise: A slow golden restoration over a wide area: dead and burnt plants green again, ruins rebuild, worn creatures regain vigor, and the mending lasts a while.
rows.does: A golden circle and rising beams, then a wave that puts out fires, turns rubble back into houses, stumps into trees and ash into grass, and heals every creature (and revives corpses). It sets trees in blossom, adds growth and flowers, and a hidden body keeps mending random patches for 5 minutes.

rows.name: Salvation
rows.promise: A pale gold rain over the threatened land that revives the dead, heals every wound and sickness, wipes out blight, plague and invading swarms, and keeps the land restored for a season.
rows.does: A gold beam and circle, then a ring of glowing gold drops sweeps across the whole island. It clears poison and smoke, acid and fire, turns ash to grass, revives and fully heals native creatures and calms them, kills every non-native creature, then raises a 600-second gold ward and regrows plants.

rows.name: Sanctuary
rows.promise: A glowing green stone at a village threshold that keeps out fire, the dark and wild things, and soothes the hurt nearby.
rows.does: Sets a small pale-green glowing stone, raises a renewed ward over the village for an hour against fire, fluids, lightning, harm and beasts, lights the area at night and heals everyone within 6 cells every 30 seconds.

rows.name: Sandworm
rows.promise: A small, arm-length coil of amber sand with glinting green scales that slithers, stirs up sudden gusts and burrows to loosen stone.
rows.does: Paints a patch of spreading drift sand and spawns one large (radius 3) ochre-and-bone serpent that hunts deer, rabbits and boar, self-heals and leaves creeping sand that turns grass and dirt to sand.
rows.missing: No gusts and no stone loosening. It has no green scales and is drawn as a big predator rather than an arm-length creature. The spreading sand that eats grassland and the self-heal are not in the entry.
rows.fix: Use radius about 0.8, color2 green ('#4fa36a') for the scales, and behavior wander with a burrow goal that digs at rock and turns it to sand or rubble. Add an ability that calls w.wind() and w.gas or a burst of grit as a gust every so often. Drop the heal, and make drift sand stay put or decay to sa

rows.name: Scrying Mirror
rows.promise: A black obsidian mirror with drifting silver threads that shows a pale image of a distant place: markets, forests, rival towers.
rows.does: Drops a plain 2x2 dark stone box, puffs silver motes every 6 s, beams and briefly lights one random creature within 30 cells every 25 s, glows at night, and villagers pray to it while beasts are scared off.
rows.missing: It never reveals a distant place: one beam to a random nearby creature is the only glimpse. The look is a box, not a polished disc with silver veins. Prayer, worship and scaring beasts are not in the entry.
rows.fix: Draw it with w.model as an upright obsidian disc on a stand with glowing silver vein parts. Make its act pick a distant spot (w.nearest village, house or hostile beyond its radius), light it with w.light and a beam, and paint a pale silver image of that place on the mirror face with w.draw, or brief

rows.name: Seal Skin
rows.promise: A selkie's wet pelt that lets its wearer slip through tides and storms, keeps out the cold, and stiffens if left dry.
rows.does: Hangs a magic-block pelt on a wooden rack beside a small pool and waters nearby fields. It also raises an hour-long dome over the whole village against fire, lava, lightning, blasts and raiders.
rows.missing: Nothing transforms or carries anyone through water. The protection is a generic village-wide shield against everything, far too big for a cantrip and not about waves or cold. Nothing happens if the pelt dries out.
rows.fix: Remove lib.lastingWard and its all-purpose dome. Add an effect act that briefly turns a nearby villager into a swimming 'selkie' kind (swims: true, immune cold) or gives a small short w.ward against fluids and cold to someone near water. The act should do nothing when w.nearest('water') is far, so a

rows.name: Sealskin
rows.promise: A shimmering selkie hide cloak that lets its wearer slip unseen through water and fog and rest calmly on any lake's surface.
rows.does: Drops a small grey stone block with a ring and burst. The artifact lights up at night, waters dry fields in drought, gives water to villagers and calms nearby fish and deer.
rows.missing: There is no hide, no wearer, no stealth in water or fog, no floating on lakes and no seal transformation. The night light contradicts 'unseen', and the drought watering belongs to a well, not a cloak.
rows.fix: Draw a draped silver-grey pelt over a stone with w.model instead of w.box, and drop the light and drought-water effects. Add an act effect that wraps a nearby villager in the skin: levitate status on water to sit calmly on the surface, plus fog around them via w.gas steam so hunters (wolf) near them

rows.name: Selkie
rows.promise: A shimmering seal-grey selkie pelt, tied to sea and tide, that calms and speaks to animals and moves through water unseen.
rows.does: Drops a plain grey stone box with an artifact that grows grass, lights the night and grants healing, then spawns one fish-based grey 'selkie' with a calm aura that wanders and lures villagers.
rows.missing: The pelt reads as a 2x1x2 stone block. Grow, night light and healing have nothing to do with a selkie. The selkie is a fish spawned on the tap spot, which may not be water, and nothing shows slipping unseen or moving with the tide.
rows.fix: Replace the w.box with a w.model of a draped, rippling seal pelt on a shore rock. Drop the grow, light and heal effects. Spawn the selkie at w.nearest('water'), as a seal-like body with swims, calm aura on beasts and a goal that moves between sea and shore, and add an act effect that briefly hides o

rows.name: Seraph
rows.promise: A rooted, luminous white-feathered sentinel with wings of light and a pulsing green heart that shields a grove and heals the wounded and the forest.
rows.does: It builds a silver-rooted white figure with wings of light and a pulsing green heart-light, then raises a 600-second ward over the area. Its artifact heals every 20 s, regrows plants at dawn, casts Rain on fire and shields against enemies, and villagers come to it for healing and prayer.

rows.name: Shade
rows.promise: A slender shadow figure that mimics nearby people's movements and acts as a sentinel, warning of intruders in a whisper.
rows.does: Spawns a dark hooded glowing spirit that follows villagers; near enemies it makes a faint wind sound and four particles every 15 s, teleports now and then, and scares wolves.
rows.missing: No visible mimicry of anyone's steps and no real warning or reveal of intruders. Being weak to light and active at night with nowhere to hide by day, it likely dies or idles; the test run failed it as idle after 4 seconds.
rows.fix: Drop 'light' from weak, or give it a den or shade to wait in until dusk. Make the whisper ability reveal the intruder (w.light or w.beam on the target, then status 'fear' on it or alert nearby villagers), and have it shadow the intruder's path with seek(target.x, target.y) so it visibly copies their

rows.name: Shadow Double
rows.promise: A smoked-obsidian mirror that splits off a dark copy of whoever stands before it, a double that lags behind them, scouts and keeps watch.
rows.does: Stacks a plain stone-and-magic voxel post with a crossbar, paints ash and places an artifact that lures villagers. Only at night does it spawn a generic dark spirit that guards its spot for 90s. Its enemy effect casts light, which hurts that same light-weak spirit.
rows.missing: Placed by day, nothing but a block post appears (the test run summoned nothing). The double copies no one, never follows or scouts, and the look is a column of boxes, not a framed mirror.
rows.fix: Draw the mirror with w.model (silver frame, dark glowing glass, stand). On placement spawn a shadow double at once and on a pair/effect copy the nearest villager (tint dark, follow that villager as leader, goal explore to scout). Give it shade or a den so it survives daylight, and drop the light eff

rows.name: Shadow Magic
rows.promise: An ink-dark pool of shadow where shadows bend toward the caster for about a minute, and anyone inside feels a faint chill and moves unseen.
rows.does: Dims the screen for 10 s and paints a creeping dark ground that fades after 60 s. For 10 s it cools the spot and freezes and calms every creature near it, while dark motes drift to the center.
rows.missing: The freeze status locks creatures in place instead of giving a faint chill and quiet movement. Nothing cloaks those inside or hides them from hunters, and no shadows stretch toward the caster.
rows.fix: Drop c.status('freeze') and keep only a mild w.temperature. Each second, give hostile creatures near the pool 'calm' so they lose those inside, and add a 'shadows' w.draw of dark streaks pointing at w.x, w.y that lasts as long as the ink.

rows.name: Singularity
rows.promise: A small dark sphere pulls loose stones and unanchored creatures into a spinning vortex for about ten seconds, then pops softly, leaving them dizzy but unharmed and the ground littered with what it drew in.
rows.does: Draws a dark spiral, then hangs a black vortex sphere that shrinks over ten seconds. Every creature in reach is pulled inward, spun and levitated. Boulders, rubble, bushes, stumps and flowers fly in as shards. It ends with a soft ping-pop, stuns and heals those caught, and litters rubble and boulder

rows.name: Siren
rows.promise: A shimmering living sea-song that calls wanderers to calm harbors and soothes storms with its hum.
rows.does: Spawns one pale glowing flying spirit that wanders, lures villagers, scares beasts, calms creatures nearby and heals itself when hurt, after a steam puff, beams and a chime.
rows.missing: Nothing ties it to sea, harbor or storm: it never seeks water or calms weather. It drones and chimes instead of singing, and has an unpromised self-heal.
rows.fix: Give it a custom goal that seeks water and lures villagers to the shore, plus an ability or act that calms wind and rain (w.wind(0,0)) when a storm is near. Use w.sound('choir') or a 'whisper' song instead of 'drone' and 'chime', and drop the heal ability.

rows.name: Smoke Screen
rows.promise: A grey smoke cloud about twelve paces across hangs for ten minutes, hiding what is inside, scattering birds and small animals, and making anyone who walks through cough.
rows.does: Hisses, draws a grey ring of rising mist, then holds a 6-cell grey cloud body for 600 seconds. Every 2 seconds it puffs smoke gas over that area, frightens birds and rabbits inside it, and briefly stuns villagers inside.

rows.name: Soul Gem
rows.promise: A small violet gem holding a reserve of stored magic that the people near it can draw strength and healing from.
rows.does: Places a stone block with a violet magic sphere on it. An artifact with 5 recharging charges heals the wounded nearby every 30 seconds, lets villagers come to it for healing, and glows at night.

rows.name: Soul Kiss
rows.promise: A violet breath of mist curls around a target, who grows pale and drowsy while their vitality trickles into the caster, healing them; the victim later wakes unharmed.
rows.does: Sends a violet cloud body toward the tap point. Only if a creature stands within 1.5 cells does it sleep, turn pale and lose 1 hp a second, with the matching heal going to whatever creature happens to stand at an arbitrary spot 0.8 r west. The test run changed no creature.
rows.missing: The target search is so narrow that the spell often hits nobody, and the healed 'caster' is just whoever stands at a made-up point, usually no one, so the heal half never shows. The mist does not linger and curl around the victim.
rows.fix: Choose the victim with w.nearest('villager' or 'animal', w.x, w.y, w.r) instead of creatures within 1.5. Choose the beneficiary as the nearest wounded creature (w.here().wounded) or a second nearby creature and heal it each tick with a visible violet particle stream or w.beam from victim to benefici

rows.name: Soul Siphon
rows.promise: Drain a steady pale-blue thread of vitality from one nearby creature, leaving it grey and weakened for an hour while a warm surge goes to the drinker.
rows.does: Draws a silver spiral over the nearest creature, stuns it, and over 3 s runs a pale-blue beam and particle thread from it to a nearby creature (villagers first) while taking about half its hp. It leaves the victim grey-tinted, shrunk and calmed for an hour, and heals the receiver with an amber glow.

rows.name: Spaceship
rows.promise: A palm-sized brass and silver winged craft with an ember nose that flies swiftly across the sky carrying messages and light parcels.
rows.does: Draws a small static model of a craft on a stone plinth. It lights the area at night, glows again every 20 seconds, and lets villagers draw gold from it. Nothing ever moves.
rows.missing: It never flies or carries anything, and its whole promise is 'move'. The night light and gold grant are unasked defaults. Several model parts are 0.04 thick, under the 0.05 minimum, so they are not drawn, and the craft hovers above a pole that does not reach it.
rows.fix: Drop the light effects and the gold grant. Add an effect {when:'every', every:30, act} that launches a w.body (look 'shard', color brass, trail '#ff9a3a', small r) from the plinth to the nearest village or another village (w.nearest) and back; on arrival it delivers food or gold to that village. Mak

rows.name: Sphinx
rows.promise: A flying winged lion with a human face that guards, carries messages and answers riddles, drifting like a sandstorm.
rows.does: Spawns one glowing flying winged lion that hunts birds and rabbits, walks to villagers to glow at them, scares wolves, and paints sand where it walks and every 40 s around itself.
rows.missing: It never guards anything despite the protect promise; its 'answers' are only a light and a whisper; its sand trail and sandstorm smother village fields.
rows.fix: Use behavior 'guard' with goal 'guard' (its village) and prey hostile/undead instead of rabbits; make the riddle act give something real (heal, calm or gold to the nearest village); drop leaves 'sand' and keep the sandstorm as wind plus a moving sand body only, not paint on fields; set base 'beast'.

rows.name: Stake
rows.promise: A small living-wood stake that pins down undead and restless shadows and wards off curses, with a sleeping vampire visible in its grain.
rows.does: Raises a 30 s ward, stacks a 12-voxel 1x1 wood column with a dark magic blob at mid-height, then lights the night and re-shields at dusk; it only 'scares' a vampire kind the island may not have.
rows.missing: Nothing ever pins, stuns or harms undead or shadows, so the 'harm' half is absent. The look is a 12 m block pillar with a blob, not a slender stake with a sleeping figure, and it is far too big for a cantrip.
rows.fix: Add an effect {when:'enemy', every:15, act} that gives the undead within radius status 'stun' or 'sleep' and hurt(n), and scare 'undead' rather than only 'vampire'. Replace the box and sphere with a w.model of a thin silver stake about 1.5 tall with a faint pale face and cloak in its grain, and keep

rows.name: Star Familiar
rows.promise: A small fox of silver starlight that floats beside a mage, trails falling sparks, never stops glowing and flares to warn of danger.
rows.does: Spawns one glowing, flying, fireproof four-legged silver spirit with a tail that follows villagers and guards them. Every 4 s it drops a glowing spark, and when an enemy comes near it flares an orange light with falling sparks and a chime.

rows.name: Star Metal
rows.promise: A dense silver-blue alloy glimmering with drifting specks of starlight, that smiths and mages forge into rings, blades and wardstones, and that steadies spells.
rows.does: Drops a plain 2x2x2 box of silver-blue stone voxels with a brief chime and a few rising sparks, then works as a generic wardstone: it lights the night, shields against enemies and arms villagers who come to it.
rows.missing: It never looks like star metal: a flat stone cube with no glowing specks, no metallic sheen and no night-sky glimmer. Its spell-steadying nature is absent. The light and the shield are stock extras, not what the metal does.
rows.fix: Draw it with w.model as a forged ingot or meteoric lump: graded silver-blue metal parts with grain, plus small 'glow' specks scattered over its faces, in place of the w.box. Keep the arms grant, which fits blades being forged from it. Replace the night light and the shield with an act effect that st

rows.name: Star Seed
rows.promise: A humming starlight pebble that raises a silver-leaved vine garden overnight, blossoms turned skyward, and keeps the wounded near it from festering.
rows.does: Drops a one-voxel glowing stone, paints a few cells of glowing 'silver vine' cover that slowly creeps into grass, heals in radius 7 every 15 s, repaints vines at night, and drops one star body at dusk.
rows.missing: Far too small for a cosmic tier: the test run changed 24 cells and 1 voxel. The pebble is a near-invisible sphere of radius 0.7 rather than a visible object. The vines carry no blossoms, so a whole garden never appears in one night.
rows.fix: Draw the seed with w.model (a pale grained pebble on a small stone, glowing frost glints). Grow the garden at once and at night over a much larger radius: w.paint silver vine at about w.r and w.tree willows with silver leaves and glowing accent blossoms. Give the vine material flower accents, or pai

rows.name: Starbloom
rows.promise: A glowing blue-white flower full of drifting specks of light, floating on a pool of water that keeps it fresh: a lasting source of star essence.
rows.does: Floods a 3-cell patch with shallow water and sets a ring of about 13 whole-cell voxels as petals and leaves on it, with a glowing particle drizzle. The artifact lights the night, grows plants at dawn and heals every minute, and a starbloom cover slowly seeds the grass around it.
rows.missing: Nothing keeps the pool: a flood one deep on open ground runs off, which can leave the bloom hovering over dry land. The flower is a handful of flat blocks rather than a bud of petals, and heal, prayer and night light are added defaults, not the essence the entry promises.
rows.fix: Make the pool with w.land(x, y, {shape: 'pond', r: 3}) so a spring keeps it full. Draw the bloom as one w.model of layered, tilted glowing petals around a white heart on pads. Swap the heal grant and the prayer use for an essence gift, e.g. a grant or effect whose act gives starlight essence (or gol

rows.name: Starburst
rows.promise: A white flare overhead splits into a dozen shards that burst in a gold-violet ring, burning, blinding and scattering foes, and the grass and stone nearby glow for a minute.
rows.does: A star flare hangs, then 12 shards streak out and burst in a ring. Every creature within R+1 takes 15 damage, burns 3s and is stunned 10s, villagers included. Two glowing ground materials are painted blindly over the area.
rows.missing: Foes are stunned in place, never scattered, and villagers are hit like enemies. The glow paint ignores what is underneath: grass under 'starlit stone' decays into rock and rock under 'starlit grass' into grass, while fields and sand are overwritten, so the land is permanently changed.
rows.fix: Hurt only w.nature(c) hostile or undead, then give them fear for 10s plus a push away from the center. Replace the two blind w.paint calls with a w.disc that sets starlit grass only where cell.ground is grass and starlit stone only where it is rock.

rows.name: Starfall
rows.promise: Glowing motes gather overhead, then shower down bouncing and sparking over a field or square; those there glow silver and feel light for a minute, and the grass glows for the day.
rows.does: Draws a pale circle with a rising hum and light, then drops 60 glowing star bodies over the area. Each bounces twice with spark bursts and leaves a patch of glowing starmoss. Creatures in reach get 60 s of levitate and a silver tint, and a final wash of starmoss covers the center.

rows.name: Starfall Rain
rows.promise: A gentle minute-long shower of silver star shards over a green that heals and soothes those beneath it and leaves the wet grass glowing for an hour.
rows.does: Opens with a circle and a splash of water, then for 60 seconds drops glowing silver shards that drift in over the area, wet the ground and turn grass into glowing starlit grass that lasts an hour; every second it heals and calms every creature within reach.

rows.name: Starship
rows.promise: A tiny crystal spindle with a white flame tail that leaps skyward in a bright streak and carries a traveler across a valley.
rows.does: Draws a crystal spindle on a stone cradle. Every 35 s it is meant to pick a nearby villager and send a star body arcing 25-45 cells away, then teleport the villager there. In the test run only a villager's worship registered; no flight happened.
rows.missing: The flight never happened in five minutes of testing. The villager hovers in place while a separate star flies, then pops to the target instead of riding it. The spindle itself never leaves. The fins and tip are under 0.05 thick and are not drawn. Night light and worship are extras the entry never m
rows.fix: Have the act move the villager along with the body: call v.teleport(b.x, b.y) each tick, or hide the model and lift a spindle-look body with the villager. Widen the search for villagers so it fires near a village, with a shorter first wait. Drop the night light and the worship use. Make every model

rows.name: Stone Guardian
rows.promise: A living granite sentinel with a carved face and a pulsing blue chest vein that stands at a threshold and steps out to block intruders without killing them.
rows.does: Stacks a few stone boxes into a static statue with three blue glow voxels, raises a permanent ward dome that pushes beasts out, and places an artifact that shields, lights at dawn, heals during fires and arms villagers.
rows.missing: No creature is ever defined or spawned, so nothing moves to block anyone; the blocking comes from a generic dome, and the arming, healing and dawn light have nothing to do with the name.
rows.fix: Add a spell.creatures entry (base golem, body golem, features glowing eyes, color2 #5fb8ff, behavior guard, goal guard, attacks that push or stun rather than kill, prey the hostile kinds) and w.spawn it at the threshold; drop the infinite ward, the arms grant, heal and light effects, and the w.box s

rows.name: Stone Shard
rows.promise: A jagged rock sliver rises from the ground, streaks into the foe for moderate damage, scatters pebbles and dissolves into dust after a minute.
rows.does: Raises a grey shard body two cells from the target that flies into it, hurts creatures within 1.5 cells for 12, paints a sparse rock patch, then bursts into dust after 60 seconds and leaves a small pit.

rows.name: Storm Giant
rows.promise: A towering grey cloud-giant, wreathed in lightning and rolling thunder, that brings rain to parched fields, moves gently among crops and can split an oak with a clap.
rows.does: Spawns a grey golem (radius 1.6, glowing eyes) that wanders and tends. Every 10 s it puffs a little steam over the nearest field, which drifts and rains back down. When an enemy is near it claps, shaking the ground and striking the nearest tree with lightning. It also heals every 15 s and scares wol
rows.missing: It reads as a small stone golem, not a towering churning cloud with lightning on its shoulders. Its 'rain' is a small steam puff on any field rather than real rain sought out over dry ones, and the heal ability is an extra the entry never promises.
rows.fix: Give it a cloud look: a model of grey and white boxes with glowing blue-white bolts on the shoulders, plus resize or a larger radius so it towers over villagers. Replace the steam puff with an ability that finds a dry field and casts 'Rain' (or w.gas steam with radius 5 or more and periodic w.lightn

rows.name: Succubus
rows.promise: A pale, red-eyed siren-vampire that sings wary villagers close and then feeds on them with its fangs.
rows.does: Flashes, then spawns one hooded, horned, red-eyed 'succubus' that lures villagers and converts them at night, but is weak to daylight and heals itself when hurt.
rows.missing: Its base 'two legs' is a body, not a built-in kind. Placed by day with weak: light and no den or shade, it may burn away before it ever sings. The self-heal is defence it was never promised, and the chime opening says nothing about a siren's song.
rows.fix: Set base: 'spirit' (or 'villager') with body: 'two legs'. Make it survive the day: drop weak: ['light'], or give it a den or shade to wait in until dusk. Replace the heal ability with a lure or sleep aura that 'sings' villagers in (auraRadius about 4). Use w.sound('whisper') or 'choir' instead of 'c

rows.name: Sunken City
rows.promise: A miniature drowned city of toppled towers, arched bridges, luminous kelp, water held in its streets and lantern-lit windows, sending a tide of recollection that reveals a ruin's lost history.
rows.does: Builds a walled stone square on ruin-colored ground and silt, floods it, adds two leaning spires, an arch, four glowing voxels and four glowing willows. The artifact tops up its water with a teal shockwave every 25 s, summons lantern spirits at night, lights up every minute, waters in drought and gr
rows.missing: The recollection never reads any ruin: the pulse is only a ripple with no target. The 'haunted ruin' ground creeps into sand and dirt across the land. Prayer and worship are unasked extras. The city is a few coarse masses with no w.model for drowned streets, windows or kelp.
