rows.fix: In the pulse act, find nearby ruins (w.nearest('rubble') or a ruins wonder) and reveal them: w.draw glowing runes or ghostly outlines there and w.beam to them, with a light. Drop the spreads on 'haunted ruin' and the prayer grant and worship use. Draw the drowned towers, bridge, lit windows and kelp

rows.name: Sunlight
rows.promise: A gold halo of light hangs over the spot for about a minute, scorching and smoking vampires and undead while the living only feel warmth.
rows.does: Hangs a glowing gold ring body 30 voxels up for 60 s, beaming light down every half second, warming the ground slightly, healing the living, painting flowers and growing plants, and burning, frightening and smoking any creature whose kind name matches a vampire/ghoul/wraith/skeleton-style list.
rows.missing: Undead are found by a name regex that misses zombies, ghosts, revenants and any other undead kind, so the central scorching can do nothing. The flower painting and plant growth are not promised (the entry says the living feel only warmth). The test run changed 0 cells and 0 creatures.
rows.fix: Pick targets with w.nature(c) === 'undead' (or the vampire kind) instead of a name regex. Drop the w.paint flowers, w.grow and c.heal and keep only the mild w.temperature warmth for the living. Open with a 'rise' or 'choir' sound instead of chime.

rows.name: Sunrise
rows.promise: A gold line on the eastern horizon spreads into a warm dawn light over the whole land, waking creatures and lifting spirits.
rows.does: It darkens the island, raises a glowing sun at the east edge, and sweeps a gold line and warm light wash west over 14 s. As it passes it melts snow and ice a little, scatters flowers on grass, and calms, heals and lifts every creature it reaches.

rows.name: Sunstone
rows.promise: A small glowing fire-opal stone veined with pulsing gold that soaks up light and gives back a steady, warm glow in the dark.
rows.does: Places a detailed opal-on-river-stone model with glowing gold veins. By day, motes of light drift into it. At dusk and through the night it keeps a warm 6-cell light lit without gaps, drives off night hunters, and gently warms snow and ice beside it.

rows.name: Superstorm
rows.promise: A huge funnel of wind and rain rips across the land, flattening crops, tearing roofs and knocking people over unharmed, then fades to drizzle.
rows.does: It darkens the sky, swirls clouds, sets the wind, and sends a vortex body across the target with rain and debris particles. In a thin swath it flattens crops, rarely turns a house to rubble, drops a few water puddles, and pushes and stuns creatures. Then a minute of particle drizzle.
rows.missing: The test run changed only 37 cells (0.4%) and no creatures, far too little for a legendary storm. The funnel crosses on a random heading that may miss fields and villages, its swath is narrow, roofs almost never go, and the rain barely wets the land.
rows.fix: Aim the vortex through w.nearest('field') or w.nearest('village') instead of a random angle and widen rc to about R*0.5. Raise the house-to-rubble chance near the core, or knock roofs off as burst voxels. Lay real rain along the path with w.paint(b.x, b.y, rc, 'water', 0.4) or a little mud. Push eve

rows.name: Survivor
rows.promise: An ash-grey, cracked-clay figure with glowing seams that walks among the wounded, heals and comforts them, and helps rebuild ruined villages.
rows.does: Adds one ordinary villager with the builder job and the title Survivor, behind a brief orange flash, a chime, a small burst and a light.
rows.missing: It never heals or tends anyone, and it looks like any other villager: no ash-grey cracked body and no glowing seams.
rows.fix: Declare a spell.creatures kind 'survivor' (base villager, body two legs, color '#8c8680', color2 '#ff9a3c', glowing eyes, goal 'tend', aura 'heal' with a small auraRadius, behavior follow leader villager) and w.spawn it in place of w.person; for rebuilding, add a custom goal that seeks rubble, or ke

rows.name: Survivors
rows.promise: Ash-legged upright creatures with ember-lantern chests that guard shelters, lead lost travellers out of wastes and rebuild ruins.
rows.does: Spawns two grey, glowing, lantern-carrying guard creatures that attack wolves, bears and boars, heal and shield now and then, under a 15-minute ward dome cast at the spot.
rows.missing: Nothing rebuilds ruins or leads anyone. The protection comes mostly from a big ward cast at arrival, not from the creatures, and boars are hunted as if they were threats.
rows.fix: Give the survivor a custom goal that seeks rubble near a village and clears it or raises a w.building there, or a fallback like 'build'. Drop the standalone lastingWard and let the 'shield' ability protect. Keep prey to wolf and bear, the hunters that threaten villagers.

rows.name: Swamp Horde
rows.promise: A sluggish swarm of cloned ox-sized bog monsters that haul timber, drain fens and lurk in the mire to guard crossings against whoever comes near.
rows.does: Paints a patch of spreading bog peat and mud and spawns 4 mud-brown four-legged guard beasts that attack beasts and spirits. It also places an invisible 'Swamp Horde' artifact that shields and waters fields, and raises an hour-long ward dome over the whole village.
rows.missing: The hour-long village dome and the shielding, field-watering artifact belong to a sanctuary, not a creature. The horde's own work of hauling timber and draining fens is absent.
rows.fix: Remove w.artifact and lastingWard. Spawn 5 to 6 clones and give the creature a custom goal that seeks tree and carries wood to the village, with like: 'build'. Keep the guard behavior with prey ['beast','hostile'] and have it leave 'mud' around its mire.

rows.name: Swamp Thing
rows.promise: A slow, moss-draped bog creature of peat and root, with a glowing fungus face, that mends poisoned marshes and guards fords against trespassers.
rows.does: Spawns one golem-based tree-folk creature with a heal aura and guard goal, and raises an hour-long ward dome over the spot.
rows.missing: Nothing mends the marsh: no poison is cleared, no mud or moss is left and no wetland is sought. It has no prey, so it never fights trespassers, and the dome is a generic extra the creature doesn't make.
rows.fix: Drop lib.lastingWard; give the creature prey ["hostile","undead"] and a custom goal that seeks water or swamp and clears poison gas there (w.clear(x,y,"gas")), plus leaves "mud" or a moss material, so it mends wetlands and attacks what comes near the ford.

rows.name: Talos
rows.promise: A child-sized bronze golem with glowing amber joints that hauls heavy loads and stands sentinel, turning on intruders.
rows.does: Spawns a bronze golem that hauls boulders as stone for the village, guards and attacks wolves and raiders, drips healing ambrosia, and on arrival raises a 15-minute ward dome over the whole spot.
rows.missing: The village-wide ward dome is not part of a porter golem; the golem's own guarding should be the protection. The heal aura and shield ability are also extras beyond a dripping glow.
rows.fix: Remove lib.lastingWard and the shield ability. Keep the haul goal and guard behavior with prey and sense so Talos itself confronts intruders. Make the ambrosia drip mostly a look or lure rather than an aura heal.

rows.name: Tar Pit
rows.promise: A shallow obsidian bowl of black, steaming tar that holds fast anything that crosses it.
rows.does: Rings a 2-cell pool of glowing black tar with rock and puffs smoke and bubbles. Every 10 s it stuns creatures within 2.5 cells for 3 s. The tar lures beasts, hurts a little and slowly creeps over the nearby soil.
rows.missing: The hold has gaps: 3 s of stun every 10 s lets most crossers walk free, and the tar that spreads binds nothing. The rim is plain rock, not cracked obsidian, it gives off smoke instead of warm steam, and the black tar glows at night.
rows.fix: Stun every 2 to 3 s for 3 s so whatever stands in the tar stays stuck, and cover the whole tar area, not only 2.5 cells. Set the ring to basalt, use w.gas 'steam' instead of 'smoke', and drop glow from the tar material.

rows.name: Tar Pits
rows.promise: A glossy black tar pool with pale ripples that makes duller twins of what is dipped in it, shrinking with each copy.
rows.does: Floods a small tar pool, adds two more tar patches every 12 s, puffs dark particles, paints scattered rock and smokes when burning; the tar lures villagers and creeps over rock, dirt and sand.
rows.missing: No copying at all: nothing ever gets a duller twin, and the tar never drains with use. It grows instead. The pale ripples are also absent.
rows.fix: Add an act effect, or a pair with villager and beast, that spends a charge to w.spawn a copy of a creature at the pool's edge with c.tint grey and a smaller c.resize, then w.clear some tar cells so the pool shrinks; drop the periodic rock painting and the endless self-flooding, and add pale glow par

rows.name: Tartarus
rows.promise: A scorched hollow of ash cliffs and black stone with crawling lava, smoking vents, glowing ores that miners dig, and a cold deep pit.
rows.does: Sinks a 10-cell crater with an ash and rock rim, a basalt floor seeded with glowing underore that lures villagers, three lava runnels, smoke, lantern posts and black stones. Over time it keeps venting smoke, leaking lava, regrowing ore and summoning cold shades at night.

rows.name: Transmutation
rows.promise: A slow ash-grey circle is drawn and everything inside changes its nature: stone to gold, rotting wood to living oak, water to salt, reverting after a season.
rows.does: An ash-grey arc and orb trace the full circle over 3 s. Rings then sweep inward, turning water into salt, rock into glowing gold that lures villagers, ash into grass, and stumps or rubble into trees and grown oaks. Gold and salt decay back after 300 s.

rows.name: Treant
rows.promise: A house-tall walking tree guardian that tends groves, shields villages from storms and guards saplings against axes and fire.
rows.does: Spawns one guard-behaviour tree-folk treant beside a crude trunk-and-leaf-ball voxel prop. Raises a 60-second ward and leaves an invisible artifact that re-shields the village every 20 seconds.
rows.missing: The protection comes from a separate dome artifact, not the Treant. The Treant never tends or grows trees, never guards saplings from axes or fire, and is itself weak to fire. The floating voxel blob reads as a second, static tree.
rows.fix: Drop the w.box/w.sphere prop and the 'Treant' artifact. Give the treant creature the work: goal 'tend' (or a custom goal seeking tree that w.grow()s saplings), leaves 'flower', and abilities [{do:'grow', when:'every so often', every:30}, {do:'shield', when:'enemy near', every:20}]. Have it guard tre

rows.name: True Love's Kiss
rows.promise: Two people kiss inside a rising golden spiral and glow warmly for an hour, healed, calm and unafraid; anyone within arm's length is touched too.
rows.does: Picks the two nearest villagers, sets them side by side, and raises a twin golden spiral and a heart of particles with heartbeat sounds. It heals both and gives them an hour-long warm tint, a pink star mark, slow healing and renewed calm, and heals and calms anyone within 1.5 cells.

rows.name: Turn Undead
rows.promise: A pale ring of holy light makes nearby undead kneel, glow gold and stay harmless for a minute, sends them back toward their graves, and cleans the rot from the ground.
rows.does: Raises a 60 s golden ward with a choir, a palm rune and a ring shockwave. Every undead in reach is stunned, pushed back, tinted gold and kept calm for 60 s under a star mark. It pushes them outward for 8 s and clears poison, smoke, mud, acid and ash from the ground.

rows.name: Twilight
rows.promise: A dusky shimmer washes over the valley, dimming the light, calming and soothing the wounded, revealing what is hidden and weakening creatures of darkness.
rows.does: Converging gold and violet particles, a burst, a shockwave, a brief light and tint, and 40 s of dimming. It raises a 600 s ward that keeps out spirits and wolves and leaves a landmark that hurts them. It heals and calms every other creature in reach and frightens and hurts spirits and wolves.
rows.missing: Nothing is revealed. The creatures of darkness it treats as such are spirits and wolves, not undead or hostile kinds. It adds a long protective ward the entry never promises.
rows.fix: Remove the w.ward. Target h.undead and h.hostile instead of spirit and wolf, with hurt and stun, and make the landmark scare those kinds. Heal h.wounded. Show the reveal by putting a w.light or w.burst on each hidden or hostile creature in reach so the player sees them picked out.

rows.name: Twin
rows.promise: A pearl-grey ovoid that makes a nearby creature produce an identical copy beside it, which later fades away.
rows.does: Flashes, chimes and leaves a small magic sphere; its artifact effects put code in 'do' instead of 'act', so the engine drops them and no copy is ever made (the test run shows nothing acted).
rows.missing: No twin ever appears: the duplication and fading never run, so the player sees only an orb and a flash.
rows.fix: Move both functions from do into act(self, w, target) with a valid trigger (when: 'every', every: 10); keep the effects that spawn a tinted, stunned copy of a nearby beast beside it and kill the copy after about 90 seconds with a burst. Duplicate villagers with w.person rather than w.spawn, and draw

rows.name: Twin Phoenixes
rows.promise: A pair of gold-and-crimson fire birds sharing one heartbeat: when one is harmed, the other bursts into flame and flies to its side. They guard sanctuaries.
rows.does: Raises two stone spires and a permanent ward over the square, then spawns two glowing fire-bird guards that heal nearby, scare beasts and breathe fire. When one is hurt, a flame orb flies from the other's spot to it and drops a small fire.
rows.missing: The twin never moves, bursts into flame or feels the harm. Only a detached flame orb travels, so the signature linked pair reads as two separate birds. The spires and the heal aura are extras the entry never mentions.
rows.fix: In the 'answer' act, make the twin itself go: burst and tint it in flame at its spot, then move it beside the hurt bird with twin.teleport(self.x+1, self.y) or a seek, or share the bond by hurting the twin a little and healing the hurt one. Drop w.fire from the orb's end, and drop the spires unless

rows.name: Undead
rows.promise: Undead, a creature: the dead rise as mindless, obedient walking corpses that move while the bond holds.
rows.does: Draws a black stone ring with a glowing ring body over ash and places an artifact that every 15 s revives a nearby corpse as its old self (once in the test); it also lures villagers to guard it.
rows.missing: No undead creature ever appears. Revived corpses come back as ordinary living villagers or animals, not mindless obedient dead, and with no corpse nearby nothing rises at all. do:'act' is not a valid effect name, so that effect is dropped.
rows.fix: Declare a spell.creatures undead kind (e.g. 'risen', base villager, grey-green tint, glowing eyes, behavior follow its maker or wander, slow, weak light, active night with a den by day), spawn one or two at cast, and in the corpse pair's act call c.revive(); c.transform('risen'). Drop lures villager

rows.name: Undead Horde
rows.promise: A shambling horde of gray dead bound with green thread that guards a spot, marching in slow tireless rings.
rows.does: Spawns three gray golem-based dead with glowing green eyes that guard against wolves and boars, wander up to 6 cells to stamp grave-dust rings, and occasionally raise the dead.
rows.missing: Three bodies is not a horde at major tier, and they walk to random spots and paint circles instead of marching in rings around what they guard.
rows.fix: Spawn 7 to 9 horde dead in a loose ring, and make the ring march walk them in a circle around their spawn point, for example seek "home" with near 3 and an act that steps each one to the next point on a 3-cell ring, leaving grave dust as they go.

rows.name: Universe
rows.promise: A plum-sized sphere of orbiting starlight round a dark core, sealed in silver, used as a lens that reveals the vast patterns of the cosmos (cosmic tier).
rows.does: Sets a tiny stone stand with a dark glowing orb circled by colored particle stars. It paints stardust that lures villagers and spirits, lights the night, summons a spirit at dusk and is worshipped.
rows.missing: Nothing is ever revealed, though reveal is its promise and the entry's purpose. Its night light spills, against 'never spills into the room'. The effect is a few cells, far too small for cosmic.
rows.fix: Drop the night light and prayer grant. Add a reveal act at night: w.camera pulls back over the whole island, w.draw constellation lines across it, and w.beam/w.light marks what is hidden (w.here hostile, undead, wounded; w.nearest lava, water, village).

rows.name: Vampire
rows.promise: A pale, winged, red-eyed vampire that hangs in darkness, feeds on the warmth of the living and chills the air where its shadow falls.
rows.does: After a dark red flash and a drone, it spawns one pale, winged, glowing-eyed flying vampire that hunts villagers at night, converts its victims, chills those near it with a freeze aura and is weak to light; in the test run it kept acting for five minutes.

rows.name: Vampire Hunter
rows.promise: A man-sized construct of ash and oak with a stake spear and glowing green eyes that prowls at night hunting and driving out the undead.
rows.does: Makes an ordinary villager with a guard job titled Vampire Hunter, and draws a static stake model one cell beside where it spawned, with a green circle, flash and burst.
rows.missing: The wooden ribbed figure never appears, the stake is left behind instead of carried, and nothing makes it seek out undead at night beyond a guard's ordinary patrol.
rows.fix: Declare a spell.creatures kind (base golem, body two legs, colors pale ash and oak, features spear and glowing eyes, color2 green) with behavior hunt, prey undead, goal hunt, active night, sense high and immune to cold. Spawn it with w.spawn instead of w.person, and drop the loose stake model.

rows.name: Vampire Lord
rows.promise: A hound-sized pale, garnet-eyed vampire creature that hungers, refuses to stay dead, and serves as a bound warden.
rows.does: Raises a dark stone spire with a red magic voxel and a permanent ward dome over the area. It spawns one winged, flying night guard creature that is weak to light and preys only on spirits. A linked artifact glows at night and heals every 45 seconds.
rows.missing: Nothing shows the dhampir's hunger or its refusal to stay dead, and nothing lets it survive the day, so it can die in daylight or sit idle. The artifact's night light works against a light-weak vampire, and the heal is an unasked-for default. The infinite ward dome outweighs the creature itself.
rows.fix: Have the creature hunt living prey (deer, boar, raiders) at night and rest in the spire as a den by day. Give it a revive ability when hurt or `onDeath` `spawn:vampire lord`, and keep `guard` near the village. Drop the artifact's light and heal effects, and limit the ward to a shorter `w.ward` cast

rows.name: Vanish
rows.promise: The caster, or whoever is at the spot, turns invisible for a minute, with a silver haze and an ember-gold trail as it fades.
rows.does: Raises a clear ward dome for 60 s, hangs a silver cloud with swirling particles over the spot, calms and levitates creatures nearby, then bursts gray-ash particles with a chime.
rows.missing: Nothing becomes unseen: creatures stay fully visible and get levitated and calmed instead, and the protective ward dome is an extra the entry never mentions; the ember-gold trail is absent.
rows.fix: Remove the ward and levitate; for a minute, make the creatures at the spot near-invisible (tint them faint/transparent, or transform them into a translucent custom kind that hunters ignore) and have their pursuers lose track (calm or fear on the hunters), leave faint footprint particles, and end wit

rows.name: Void
rows.promise: A plum-sized orb of starless darkness that drinks the light around it, mutes spells and stills restless air and flames.
rows.does: Sets a stone plinth with a small floating black sphere; when fire is near it chills the area, turns burning cells to ash and zeroes the wind; every 15 s it clears gas; at night it calms creatures nearby; villagers worship it.
rows.missing: Nothing drinks light, though that is the entry's central trait: lanterns, glow and fire light around it never dim. Nothing mutes spells. Prayer, worship and the night calm are extras the entry never mentions. The plinth is coarse whole-cell boxes, not a fine model.
rows.fix: Add a night or every effect that dims light around it, such as a small w.light with a near-black color or local darkening, and pulls glow particles inward. Make fire act on flames already near it rather than global wind. Drop grants prayer, the worship use and the calm aura. Draw the plinth and orb

rows.name: Void Familiar
rows.promise: A cat-sized coal-black familiar with starlight eyes that blinks in and out of view, serves as a messenger and lookout, fetches things, and pulls loose objects toward itself.
rows.does: Spawns one dark winged flying spirit with glowing eyes that follows a villager, gathers, teleports every 16 s and when hurt, scares beasts, and every 10 s erases free voxels within 3 cells under a dark burst.
rows.missing: Its gravity erases nearby loose voxels (w.unvoxel) instead of pulling anything toward it. It is drawn as a winged spirit rather than a sleek cat-like creature, and the scaring of beasts is not part of its entry.
rows.fix: Replace the unvoxel pull with a real tug: nearby small creatures get c.push toward self (and/or a short-lived dark body that seeks self). Use body 'four legs' with features ['tail','glowing eyes'] at cat size, add a goal that fetches (seek a material, carry it to its keeper), and drop scares: ['beas

rows.name: Void Grove
rows.promise: A small twisted tree with light-drinking bark and leaves slowly orbiting a dark floating sphere where its crown should be, a source of space-folding power that pulls distant things in.
rows.does: Grows a 14-voxel dead-style tree with dark glowing leaves, sets a dark magic sphere at z 18 above it, and keeps a vortex body there that nudges creatures within 7 cells toward it (0.05 a frame) and drops a few pale particles.
rows.missing: The pull is so faint that the test saw only 2 creatures move. Nothing beyond 7 cells, and no object or item, is ever drawn in, so the 'distant objects' and space-folding are absent. The leaves glow, which is the opposite of light-drinking. It is placed as a bare tree and body, with no artifact, so n
rows.fix: Make it a w.artifact with an effect act(self, w) that every few seconds draws creatures from about 12 to 15 cells away toward the core with a clearly visible push or a short teleport closer, using a beam or particle streak as the fold. Drop glow from the leaves. Keep the leaves orbiting the sphere a

rows.name: Volcanic Ash
rows.promise: A layer of grey, gritty, faintly ember-glowing ash that hangs in the air, marks a warding circle and makes fire burn hotter.
rows.does: Raises a ward dome and a magic circle, sprinkles inert glowing ash cover over the inner half, and builds a stone arch with a glowing orb that holds an artifact for night light and a fire shield.
rows.missing: The ash never hangs in the air, runs hot or feeds fire (flammable 0, no reactions). The arch gate is invented. The recurring ward effect uses a function as do, so the engine drops it and the dome lapses after 30 s.
rows.fix: Drop the arch, orb and night light. Paint volcanic ash as a denser ground layer with heat, a low glow and reacts {water: 'mud'}. Add a lingering w.gas smoke/ash haze and let the ash boost fire (w.heat, faster ignite). Move the periodic w.ward into act(self, w) with a valid effect, and use 'hiss' or

rows.name: Volcanic Smog
rows.promise: A choking, amber-lit sulfurous cloud that drifts a few paces, makes anyone inside cough for a minute, browns the plants under it and fades after a minute.
rows.does: A glowing grey-amber cloud body forms after a falling blob of lava leaves a small lava puddle, steam and poison gas. For 60 seconds it drifts slowly, lays poison gas, stuns creatures under it and turns crops, flowers and bushes to ash.

rows.name: Wall of Fire
rows.promise: A curtain of real fire, house-tall, in a ring that burns whoever steps in, makes animals flee, lasts long and leaves scorched grass.
rows.does: Lays a ring of ash, raises a static ring of orange 'magic' voxels 8 tall, and puts an hour-long ward dome over the whole inside that blocks fire, lava, blasts and raiders.
rows.missing: Nothing actually burns: no w.fire on the ring, no burn on creatures that cross it, no fear on animals. The orange voxels are a solid wall that never flickers or fades, and the dome does the protecting, not the flames.
rows.fix: Keep the ring but run a lasting body whose tick re-lights w.fire on ring cells (on ash, so it cannot spread inward). It should give status('burn') to creatures inside the ring band, give status('fear', from the ring) to beasts and hostiles within a few cells, and emit rising flame particles. Drop or

rows.name: Wasteland
rows.promise: A large patch of cracked grey ashen earth with dead roots that withers nearby meadows and crops and stays barren until cleansed.
rows.does: Sinks and paints a disc up to 16 cells across as grey blighted earth, ash, dead roots, stumps and dead trees. A Blight Heart artifact withers crops, flowers, bushes, grass and some trees within 12 cells every 20 seconds. The blight creeps into grass, fields and crops (670 cells in the test run), and

rows.name: Water Sprite
rows.promise: A tiny shimmering water creature that slips through wells and puddles as a messenger and reveals which waters are safe to drink.
rows.does: Spawns one glowing blue spirit-based sprite that wanders and explores the island, leaving water on the cells it walks over and healing itself when hurt.
rows.missing: Nothing ties it to water or reveals anything. It does not seek wells, puddles or lakes, does not mark or test water, and carries no messages. Its self-heal is defensive magic the name does not promise.
rows.fix: Make it seek water through a custom goal (seek 'water', near the village wells) whose act marks safe or fouled water, for example with a brief w.light or glow on clean water and a w.gas('poison') or tint on acid, mud or poisoned cells. Drop the heal ability, and give it a water-themed arrival (sound

rows.name: Wellspring of Life
rows.promise: A glowing silver-green spring that bubbles in a heartbeat pulse and restores weary people, beasts and wilting gardens nearby.
rows.does: Raises a rim of land around a small pool of glowing wellspring water (which turns to plain water after 240 s), opening with a flash, chime and burst; the artifact heals everyone within 6 cells every 4 s, waters fields in drought, lights up at dusk, and grants heal and water to villagers.
rows.missing: No ongoing heartbeat bubbling, only a one-off burst and a chime; wilting gardens are watered only in drought and never regrown; the dusk light is an extra the name never promised.
rows.fix: Add a body or a timed effect that pulses bubbles and a heartbeat sound from the pool every second or two; replace the dusk light with a {when:'every', do:'grow'} effect so nearby plants recover; open with w.sound('water') or 'heartbeat' instead of the chime.

rows.name: White Wizard
rows.promise: A tall wizard in shadow robes with a pale-fire hem who carries a staff of cold white flame and guards a place, dazzling intruders with harmless light and sparing the wise.
rows.does: Adds an ordinary elder villager titled White Wizard and plants a glowing staff model with an artifact beside him. Every 6 s the artifact beams at hostiles, undead and wolves within 12 cells, stunning them for 3 s and frightening them for 10 s. It also lights the area at night and grows plants at daw
rows.missing: The wizard is a plain villager with no shadow robes and no pale-fire hem, and he wanders off with the village. He never carries the staff or does any guarding himself. All the protection comes from a staff left standing in the ground, and its 12-cell reach is small for a legendary tier.
rows.fix: Give w.person a guard job so he stays at the staff, and draw him with a w.model as a tall figure in dark robes with a glowing pale hem, holding the flaming staff. Widen the artifact's radius and its foe check toward w.r, and drop the dawn grow effect, which the entry never promised.

rows.name: Wild Hunt
rows.promise: A bridle of northern light that calls four pale, tireless ghost riders who gallop across the sky, scouting and carrying messages far away.
rows.does: Raises a stone spire under an aurora of magic voxels and spawns four flying spectral riders at once. The riders hunt wolves and bears, leave snow and last 150 seconds. The artifact summons more at dusk, lights the night, freezes enemies and grants prayer and arms.
rows.missing: The riders are weak to daylight and spawn in the open whenever it is placed, so by day they wither before riding anywhere; after five minutes only villager worship was recorded. Nothing scouts or carries messages over distance. Prayer, arms and night light are extras the name never promised.
rows.fix: Remove weak: ['light'] or hold the first riders as mist until dusk. Give the riders a custom goal (seek 'village' or 'anywhere' with a large near) so they ride between distant villages and the far edges of the island. Drop the prayer/arms grants and the light effect.

rows.name: Will-o'-the-Wisps
rows.promise: Small pale-green flame orbs that bob at shoulder height, light the dark, guide travellers across bog and forest, and dim when left alone.
rows.does: Spawns 3 glowing green flying spirits with eyes that follow villagers, plus an artifact that lures villagers, lights the night, tints the wisps dark when no villager is near, and puffs smoke every 25 s.
rows.missing: They follow villagers instead of leading them, they look like spirit figures with eyes rather than plum-sized flame orbs, and the smoke puffs suggest burning.
rows.fix: Give the wisp a custom goal that walks ahead of villagers to a destination (a model or small glowing body as a pale-green flame orb, no eyes), drop the smoke gas, and keep the light and dim tint.

rows.name: Wisp Lantern
rows.promise: A small silver-wire lantern with a restless glowing wisp whose light draws travelers away from danger and keeps them safe.
rows.does: Draws a staff-hung silver lantern with a glowing bulb and raises a long ward over its spot. A glowing wisp orbit flickers light around it, darts toward fire, lava or raiders, and pulls stray villagers back to the lantern. It also shields on enemy or fire and lights the night.

rows.name: Withering
rows.promise: A small spiral sigil pulls green life into a void, turning plants grey and grass to dust in a ~10-pace circle, and leaving creatures there weary and slow for a minute.
rows.does: Draws a spiral sigil with green particles and a vortex spiraling inward, then paints grey blight dust and grey dry-leaf cover over a radius-5 disc (both decay in 300 s) and gives creatures inside fear for 60 s.
rows.missing: Creatures panic and flee instead of growing weary and slow, and dry-leaf cover is painted over every cell, including bare ones, rather than only withering the plants that are there.
rows.fix: Replace status('fear', 60) with a sleep or stun status lasting a few seconds and repeated over the minute (or with a slowing effect). Lay 'dry leaf' only on cells whose w.cell cover is tree, bush, crop or flower, and turn trees into grey dead-style trees rather than replacing them.

rows.name: World Tree
rows.promise: A tall, slender silver-barked tree with softly glowing green light that anchors new growth, spreading groves and gardens across the soil around it.
rows.does: Grows a 70-voxel giant tree with a silver trunk and glowing pale green crown. A glowing rootglow ground spreads from its base, and every 40 s it plants silver birch and oak saplings with greenery nearby. It also grows the land at dawn and summons flower-leaving tending sprites; the test run shows on

rows.name: World Tree Awakening
rows.promise: Glowing green veins split the ground, roots burst up and cradle every creature in bark and blossom to heal it, and glowing leaves linger for a day.
rows.does: Draws glowing veins and jolts the land, grows a 75-voxel glowing world tree at the center with wooden root arches along the veins, heals and levitates every creature for 6s with a green beam, and paints decaying glowleaf over the island under a healing landmark.
rows.missing: No roots rise under the creatures (they float on a beam), the quakes and arches wreck about 8% of houses during a healing spell, and an unexplained -40 chill hits the tree's base.
rows.fix: For each lifted creature, raise a small w.arch or w.tree root of bark and a w.model blossom cradle at (c.x, c.y). Drop the quakes or keep them weak, skip arch points where w.wouldHurt shows houses, and remove w.temperature(cx, cy, 14, -40).

rows.name: World Tree Guardian
rows.promise: A living silver-barked staff with a dryad spirit that raises protective root-walls from the soil and watches over the forests.
rows.does: Plants a glowing silver staff with a leafy crown, raises a 600-second ward and a ring of eight gapped wooden root-walls, grows the land and flowers, and spawns two dryads that tend, heal and guard. The artifact keeps shielding, healing, growing and reviving.

rows.name: World Turtle
rows.promise: A vast living turtle whose mossy shell carries forest, river and village, with lantern eyes, that slowly moves settlements across the land and steadies the ground.
rows.does: Raises a mossy hill with blocky stone legs, head and tail around it, plants trees, a stream line, four loose houses and villagers on top, briefly lights two eye voxels, then leaves a static artifact that greens the land, lights at dusk, rains in droughts and is worshipped.
rows.missing: It is never a creature and never moves or carries anything, so the central promise of bearing settlements across barren lands is absent. The eyes glow only for 4 seconds, and the body is crude whole-cell boxes rather than a turtle model.
rows.fix: Add a spell.creatures turtle (body four legs, huge radius, very slow wander/migrate goal, glowing eyes) spawned under the shell, or a slow body that drags the shell hill and its village a few cells over time. Draw the head, legs and scutes with w.model, make the eyes lasting 'glow' parts, and build

rows.name: Wraith
rows.promise: A vial of silver-grey mist that thickens and curls toward any living, warm creature within a few paces, revealing them.
rows.does: A flash, drone and chime, eight floating grey magic spheres and a burst; both effects put code in `do` instead of `act`, so the engine drops them, and the test run shows nothing happening after arrival.
rows.missing: No mist ever curls toward living things (the sensing never runs), there is no vial look, and it adds unpromised extras: scaring beasts at night and a heal grant.
rows.fix: Move each effect's code into act with when 'every' (do is only for engine names), so every few seconds it finds w.creatures within about 4 cells and sends drifting pale particles or a thin beam from the vial to each one; draw a small glass vial with coiling mist in one w.model; drop the beast fear a

rows.name: Yama
rows.promise: A slow, gaunt grey-earth and bone guardian with a dark stone heart that leaves frosting footprints, guards thresholds and carries the weary out of ruins.
rows.does: Spawns one grey golem-based guard with orange glowing eyes, a hood and a lantern, draws a stone doorway model, and raises a 30-minute ward over the area. It calms nearby spirits, heals now and then, and shields when enemies come near.
rows.missing: No cold footprints that frost over. Nothing carries or leads weary or wounded villagers to safety. Most of its prey and keepOut kinds (ghost, zombie, skeleton, wraith, raider) are undeclared, so the guard has little to fight. Its orange fire-eyes and lantern read warm rather than cold.
rows.fix: Add leaves: "ice" (or a frost material) and a slower speed. Recolor the accents to pale bone and cold slate. Set prey/keepOut to real kinds (undead, hostile, wolf, bear). Replace the generic heal with an ability that finds w.here().wounded villagers far from home and teleports or escorts them back t

rows.name: Ymir
rows.promise: A slowly beating frost heart that mends frostbitten land and wakes seeds through winter.
rows.does: Sets a magic blue orb on an ice plinth that pulses light. It paints creeping rimebloom that turns snow, ash and dirt to grass, grows plants at dawn, heals nearby creatures every 40 s, sprouts stumps into trees at night, and summons a healing rime warden on full moons.
